jobs.description:
HONK is a technology-driven roadside assistance platform that connects enterprise customers (insurance carriers, auto clubs, warranty companies, and fleet operators) with a nationwide network of independent service providers. Our mission is to help people and vehicles move forward - quickly, safely, and seamlessly - whenever and wherever it matters most.

Our platform powers one of the largest digital roadside assistance marketplaces in North America, intelligently connecting enterprise customers with a nationwide network of service providers. Through automation, AI, and modern dispatch technology, we're helping the industry move beyond legacy call-center models to deliver faster, more transparent, and more reliable roadside assistance at scale. Backed by private equity and investing aggressively in innovation, we're building the future of roadside assistance.

The Role

    As an Account Director, you'll identify strategic opportunities, build executive relationships, navigate complex buying organizations, and lead customers from first conversation through contract execution and successful commercialization.

    Unlike many enterprise sales organizations, we believe hunting and long-term account management are different disciplines. Once a customer is successfully commercialized, ownership transitions to our Strategic Account Management team, allowing Account Directors to stay focused on what they do best - creating and winning the next enterprise opportunity.

You Will:

  • Create and execute account strategies that open doors, build executive sponsorship, and convert targeted prospects into long-term HONK customers.
  • Generate a predictable pipeline through strategic prospecting, executive networking, industry engagement, and partner relationships.
  • Establish trusted relationships with executive decision-makers across insurance, automotive, fleet, mobility, and technology organizations.
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles involving executive leadership, operations, technology, procurement, legal, and finance stakeholders.
  • Understand customer business challenges and position HONK’s platform to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Develop commercial proposals, executive presentations, business cases, and contract strategies.
  • Lead contract negotiations through execution while partnering with internal stakeholders to ensure successful customer commercialization.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Operations, and Strategic Account Management throughout the sales process.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM reporting.
  • Represent HONK professionally at customer meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling complex technology or SaaS solutions.
  • Proven success acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently exceeding sales targets.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with Fortune 1000 or large enterprise organizations.
  • Executive presence with the ability to build trusted relationships at the C-suite and senior leadership levels.
  • Strong business acumen with experience developing commercial strategies, business cases, and executive presentations.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy.
  • Experience within insurance, automotive, fleet, mobility, marketplace, infrastructure, or enterprise technology organizations is strongly preferred.
At HONK, we're a community of diverse and passionate individuals who believe in the power of remote work and the strength of inclusivity. As a remote-first company, we embrace the boundless possibilities of collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from anywhere in the US.
HONK is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions at HONK are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by law.

We are seeking a highly motivated Staff Software Development Engineer to be the hands-on technical lead for a product domain within our consumer lending platform. This role owns the architecture and delivery of secure, scalable platform services on cloud infrastructure, and brings AI capabilities into those services safely and in compliance with financial-services regulation.


The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise with a strong understanding of cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and the unique challenges of fintech, including security, compliance, data privacy, and transaction reliability. As a Staff Engineer, you will partner with Product, Data, Risk, Compliance, and Security, mentor SDEs and Senior SDEs, and contribute to the engineering standards set by our Principal engineers and architecture group.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Apply and evolve engineering standards, best practices, and architectural principles within your domain, and contribute to org-wide standards set by Principal engineers.
  • Drive cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven designs that align with the enterprise architecture.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Data, Risk, Compliance, and Security teams to deliver scalable business solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies for your domain and recommend solutions that improve performance, security, and operational efficiency, escalating cross-cutting choices to Principal SDEs and Architecture.

jobs.title: Windows Server Administrator
jobs.excerpt: TTM Technologies, Inc.  – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer About TTMTTM Technologies, Inc.
jobs.description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

TTM Technologies is seeking a hands-on, operationally focused Windows Server Administrator to join our IT Infrastructure team. This is a core operations role responsible for the day-to-day health, patching, management, and lifecycle of TTM's Windows Server environment — on-premises, colocation, and virtualized. The Server Administrator operates as the primary owner of server operations and works independently to keep TTM's server estate secure, compliant, and performing.

While the Server Administrator coordinates with the broader IT team, the day-to-day focus is on Windows server operations. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in an operations environment, takes ownership of infrastructure reliability, and brings a strong foundation in NinjaOne RMM, Windows Server administration, virtualization, and PowerShell-driven automation.


Duties and Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Server Patching & Compliance – Own and execute TTM's enterprise server patching program end-to-end using NinjaOne RMM as the primary platform. Define and enforce patch schedules, approval workflows, and maintenance windows across production, staging, and development server environments. Track patch compliance, generate regular patching status reports, and escalate exceptions to IT management. Ensure patch SLAs are consistently met across the global server estate.
  • NinjaOne RMM Administration – Serve as TTM's primary administrator for the NinjaOne RMM platform. Configure and maintain monitoring policies, alert thresholds, patch deployment pipelines, remote access workflows, and automation scripts within NinjaOne. Build and tune custom dashboards for server health, patch compliance, and capacity visibility. Develop NinjaOne automation scripts to reduce manual operational tasks and improve response times across the server estate.
  • Windows Server Administration – Administer TTM's Windows Server environment across all versions (2016, 2019, 2022, 2025) including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, DFS, file services, and print services. Manage server roles, features, and configurations across production, staging, and development environments. Troubleshoot and resolve Windows Server issues independently and efficiently.
  • Virtualization & VM Management – Build, configure, manage, and maintain virtual machines on VMware vSphere. Maintain VM templates, manage snapshots, and allocate compute and storage resources based on workload requirements and performance data. Right-size VMs to optimize infrastructure efficiency and perform P2V and V2V migrations as needed.
  • Server Upgrades & Lifecycle Management – Plan and execute server OS upgrades, refresh cycles, and workload migrations with minimal disruption to business operations. Manage the full server lifecycle from provisioning through decommission — including data wiping, asset documentation, and inventory updates. Maintain accurate CMDB / asset records for all managed servers and virtual machines.
  • Server Monitoring & Health – Monitor server health, performance, capacity, and availability using NinjaOne and integrated monitoring tools. Proactively identify and remediate performance bottlenecks, storage capacity risks, and infrastructure anomalies before they impact operations. Deliver regular server health and capacity reports to IT management.
  • PowerShell Automation – Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation workflows to streamline repetitive server administration tasks — including patching automation, health checks, provisioning workflows, compliance reporting, and alerting integrations. Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through scripting and NinjaOne automation.
  • DevOps & Automation Practices – Apply DevOps practices to server operations where applicable — including version-controlled script repositories, automated testing of configuration changes, and repeatable deployment procedures for server builds and upgrades. Experience with infrastructure automation tooling is a plus for driving operational consistency and reducing configuration drift.
  • Endpoint Security & EDR Compliance – Ensure servers are enrolled in and compliant with TTM's endpoint protection platforms — including SentinelOne EDR and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Respond to endpoint alerts and remediate vulnerabilities identified through EDR and patch compliance reporting.
  • Incident Response & Troubleshooting – Respond to and resolve server-related incidents as the primary technical owner, including P1/P2 production outages. Lead root cause analysis and post-incident reviews for server infrastructure events. Maintain and continuously improve operational runbooks based on incident learnings to prevent recurrence.
  • Documentation & Change Management – Create and maintain thorough documentation of server configurations, patch baselines, VM inventories, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Ensure documentation is current, accurate, and accessible to the IT team. Maintain change records for all server modifications through TTM's change management process.

Education and Experience

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred — or equivalent combination of hands-on experience and technical certifications

Required Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in a server administration or IT infrastructure operations role
  • NinjaOne RMM — Demonstrated, hands-on experience with NinjaOne RMM — including patch deployment, monitoring policy configuration, alert management, remote access, and automation scripting. NinjaOne experience is a primary requirement for this role.
  • Windows Server — Strong proficiency in Windows Server administration (2016, 2019, 2022, 2025) — Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, DFS, file services, and server role management
  • Virtualization — Hands-on experience building, configuring, and managing virtual machines on VMware vSphere — including VM templates, snapshots, cloning, and resource allocation
  • Server Upgrades — Proven experience planning and executing server OS upgrades and hardware refresh cycles with minimal operational disruption. This will be the primary day to day focus to start the role. Focusing on eliminating legacy OS from the environment.
  • PowerShell — Strong PowerShell scripting skills — ability to write, maintain, and operationalize scripts for patching, reporting, provisioning, health checks, and task automation
  • Backup & Recovery — Working knowledge of enterprise backup platforms and restore validation procedures — experience developing and maintaining server recovery runbooks
  • Endpoint Security — Experience with server-level endpoint protection platforms — SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, or equivalent EDR — including enrollment, compliance monitoring, and alert response
  • Troubleshooting — Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills — able to independently diagnose and resolve complex Windows Server, Active Directory, and virtualization issues
  • Documentation — Strong documentation discipline — consistent creation and maintenance of runbooks, SOPs, asset records, and configuration documentation
  • Communication — Clear communicator — able to convey technical issues and status updates to IT peers and non-technical stakeholders with appropriate urgency and clarity

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with automation and DevOps practices in a server operations context — version-controlled script repositories (Git), repeatable server build processes, configuration management concepts, or CI/CD pipeline exposure applied to infrastructure workflows
  • Experience managing servers in a colocation or data center environment — remote hands coordination, rack hardware management, IPMI/iDRAC/iLO out-of-band management, and power management configuration
  • Familiarity with hybrid identity environments — Active Directory integration with Entra ID, AD Connect, and Group Policy management in hybrid configurations
  • Familiarity with ITSM platforms — ServiceNow or equivalent — for incident, change, problem, and asset management workflows
  • Experience in a manufacturing, electronics, or complex global enterprise IT environment

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate
  • VMware Certified Professional — Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV)

· CompTIA Server+

  • NinjaOne Certified Administrator (if available)
  • ITIL Foundation — IT Service Management
  • CompTIA A+ or Network+ (foundational)

What Success Looks Like in This Role

The Server Administrator is doing their job well when TTM's server estate is consistently patched on schedule, servers are healthy and monitored proactively, incidents are resolved quickly with documented root cause analysis, and operational runbooks are current and reliable. Success in this role is measured by patch compliance rates, server availability, mean time to resolution for server incidents, and the quality of documentation and automation that reduces manual effort over time. This person takes pride in a clean, well-maintained infrastructure and doesn't wait to be asked — they find the problems before the problems find the business.


#CORP


Compensation and Benefits:

TTM offers a variety of health and well-being benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401K, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, accident benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, paid vacation & holidays. Benefits are available 1st of the month following date of hire.

Compensation for roles at TTM Technologies varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience. As required by local law, TTM provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in New York, California and Colorado. For California-based roles, compensation ranges are based upon specific physical locations.

Export Statement:
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC including but not limited to: a) being able to identify ITAR product on the manufacturing floor and understand that access to these products and related technical data is restricted to only US Citizens and US Permanent Residents; b) recognition of Foreign Person visitors by badge differentiation; c) understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL); d) understand the Export and ITAR requirements for shipments leaving the US; e) manage vendor approvals for ITAR manufacturing and services.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability or protected veteran status.

  • Pensamiento crítico y resolución de problemas: distinguir síntomas de causas y proponer intervenciones sustentadas en evidencia.
  • Adaptabilidad y gestión del cambio: abordar resistencias con empatía y ajustar el acompañamiento según los aprendizajes.
  • Liderazgo servicial y orientación a resultados: crear condiciones para el desempeño, fomentar confianza y mantener el foco en el valor para el cliente y el negocio.

Habilidades técnicas esenciales

  • Dominio práctico de Scrum, Kanban y principios Lean, con capacidad para explicar su propósito y aplicarlos según las necesidades del equipo.
  • Gestión del flujo de trabajo: visualización, límites de trabajo en curso, identificación de bloqueos y reducción de tiempos de espera.
  • Manejo e interpretación de métricas como tiempo de ciclo, tiempo total de entrega, volumen de trabajo terminado, trabajo en curso y antigüedad de tareas.
  • Comprensión de métricas de resultados del producto y del negocio, para apoyar al Product Owner en la conexión entre las entregas y los objetivos.
  • Facilitación de retrospectivas, análisis de causas y experimentos de mejora con seguimiento a sus resultados.
  • Manejo de herramientas como Jira, Azure DevOps o equivalentes, para asegurar transparencia y datos confiables.
  • Comprensión del ciclo de desarrollo y puesta en producción, incluyendo pruebas, calidad y fundamentos de DevOps y entrega continua.
  • Gestión de dependencias y coordinación entre equipos en entornos de escalamiento ágil.

Formación y experiencia

  • Profesional de Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Mercadeo o carreras afines.
  • Cuatro o más años de experiencia en instituciones financieras o de servicios, con experiencia demostrable acompañando equipos ágiles.
  • Inglés avanzado.
  • Certificación Professional Scrum Master I o equivalente. Deseables certificaciones adicionales en facilitación, Kanban, liderazgo ágil o escalamiento.

Informações adicionais

Criterio clave de selección

Buscamos una persona que combine solidez metodológica con capacidad de influencia y transformación del equipo. Deberá demostrar, mediante casos reales, cómo ha mejorado la colaboración, desarrollado autonomía, abordado impedimentos y contribuido a entregas efectivas, explicando las métricas utilizadas y los resultados obtenidos.

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer
jobs.excerpt: Join Tech @ Ro to build the future of healthcare, from the ground up!
jobs.description:
Join Tech @ Ro to build the future of healthcare, from the ground up!

At Ro, we believe that when people achieve their health goals, they can achieve their life goals. The highest-leverage way to move society forward is to give people their health, and the current healthcare system isn’t built to do that. It was built to bill, not to serve patients.

We’re building a new system. One where the patient is in control. One designed from scratch for the digital age.

At Ro, technology isn’t just a function… It's core to how we deliver care. We’ve built a vertically integrated healthcare platform that connects telehealth, diagnostics, pharmacy, and logistics into a seamless, end-to-end experience for millions of patients.

…and we’re just getting started.

As part of Tech @ Ro, you’ll work on systems that operate at scale, with an opportunity to:

  • Solve complex, high-concurrency problems across a full-stack platform
  • Build and ship quickly with tight feedback loops and real-world impact
  • Own systems end-to-end, from architecture to production performance
  • Work alongside experienced operators, technical leaders, and clinicians
  • Help define how modern healthcare should be delivered

We’re a performance-driven team with a strong sense of ownership and urgency. We move fast, learn quickly, and hold a high bar for what we build, and do so with a big heart — because patients depend on it.

If you’re motivated by impact, scale, and the chance to help lead the patient revolution, come build with us.

As a Principal Product Designer, you’ll be a senior individual contributor and member of Product Design leadership responsible for raising the quality, creativity, and craft of Ro’s patient experience. You’ll lead through the work, setting a high bar for visual and interaction design, tackling ambiguous problems across the patient journey, and helping the designers around you produce their best work.

Your primary focus will be evolving Ro’s Design System into a foundation for exceptional product experiences, including how we enable AI-assisted design and development. You’ll partner closely with various partners by bringing strong creative direction, storytelling, and experimentation to the experiences that introduce people to Ro.

You’ll report to the VP of Product Design and work closely with Design, Product, Engineering, Growth, and Marketing to identify opportunities and shape what great experiences at Ro can become and propagate those improvements through the Design System.

What You’ll Do:

  • Raise the design quality across Ro: Lead through direct contribution, bringing exceptional visual craft, creative direction, and product thinking to some of our highest-impact patient experiences.

  • Lead the evolution of Ro’s Design System: Establish its vision and roadmap, evolve its visual language, and partner with Design Engineering to increase adoption and impact.

  • Shape how our Design Systems enable AI-assisted product development: Partner across Design and Engineering to ensure tools like Claude and Figma Make can leverage Ro’s systems, patterns, and standards to produce higher-quality, on-system work at greater velocity.

  • Bring creative direction to Vertical Growth: Partner with designers, Product, Growth, Marketing, and Engineering to develop compelling concepts and experiences that introduce prospective patients to Ro, communicate our value, and improve conversion.

  • Turn creative exploration into org-wide leverage: Identify new patterns and approaches through hands-on product work, then codify the strongest ideas into reusable systems that can improve across Ro.

  • Lead our hardest design problems from ambiguity through execution: Identify opportunities proactively, establish a point of view, create and iterate on concepts, and bring the organization along from early exploration through polished implementation

  • Elevate the broader Product Design org: Mentor and challenge Senior and Staff designers, provide high-quality critique and craft leadership, and help expand the team’s capabilities in visual design, storytelling, concept development, and systems thinking.

  • Partner with Product Design leadership on the future of the patient experience: Help define where Ro should push creatively, identify opportunities beyond the immediate roadmap, and establish a cohesive standard for how Ro’s products should look, feel, and behave.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Exceptional visual and interaction craft by sharing a portfolio demonstrating sophisticated use of typography, composition, hierarchy, and storytelling alongside strong product-design fundamentals.

  • 10 years of experience designing and shipping high-impact digital products across web and mobile.

  • The ability to operate as both a systems thinker and hands-on maker by defining scalable design languages and patterns while personally demonstrating what exceptional execution looks like.

  • Experience building, evolving, or driving adoption of design systems at scale with a strong point of view on how systems can increase both product quality and development velocity.

  • Strong conceptual thinking and creative-direction skills that allow you to generate compelling ideas, establish a creative point of view, communicate the thinking behind it, and guide others toward a high-quality result.

  • Experience designing consumer-facing experiences where brand, storytelling, growth, and conversion matter with an understanding of how creative quality and rigorous experimentation work together.

  • Demonstrated Principal-level leadership and influence where you proactively identify ambiguous, high-impact opportunities, align senior cross-functional partners around a direction, and raise the capabilities of experienced designers through your work, critique, and mentorship.

We welcome qualified candidates of all races, creeds, genders, and sexuality to apply.

When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. Bold

Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera. Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor.
Nuestra misión en Bold es liberar el potencial de los emprendedores. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos.

En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos.

Para más información acerca de Bold visita nuestro sitio web:

  • Realizar investigación de casos de contracargos de clientes específicos, optimizando el programa de gestión de fraude.

  • Analizar las transacciones disputadas por el titular de la tarjeta para determinar la acción; procesar un contracargo o cancelarlo.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT OUTBUILDAt Outbuild, our innovative team is on a mission to transform how the construction industry plans and executes projects.
jobs.description:
ABOUT OUTBUILD

At Outbuild, our innovative team is on a mission to transform how the construction industry plans and executes projects. Our all-in-one platform focuses on improving how construction teams manage scheduling, coordination, and communication. We apply Lean Construction and BIM principles to streamline these processes, enabling our clients—primarily in the U.S.—to work more efficiently.

Outbuild is the Scheduling Intelligence Platform built specifically for the construction industry. At its core, Outbuild prevents delays and cost overruns with AI-powered scheduling, field coordination, and portfolio visibility.

The platform combines master scheduling, short-term planning, and AI-driven insights into one connected system. By centralizing workflows and improving communication between office and field teams, Outbuild helps contractors reduce schedule risk, improve accountability, and make faster decisions across entire portfolios of projects.

We're growing quickly, and our customers are at the center of that growth. We're looking for our first Account Manager to own the renewal relationship for our company-wide customers, protect the revenue we have, and grow it at renewal.

OUR CORE VALUES:

  • Integrity: We do the right thing—even when it's hard, even when no one is looking. Our integrity builds trust with teammates, customers, and partners. It’s the foundation of how we make decisions and take action.
  • Honesty & Transparency: We communicate openly and clearly. Whether it’s sharing wins or owning mistakes, we lead with truth. Transparency keeps our team aligned, builds stronger relationships, and drives better outcomes.
  • Empathy: We take time to understand the experiences, challenges, and perspectives of others. By listening with care and responding with compassion, we build a culture where everyone feels seen, heard, and valued.
  • Innovation: We challenge assumptions and seek better ways to build. Whether it’s the tools we create or the problems we solve, we stay curious, move fast, and embrace bold ideas that move the construction industry forward.
  • Quality: We take pride in our craft. From code to communication, every detail matters. We aim for excellence in everything we deliver—because our work shapes the way others build the world.
  • Ownership: We act like owners—because we are. We step up, take accountability, and follow through. No task is too small, no problem is someone else’s. We take initiative and drive results, together.

MISSION:

  • To empower construction field teams with the best-in-class scheduling and planning software on the market—reshaping how the world builds.

VISION:

  • To become the world’s new standard platform for construction scheduling and planning—replacing the status quo and improving project outcomes across the industry.

SUMMARY

  • Location: Remote, US based
  • Reports to: VP of Sales
  • Employment type: Full-time

You will be Outbuild's first Account Manager. You will own the renewal relationship for our company-wide customers, a multi-million-dollar book with around 150 renewals each year. Your job has two parts: protect the revenue we have, and add revenue by bringing Outbuild Pro and other modules into the renewal conversation and capturing growth as our customers grow.

You will work closely with our Customer Success Managers, who drive adoption and product value. As the first person in this seat, you will also help build the function, from renewal process to account health scoring.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the Renewal Cycle

  • Manage every company-wide renewal from first conversation to signature
  • Start renewal conversations early, working from a renewal calendar that runs six months or more ahead of each contract end date
  • Negotiate pricing, term, and scope with customers and their decision makers
  • Run renewals through our HubSpot renewal pipeline and forecast them accurately each quarter

Add Revenue at Renewal

  • Position Outbuild Pro and other modules as part of the renewal conversation
  • Identify which accounts are a good fit based on usage and needs, and build the business case for adding a module
  • Capture volume growth as customers add projects and users, and build it into the renewal
  • Close module add-ons at renewal and track them in HubSpot

Protect the Base

  • Track account health and flag churn risk early, using usage and engagement signals
  • Build save plans with Customer Success for accounts marked at risk
  • Understand why customers downgrade or leave, and share what you learn

Build the Function

  • Help define the account management playbook, including renewal timelines, health scoring, and module attach plays
  • Capture customer feedback and feature requests and share them with Product
  • Keep clean, current records in HubSpot

Renewal volume is heaviest in the first half of the year, so expect Q1 and Q2 to be your busiest quarters.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 60 Days

  • Learn the product, including Pro and our other modules
  • Take ownership of the upcoming renewal calendar
  • Meet your top accounts and review every renewal due in the next two quarters

First Year

  • Meet your quarterly retention and new ARR goals
  • Establish a repeatable renewal and module attach process
  • Leave a documented playbook the next hire can use


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3 to 5 years in account management in B2B Saas - Construction Technology
  • A track record of retaining revenue on a book of business
  • Experience selling add-on modules or features to existing customers
  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence discussing pricing and contract terms
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Disciplined CRM habits (HubSpot preferred)
  • Comfort building process in a role with no existing playbook


HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

Goals are set and paid quarterly.

  • Gross revenue retention (GRR): the share of renewing ARR we keep, before any added revenue
  • New ARR: revenue added at renewal from Outbuild Pro, other modules, and volume growth
  • Renewal forecast accuracy and CRM hygiene


BENEFITS

We take pride in offering an extensive array of benefits to our team:

  • Healthcare: Blue Shield PPO: Bronze, Gold & Silver options; in-network & out-of-network tiers
  • Dental: Guardian: In-network & out-of-network coverage; annual max & coinsurance details
  • Vision: Guardian 20/20/150: Copays for exams/materials; allowances for frames & contacts
  • Basic Life: Guardian: $15,000 employer-paid benefit
  • Long-Term Disability: Guardian LTD - 60% of pre-disability earnings, up to $6,000/month
  • Work Equipment: Provided as needed
  • 401K: Employer match of 100% on the first 3% of pay you contribute, plus 50% on the next 2% (up to 4% total), with immediate full vesting. Eligibility begins after 3 months of service.
  • Parental Leave: Paternity: 1 Month | Maternity: 3 Months
  • Time Off: PTO = 25 days per year | Sick Days = 5 days per year | Birthday off


COMPENSATION

  • Base salary: $100,000 – $120,000
  • On-target earnings (OTE): $160,000 – $180,000

Variable pay is paid quarterly. About half is a retention bonus on gross revenue retention, with tiered payouts and a premium for an exceptional quarter. The other half is commission on new ARR, with a higher rate once you pass your goal.

The annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 – $120,000, depending on qualifications, experience, and location. This is a good faith estimate of the compensation we reasonably expect to pay at the time of hire. Final compensation will be determined based on individual factors including skills, experience, and geographic location. Variable compensation is governed by a written plan document.


Why Join Outbuild?

  • Direct impact on revenue at a company in a high-growth phase
  • A ground-floor opportunity to build and own the account management function
  • Clear ownership of a defined book with a clear path to add revenue
  • Close access to leadership and a team that values accountability
  • Help modernize one of the world’s largest industries
  • High ownership, high impact, low bureaucracy

🌐 Fully Remote

This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are currently hiring in the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Michigan, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, and Wisconsin.

If you’re excited about protecting and growing customer relationships, construction technology, and building a new function from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Outbuild is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value-based model in obesity treatment.

Since launching Direct-to-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Calibrate, our clinical team of nurse practitioners, nurses and doctors are at the heart of our mission to change the way the world treats weight by offering comprehensive obesity care that results in life-changing, sustainable results. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal part in delivering evidence-based, patient-centered care that integrates coaching and curriculum for lifestyle support.

We’re looking for nurse practitioners who are passionate about improving lives through a holistic approach to weight health. You'll collaborate with an interdisciplinary team, contribute to an innovative care model, and help patients achieve meaningful, lasting results.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team and help shape the future of obesity medicine through telehealth. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact in the lives of patients while working in a supportive environment as a seasonal employee working a minimum of 10 hours per week from January 2027 through April 2027.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Consistently provide a world-class level of clinical care and patient experience
  • Review patient intake and provide the initial patient interaction, including the discussion of the scientific principles of obesity and the prescription of appropriate weight loss therapy based on Calibrate clinical protocols
  • Utilize and support a detailed clinical treatment paradigm, developed and updated by the Calibrate team and specialized to support obese patients achieve weight-loss goals
  • Able to commit to at least 10 hours per week in a telehealth (remote) setting with option for up to full-time if interested
  • Follow state regulations for collaboration agreements with supervising physicians as required by each state you’re licensed to practice
  • Applicants must be available to work shifts scheduled between 8:00 am and 10 pm EST and provide a minimum of 10 hours of availability per week (up to 40 hours)

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Board-certified Nurse Practitioner (FNP, AGNP, or other relevant specialties)
  • Active, unrestricted license in AL, AR, FL, GA, KY, LA, MS, MO, SC, TN (MUST be licensed in FL or TN)
  • Demonstrated excellent written/verbal communication skills and virtual “bedside” manner

IDEAL QUALITIES

  • A clinical style that will work well with our belief that healthy, long-term, sustainable weight-loss is impossible to achieve without dedicated medical and coaching support
  • Excited to build and deliver a new model for achieving lasting weight health
  • Creative and flexible, but always puts the patient first
  • Excellent at forging successful and respectful relationships with the entire team

OUR VALUES

Members First. Always.

Every decision starts with one question - Will this improve the health and the experience of the people we serve?

Outcomes That Matter.

As a Engagement Manager at Chooose, you will partner with our enterprise customers in the aviation and energy sectors, enabling them to build and operate their SAF programs. In close collaboration with the Chooose Customer organization, you will own day-to-day relationships with our largest customers in your assigned region, supporting customers across their entire experience with the Chooose platform, from implementation to solution go-live and beyond.
This is a remote role that must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida
Alt ID: Strategic Account Manager / Client Partner / Engagement Manager / Enterprise CSM / Strategic Account Lead

What you'll do

  • Own total responsibility for a portfolio of key enterprise customers within the aviation, energy, and logistics sectors.
  • Become the expert on the customer's SAF program. Thoroughly understand the customer’s program objectives, and guide how the customer leverages the Chooose platform to reach these objectives.

  • Maintain a balanced approach and multiple perspectives. Enable commercial growth while considering Chooose's commitment to enabling long-term, high-integrity climate action.
  • Manage complex software deployments. Supported by an assigned Technical Implementation Manager and other key resources, oversee the implementation of complex decarbonization programs including a range of climate solutions from Sustainable Aviation Fuel to carbon offsets and removals.
  • Refine our playbook. Drive continuous improvement across Technical Implementation, Customer Operations, and Customer Success functions.
  • Collaborate with multiple Chooose teams to execute the operational tasks needed to achieve program objectives on time and with high quality.
  • Proactively and continually educate yourself on the carbon-related requirements and market trends impacting our customers and the sectors in which we operate.

What you bring to the table

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited institution, ideally in the hard sciences.
  • Minimum of 4 years of demonstrated success in management consulting, SaaS implementation, enterprise project management, or similar.

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will involve a practical exercise for you to show your work. You’ll receive written instructions for the exercise in advance, and we’ll then schedule a time to discuss. The third and final phase consists of a one-on-one conversation with a member of our executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring enough time to get to know one another.

jobs.excerpt: About Us:OncoveryCare is an early-stage virtual healthcare company committed to fundamentally rethinking and transforming the landscape of physical and mental healthcare for cancer survivors.
jobs.description:
About Us:

OncoveryCare is an early-stage virtual healthcare company committed to fundamentally rethinking and transforming the landscape of physical and mental healthcare for cancer survivors. Our team is composed of cancer survivors, clinicians, and experts in cutting-edge healthcare delivery. We believe that world class care after a cancer diagnosis shouldn’t end when treatment is over, and we provide an innovative, evidence-based approach to deliver patient-centered, whole-person support for survivors throughout the cancer journey.

Our vision is a world where living beyond cancer isn’t just “surviving”—it’s thriving.

A few tidbits about cancer survivorship:

  • There are over 18 million cancer survivors in the United States today—and that number is expected to grow to 26 million by 2040
  • Cancer survivors experience a range of physical and mental health side effects from treatment
  • Survivorship starts at the moment of diagnosis and continues post-treatment—we are starting in the “transitions of care” phase post-treatment, when there is often not a specialized team to take over caring for the survivor moving forward

Our Guiding Principles:

  • By survivors, for survivors: We build the survivor voice and experience into all that we do
  • Clinical integrity and rigor: We prioritize evidence-based approaches and an integrated team to deliver the highest-quality care
  • Trauma-informed care: We “meet survivors where they are” and respect their lived experience
  • Changing the status quo: We are committed to radically reinventing how cancer survivorship care is designed, delivered, and experienced
  • Transparency & inclusivity: Building a new frontier of cancer care is both hard and rewarding—everyone has a role to play, and fostering a positive and open team culture is our priority

About the Role:

At OncoveryCare, we have a firsthand understanding of the impact of cancer on one’s mental health and wellbeing, and are committed to supporting our patients with trauma-informed and evidence-based mental health care. As a Survivorship Behavioral Health Clinician, you will play a central role in the lives of our patients as they navigate the mental health challenges that can come with cancer survivorship. Through individual therapy and our collaborative care model, you will build strong and supportive patient relationships at a key moment of need for our survivors. We believe mental and physical health are intricately connected, and as our behavioral health clinician, you will work closely on patient care within our multidisciplinary team which includes survivorship MDs, NPs, care navigators and peer guides.

We prioritize equipping our clinicians with the necessary tools and resources to deliver exceptional patient care. To support this, our care team is supported by a robust clinical operations team that assists with admin and billing, custom tools to streamline care delivery and documentation, and consultation from clinical leadership. Additionally, you will have access to vetted referral partners and community resources to facilitate seamless transitions of care for your patients. You will also have an opportunity to help shape the future landscape of survivorship care through working closely with executive leadership on program delivery and patient experience.

Candidates must hold an active license in New York or Tennessee.

What You’ll Do:

  • Treatment Planning: Conduct thorough assessments to determine the mental health needs of cancer survivors and monitoring progress to adjust treatment plans as needed
  • Deliver Therapy: Administer evidence-based individualized and group survivorship therapy protocols to cancer survivors
  • Personalized Care Delivery: Collaborate closely with other members of the survivorship care team to identify and address patients’ mental health needs in the context of their individual history and unique experiences, promoting a holistic and integrated approach to survivorship care
  • Participate in Collaborative Care: Support the implementation of an innovative cancer survivorship collaborative care program (CoCM), championing the integration of mental health support within the broader care model
  • Care Planning: Support the care team in developing comprehensive care plans, providing expertise in behavioral health interventions where applicable to ensure holistic patient support
  • Education Guidance: Deliver psychoeducation to survivors and their families, utilizing evidence-based OncoveryCare educational content and cutting-edge resources on survivorship care

How You’ll Thrive:

  • Within the first 90 days,you will onboard with our clinical care team, engaging with executive leadership and healthcare providers focused on the physical and mental health of cancer survivors. You will become familiar with the OncoveryCare philosophy, technology platform and our integrated approach to survivorship, and begin conducting virtual visits with patients.
  • Within the first year,you will establish robust relationships with OncoveryCare patients and providers. You will develop proficiency in delivering individual and group therapy to survivors, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the referral partner landscape in patients' local communities. You will also provide critical insights to OncoveryCare’s leadership and clinical team, contributing to ongoing enhancement of our program delivery and protocols.
  • Long-term growth opportunity: You will have the chance to rapidly progress within a dynamic startup and play a pivotal role in the design and delivery of survivorship care programs for cancer survivors.

What You Will Need:

  • 3+ years of clinical experience treating patients in a psycho-oncology or survivorship care setting required
  • Master’s or doctorate degree in clinical psychology, counseling, or clinical social work (e.g., LCSW, LMFT, PsyD, or PhD)
  • Active LCSW or LMFT license in New York or Tennessee
  • Proficiency in therapeutic modalities including cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT)
  • Excellent communication, empathy, and active listening skills
  • Ability to independently drive work forward and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders
  • Availability for a full-time 40 hour workweek, Monday to Friday schedule

Who You Are:

  • Strong clinical focus. You’re committed to delivering excellent evidence based and trauma-informed clinical care to cancer survivors
  • Survivor-centered. Patients are your “why” for the work - you value building and maintaining meaningful relationships with cancer survivors and thinking creatively about how to improve their care
  • High EQ. You pride yourself on being a strong listener, communicator and are able to empathize with people with diverse life experiences
  • Go-getter: You’re psyched to roll-up your sleeves, get things done, and don’t mind playing a versatile role on a fast-paced team
  • Growth Mindset. You embody a spirit of continuous improvement, actively seek to enhance care programs, and are comfortable sharing insights with clinical leadership
  • Forward thinking. You are interested in fast paced, early stage health innovation and are excited by big ideas and creating impact

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental insurance
  • 401k
  • 4 weeks of paid PTO
  • Annual WFH stipend
  • Annual wellness stipend
  • Team bonding & culture stipend
  • Continued Medical Education stipend
  • Medical Malpractice Insurance coverage
  • Reimbursement for licensing & credentialing

We know that diversity makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking, and are committed to equity and inclusion. We are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encourage everyone to apply if your experience is close to what we are looking for. Senior CSMs excel at strategic communication and data-driven storytelling, tailoring their approach for business owners, executives, and internal leadership. They communicate with clarity and influence, whether guiding customers through complex workflows or preparing concise insights and recommendations for cross-functional and executive stakeholders. You will independently manage escalations, lead high-revenue renewals, and drive strategic expansion opportunities that may extend beyond the current product portfolio.

In this role, you set the standard for operational excellence. Senior CSMs influence cross-functional initiatives, mentor newer team members, and help shape the evolution of Customer Success through feedback, playbook refinement, and strategic insights.

jobs.description:
Pyramid Healthcare is dedicated to offering the highest quality of care to those we serve. A focus on client-focused care establishes our family of brands as respected leaders in addiction treatment, mental health recovery and eating disorder treatment modalities.

Pyramid Healthcare offers comprehensive behavioral healthcare defined by supportive environments that offer patients the strength they need to overcome life’s challenges. We offer behavioral healthcare services – psychiatry, addiction recovery, mental disorder treatment, etc. – that allow clients at all stages of recovery or rehabilitation to reclaim health and well-being.

Vice President of Clinical Operations

Remote Role | Remote with travel as needed to programs or for other meetings as needed
Pay Range: $110,000 – $140,000 per year
Shift: Monday - Friday 8:30am - 4:30pm or 9:00am - 5:00pm (flexible)

Executive Clinical Leadership Opportunity

The Vice President of Clinical Operations provides strategic leadership and oversight of clinical services. This role is responsible for setting and implementing the organization’s clinical strategy, ensuring high-quality and compliant care, and supporting consistent clinical standards across all programs. The VP collaborates with executive leadership to align clinical priorities with operational, regulatory, and financial goals and advances performance, outcomes, and innovation throughout the organization. For Silverline programs, the VP of Clinical Ops also has the responsibility of the programs overall clinical quality; and ensuing compliance and safety standards are met by supporting training initiatives, clinical program excellence and safety audits.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the organization’s clinical strategy to advance quality, outcomes, and operational performance.
  • Provide leadership and oversight to regional and program-level Clinical Directors to ensure consistent standards of care across all facilities.
  • Consult with the SVP and executive leadership on clinical operations, program development, risk areas, and emerging trends.
  • Lead implementation and fidelity monitoring of evidence-based practices and treatment models (e.g., ASAM, trauma-informed care).
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and accreditation requirements, including OMHSAS, DDAP, and CARF and any state accrediting bodies.
  • Guide programs through audits, licensing renewals, and regulatory corrective actions as needed.
  • Review, approve, and maintain clinical policies, protocols, and procedures to ensure consistency and regulatory alignment.
  • Monitor key clinical metrics—such as engagement, length of stay, outcomes, and readmission rates—and lead performance improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with Quality, Compliance, and Risk to establish clinical performance indicators, peer review processes, and corrective action plans.
  • Use data-driven methods to evaluate program performance and identify opportunities for improvement and growth.
  • Mentor and develop clinical leaders and interdisciplinary teams, promoting professional growth, accountability, and engagement.
  • Support training, competency assessments, and credentialing processes for clinical staff.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Finance, Business Development, and Payer Relations to align clinical priorities with organizational and financial goals.
  • Support payer negotiations and Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) initiatives to enhance reimbursement linked to measurable quality outcomes.
  • Ensure efficient and ethical utilization of clinical resources while maintaining client safety.
  • Identify emerging trends in behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, and integrated care to inform innovation and strategy.
  • Lead implementation of new clinical programs and technology solutions to improve access and outcomes.
  • Represent the organization at conferences, regulatory meetings, and external stakeholder collaborations.
  • Must exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality with regard to all company information
  • Completion of all required trainings as designated by the company and accreditation/licensing entities.
  • Travel as needed to programs or for other meetings as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Direct oversight of Regional Clinical Directors, Program Clinical Leaders, and designated interdisciplinary teams.
  • For Silverline programs, this role provides supported oversight Clinical Directors, Program Clinical Leaders, and designated interdisciplinary teams.
  • Responsible for leadership development, coaching, and performance management of clinical leadership roles.

Required Qualifications

Education, Licensure, & Experience

  • Master’s Degree in a behavioral health-related field required (e.g., Counseling, Social Work, Psychology, Nursing).
  • Licensure required LCPC (Licensed Clinical Professional Counselor) OR LCSW-C (Licensed Clinical Social Worker-Clinical)
  • 7–10 years of progressive clinical leadership experience in behavioral health or substance use disorder settings.
  • Demonstrated experience with regulatory bodies such as OMHSAS, DDAP, CARF, and other relevant licensing authorities.
  • Experience leading multi-site or multi-state clinical operations preferred.
  • Experience with payer relations, outcomes measurement, and performance improvement initiatives strongly preferred.

Job Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Advanced clinical knowledge related to behavioral health and substance use disorder treatment modalities.
  • Ability to analyze complex data and drive informed, strategic decision-making.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage competing demands.
  • Capability to lead change, motivate teams, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Ability to navigate crisis situations and exercise sound judgment.
  • Must maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to ethical and professional standards.

Physical Demands

Duties require frequent talking, hearing, and computer use. The employee may regularly sit, stand, walk, and occasionally stoop, twist, kneel, or climb stairs. The employee may be required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Vision requirements include close, distance, and peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

This role operates across clinical program settings and corporate environments. Regular travel is required. The employee must provide their own transportation. Incumbents may be exposed to behavioral health environments, including clients experiencing psychiatric or medical crises, and may encounter potential exposure to viruses, diseases, or infections.

HexCoded (hexcoded.ai) is an AI creative studio — creators and brands use our platform to produce video content end-to-end with AI: films, short dramas, and ad creatives. About the role

Sales at HexCoded is not a dialer job. Our buyers are a few dozen named companies — short-drama apps, AI-native content platforms, IP holders, music labels — and we win them with a proof piece and a direct, well-researched ask. You’ll run that machine, and you’ll build the tools that run it.
What’s the founder’s, not yours: the first call with every new buyer and the price. You’re in the room for those; after that the relationship is yours to run.

The terms, up front

  • Remote, from anywhere.
  • Full-time, 6 days a week, 6 months, starts immediately.

  • Full-time offer on completion for strong performers.

What you'll actually work on

  • Own the target account list. Research each buyer, find the right person — heads of content, commissioning, partnerships — verify contacts, keep the list ranked and honest.

What you'll bring

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Accountant who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

This position is based in LATAM for an accountant with 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience to join our finance team. Supporting a US-headquartered, NASDAQ-listed public company, you will perform accounting tasks, drive monthend close schedules under US GAAP and ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls.

What You'll Do:

  • US GAAP & Month-End Close: Execute monthly journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, cash reconciliations and variance analysis compliant with US GAAP standards; support quarterly/annual financial reviews and audits.
  • SOX Compliance & Internal Controls: Maintain audit-ready documentation and execute internal control testing in compliance with SOX 404 requirements.
  • Audit Preparation: Maintain organized documentation and supporting schedules for quarterly/annual financial reviews and audits.

What We Look For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent.
  • 2 to 4 years of progressive accounting experience. Exposure to US GAAP is a requirement; exposure to public company operations (or USheadquartered subsidiaries) is a plus.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Solid foundation in US GAAP and basic exposure to SOX compliance / internal controls framework.
  • Systems: Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Communication & Hours: Professional English fluency (written and spoken) is required; ability to work aligned with US Central time zones.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical, operational, organizational, technical, management and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to multitask and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Works well in a team environment
  • Excellent communicator
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity

About You:

  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. We will be the definitive home for next-generation superfans of music & culture. RapTV | What’s Next in Hip Hop & Culture | @rap

Controller | All Things Gaming & Entertainment | @controller

Country Hub | Country, Now | @countryhub

Company Culture

Making our ambitious vision a reality will not be easy. So we don’t hide the truth…it’s not easy to work here.
Our culture is unique and characterized by many things including but not limited to high standards, transparency, relentless accountability, a pursuit of goals & intellectual honesty (not looking good) and growth mindset.
Our company culture will evolve over time, but many of these values are fundamental to what we do and who we are and, therefore, will not change. Every day, we strive to live as closely to these values as we can, and of course, it doesn’t always happen.

The Opportunity

Joining the social team as a Social Editor means you will be servicing content to hundreds of thousands of our pre-existing audience on a daily basis, working with the other members of the social team to strategize content pieces and be a driving force in creating one of the largest Pop music brands on social. We are looking to bring on a creative individual who is very passionate about Pop music and interested in making a direct impact immediately. You’ll join a fast-moving, supportive team that celebrates experimentation and moving at the speed of culture.

Responsibilities

  • Driving Social Performance: Driving growth & engagement across @pophive’s social platforms including Instagram, TikTok, X, and Facebook
  • Content Creation: Creating, publish, & curate a minimum of 15 pieces of content per day.
  • Identifying Cultural Opportunities: Identify emerging pop culture trends, memes, and conversations — and translate them into timely, platform-native content.
  • Breaking The News: Work alongside the social team to roll out stories, breaking news, and editorial content across social throughout the day and into the night/weekend hours.
  • Community Management: Engage directly with the PopHive audience via comments, replies, and story polls to foster community connection and collect insights
  • Post Creation: Use design software like Photoshop to create formatted posts and graphics.
  • Stay On The Pulse: Monitor social media trends, industry developments, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and stay up-to-date with best practices.
  • Leverage Data To Drive Social Insights: Monitor and analyze social media metrics, such as impressions, engagement, and audience sentiment, to evaluate the effectiveness of content strategies and provide data-driven insights.
  • Support Sales Campaigns: Collaborate with sales team to roll out ad campaigns in a timely manner.

Expected Outcomes

  • 15+ Posts Per Day
  • YoY growth in community engagement.
  • QoQ social follower growth.
  • QoQ growth in social content concepts pitched.

Must Have

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing and growing social media accounts for brands or publishers.
  • Deep knowledge of core social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Facebook, Threads) and their evolving best practices.
  • Intermediate experience with graphic design skills in services such as Photoshop
  • A deep understanding of journalism guidelines, accuracy, and fact-checking standards.
  • Passionate about Pop music and fluent in intersection of current music, artists, and the pop culture landscape.
  • Strong communication skills & experience working within a team + across departments (editorial, video, design.)
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with a strong eye for grammar, tone, and voice.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Comfortable using analytics tools (e.g., Instagram Insights, Measure Studio, or similar) to inform strategy and optimize performance.
  • Positive, intuitive, and always proactive.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • A fully remote team
  • Health insurance
  • Yearly skills development budget

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Job Summary

At Bugcrowd, we handle application security assessment at an epic scale. As an Application Security Engineer (ASE) you will curate and manage the incoming security vulnerability submissions to some of the world’s biggest companies’ bug bounty programs. Here are just a few of the reasons why we are the best:

  • A tenure at Bugcrowd often means you have worked on not only one company’s security program but potentially on hundreds.
  • As an ASE at Bugcrowd you will be exposed to the Internet’s best security researchers and their cutting-edge security testing methodologies. Our ASEs quickly become technically fluent in obscure/complex XSS, SQLi, XXE, IDOR, SSTI, SSRF, and many other vulnerability types.   • You will be exposed to things outside of your comfort zone. We routinely run security programs for cars, IoT devices, embedded systems, mobile applications, and more!

An ASE is responsible for the ongoing triage and validation services of Bugcrowd managed programs. Under the direction of the Director of Technical Operations, you will take incoming submission data and curate it for validity, accuracy, and severity as well as communicate directly with Bugcrowd’s clients or researchers when additional information is required. ASEs also handle Incident Response – escalating and communicating about the highest severity bugs to clients. ASEs need to have strong knowledge of OWASP Top Ten type vulnerabilities. They also usually require a strong skill set in one scripting/development language, often to assist with the design or development of tooling for improving the triage/validation process. We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with engineering leadership, our co-founder and members of technical staff to define Tailscale's internal AI-enablement priorities and roadmap.
  • Work with the team that’s building Aperture by Tailscale – our AI gateway that we both use internally and provide as a product.
  • Build, maintain, and iterate on internal tools, workflows, and shareable practices (skills, development environments, internal tooling) that help engineers use coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi more effectively.

  • Work directly with both engineering and non-engineering teams across the company to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI to their day-to-day work — this is a support/enablement function, not a standalone product team, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built.
  • Develop infrastructure, guardrails, review practices, and documentation for the safe, secure use of AI-generated code.
  • Act as an internal advocate for effective AI practices — through documentation, internal talks, and hands-on coaching — meeting teams where they are rather than mandating a single tool or workflow.
  • Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on engineering velocity and quality, and report back to leadership.
  • Expect the day-to-day to span hands-on building, internal teaching/evangelism, and prioritization — on a team this size, you'll move between all three regularly.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use
  • Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation
  • Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling
  • A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate
  • Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team
  • Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling
  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents
  • Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python

  • Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption

What you'll bring

  • You already build things with AI. Not a chat tab you ask questions in. Actual work. You do need to have used AI to save yourself real time, and be able to show us what you made.
  • Short, clear writing. Most of what you make is a few words a stranger reads once and judges us on.
