Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking an Account Director to support accounts in need of and in support of a broad spectrum of communications infrastructure and sell into the financial services and large banking enterprise vertical. The Account Director is responsible to achieve sales and revenue growth targets through consistent account management & hunting activities, meet monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals set by the leadership team through aggressive selling. The ideal candidate has the ability to work on large, complex deals applying a consultative and trusted advisor approach.

Location: This remote work position will consider applicants in the following metro cities: New York City metro area; Dallas, Texas; Charlotte, North Carolina.

Responsibilities:

  • Generate sales revenue by actively promoting Zayo products and services to targeted account patches.

  • Meet monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals set by the leadership team through aggressive prospecting and selling.

  • Present proposals and manage customers through the sales process.

  • Attain high Net Promoter Score results based on excellent customer support in the sales process.

  • Maintain current business relationships with customers, securing existing revenue on long-term commitments and or selling net new accounts.

  • Apply knowledge of customers, industry, and services to achieve revenue objectives.

  • Work with the current Sales team to develop account strategy, solution design, and relationship management on targeted accounts.

  • Manage a high volume of work while maintaining a high degree of responsiveness.

  • Track, analyze and report on sales performance and activities in Salesforce and other reporting tools.

  • Provide accurate and timely forecasts of sales opportunities.

  • Develop and maintain records of customer activity for reporting of sales and forecasts.

  • Provide accurate and timely information to management.

  • Coordinate closely with other departments to ensure customer satisfaction is maintained and revenue objectives met.

  • Collaboratively work as a part of a team while concurrently performing as an individual with minimal supervision.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent from four-year College; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience solution selling into large financial services / banking accounts.

  • Strong financial acumen.

  • Demonstrated success & consistency in achieving targeted sales goals.

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Exceptional customer service and relationship building / maintaining skills.

  • Thorough understanding of account management & the strategic selling process.

  • Effective problem solving and interpersonal skills.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Salesforce a plus.

  • Complete understanding of Zayo Networks value proposition, products and services such as Ethernet, OCN, IP transport, Dark Fiber, custom access, and colocation.

Estimated base salary range: $115,000- $140,000 USD/annually.

The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.


Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.


The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.

jobs.excerpt: About the teamAt Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience.
jobs.description:
About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above Minnesota. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need.

You Will Get To:

  • Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements.

  • Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation.

  • Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners.

  • Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations.

  • Leverage Zillow’s CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement.

  • Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently.

  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication.

  • Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions.

  • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

  • This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Federated Co-operatives Limited (FCL) is hiring a Senior HR Business Analyst/Trainer on a contract basis for our HR Transformation implementation program to help deliver software and systems training. This position is a remote opportunity and can be based across Western Canada.

  • Facilitate hands on technical training sessions for team leaders across the Co-operative Retailing System (CRS), delivered virtually or in-person to ensure accessibility and effectiveness. 

  • Plan and execute in-person workshops, managing all logistics including venue selection, travel arrangements, and catering for groups of various sizes.

  • Collaborate with the program team throughout the development process to ensure training materials are relevant, clear, and aligned with overall program goals. 

  • Continuously evaluate and refine training content to ensure it meets the evolving needs of the team and aligns with program goals.

  • Provide continued support for customers from training sessions, Go-live cutover activities, and through Payroll cycles.

Who you’ll work with:
You will work closely with the program team and will report into the Training Lead. This team strives to cultivate a culture of collaboration, relationship building and support. 

Why it matters:
We help local Co-ops grow and thrive by offering a range of professional services, including marketing, market research, information technology, human resources, accounting, risk management and business development. 

Who you are:
You are looking for a project-based role in HR Business Analysis and Training and:

  • High skill level working with MS Office.

  • Experience in HR requirements gathering and validation.

  • Excellent customer service level communication skills.

  • Well organized and efficient with time management and are resourceful without task-based direction.

  • Understand the urgency of deliverables and be able to prioritize to achieve timelines.

  • Able to work well in a virtual environment and be comfortable working with ambiguity.

  • Have 1-3 years of experience within HR Training or learning and development (a combination of relevant education and experience may be considered).

  • Bring 2+ years of strong systems training delivery experience.

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, preference in Human Resources.

  • Comfortable with both in-person and virtual technology-based learning, and able to adapt to evolving priorities.

  • Have a strong familiarity and training experience with Human Capital Management solutions, (preferably Oracle Cloud HCM and UKG Workforce Management).

  • Have provided direct support for customers during project launches/system go-lives, serving as first point of contact. 

  • Apply adult learning principles to create positive learning environments and handle sensitive situations with professionalism and care.

  • Have a valid driver's license and the ability to travel one week per month for a minimum of 12 months (2027-2028) to facilitate in-person workshops. As travel across Western Canada is expected, proximity to a major airport is considered an asset.

jobs.excerpt: Why MSI?  We thrive on solving challenges.  As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer and reinsurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs.
jobs.description:
Why MSI? We thrive on solving challenges.


As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer and reinsurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs.


We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners.


Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle.


Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better.


Title: Underwriting Director/Manager, Commercial Habitational

Direct Reports: New business and renewal underwriters

Reporting To: Program Leader, Commercial Habitational

Position Summary:


The MSI Commercial Habitational Director/Manager will own the strategic growth and profitability of our commercial habitational book, leading a team of new business and renewal underwriters and cultivate long-term relationships with key production sources across the commercial habitational market. This role sets underwriting strategy and appetite, drives new account submissions and profitable binding activity across the team, and is directly accountable for portfolio growth, rate adequacy, and loss ratio performance. The Director/Manager will build and develop underwriting talent, partner with senior leadership on product and distribution strategy, and serve as a key external face of MSI with brokers, agents, and reinsurance partners.



Principal Responsibilities:


  • Lead, manage, and develop a team of underwriters, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development, to build a high-performing habitational property underwriting function.
  • Drive the creation and growth of Commercial Habitational programs with a high degree of autonomy and decision-making authority.
  • Set underwriting strategy, risk appetite, and pricing guidelines for the commercial habitational book, and own overall portfolio growth, rate adequacy, and loss ratio results.
  • Underwrite and produce new and complex habitational accounts, including appropriate risk selection, negotiation of terms and conditions, and accurate account pricing, while providing referral and escalation authority for the broader team.
  • Monitor market trends and competitive activity, and translate that insight into underwriting guidelines, product enhancements, and go-to-market strategy that keep the organization ahead of shifts and maintain a leading market position.
  • Build and maintain senior-level relationships with key brokers, agencies, and reinsurance partners, serving as MSI's primary point of contact for strategic accounts and driving new business production across the team's territory.
  • Ensure all issued policies comply with carrier and reinsurance requirements, and partner with Legal, Compliance, and Reinsurance on treaty terms, audits, and regulatory matters affecting the book.
  • Establish and enforce underwriting guidelines, authority levels, and quality-control standards across the team to ensure guideline adherence, sound underwriting judgment, and consistent execution of underwriting processes.
  • Partner with senior leadership on business planning, budgeting, and goal-setting for the habitational property unit, and report regularly on production, profitability, and team performance against plan.

Education, Experience, Skills and Abilities Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a Business, Economics, Marketing or Engineering field, or equivalent years’ experience.
  • 10+ years of Commercial underwriting experience within an insurance carrier, MGA / program administrator, or agency / brokerage, including substantial experience underwriting large or complex accounts.
  • Significant E&S commercial underwriting experience required; habitational experience strongly preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience directly managing and developing underwriting staff, with a demonstrated track record of building high-performing teams and holding direct reports accountable to production and profitability goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to set underwriting strategy and risk appetite, and to own profit-and-loss outcomes for a book of business.
  • Ability to demonstrate a sense of urgency to resolve problems and meet broker and market expectations of service.
  • Above‑average technical aptitude with proven capability to work effectively across multiple systems, tools, and digital platforms.
  • Experience working with MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to travel approximately 1-2 times per month to visit agents, brokers, and reinsurance partners and/or attend team meetings.

Special Working Conditions:


  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate effectively with colleagues.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a remote environment, demonstrating strong self‑management and accountability.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% as needed

jobs.description:
Flow Control Group (FCG) is a leading solutions provider focused on technically oriented products and services for the flow control, fluid handling, and process and industrial automation sectors with 170 locations throughout North America. FCG’s distribution and technical expertise serve an essential function in the movement of mission-critical components to a diverse array of end markets by utilizing a unique model with over 100 distribution (brand) companies, 3,000+ suppliers and 75,000 customers, and with over 3000 employees across North America and Puerto Rico. FCG has completed more than 85 acquisitions since 2015 and today represents one of the largest and fastest-growing organizations in the industrial distribution and service provider space. FCG provides a unique atmosphere facilitating high-level collaborations by connecting like-minded professionals through our technology and operating group networks. Lastly, FCG’s equity partner, KKR, a leading global investment firm, is focused on employee engagement as a key driver in building stronger businesses. The cornerstone of their business model has been to allow all employees to take part in the benefits of ownership by granting them the opportunity to participate in the equity return alongside KKR. Beyond sharing ownership, KKR also supports employee engagement by investing in training across multiple functional areas and by partnering with the workforce to give back to the community. Position Overview Flow Control Group is seeking a highly analytical and collaborative Estimator to join our team. This vital role requires a dynamic professional who possesses a comprehensive technical understanding of all brands and technology groups owned by Flow Control Group, with a sharp focus on translating complex customer requirements into highly accurate and competitive technical proposals. As an Estimator, you will serve as the primary engine for our front-end bidding process across the FCG ecosystem. You will work closely with brand leadership, engineering teams, and external vendors to evaluate inquiries, size and select equipment, and build robust commercial bids. On a daily basis, you will collaborate with Project Managers, Inside Sales Representatives, and Strategic Account Managers to take complex technical RFQs from initial receipt through precise costing, margin analysis, and final proposal delivery. Key Responsibilities

Cross-Brand Solutions: Maintain an in-depth, comprehensive knowledge of all FCG brands, products, and technology groups to identify cross-brand integration opportunities and package holistic flow control solutions in bids. Vendor & Brand Relations: Collaborate with internal brand manufacturing units and external partners to obtain competitive pricing and accurate lead times.

Front-End Alignment: Partner daily with Inside Sales Representatives, Project Managers, and Strategic Account Managers to evaluate Request for Quote (RFQ) packages, review engineering specifications, and align on bidding strategies for high-value accounts. Hand-off Coordination: Lead seamless transition meetings to hand off successfully won bids to the Project Management team, ensuring all cost assumptions, scopes of work, and technical details are clearly communicated.

Data Sheet & P&ID Analysis: Review customer technical drawings, datasheets, P&IDs, and complex engineering specifications to ensure compliance with industry standards and customer requirements. Equipment Selection: Sizing and selecting appropriate flow control technologies (valves, actuators, pumps, instrumentation) to meet specific application parameters.

Cost Assembly: Develop highly detailed, structured cost estimates encompassing equipment, engineering, labor, testing, packaging, and freight. Technical Proposals: Draft comprehensive commercial and technical proposals that clearly outline the scope of supply, technical clarifications, deviations, and commercial terms.

Margin Protection: Apply strategic pricing methodologies to protect and optimize gross margins while ensuring bid competitiveness in the market. Risk Mitigation: Identify potential technical or commercial risks within RFQs (such as penalizing clauses or non-standard testing requirements) and incorporate appropriate contingency costs or legal deviations into the proposal.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 5+ years of experience in technical estimating, application engineering, or inside sales within the industrial flow control, fluid handling, valve automation, or instrumentation industry is strictly required.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent specialized industry experience). Technical Expertise: Strong working knowledge of various flow control technologies, equipment, and industry applications. Familiarity with sizing software and the specific product lines served by Flow Control Group brands is highly preferred.

Scope & Standards: Ability to read and interpret complex engineering bid packages, drawings, P&IDs, and international industry standards (API, ASME, ANSI, ISA).

Collaboration & Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, external vendors, and clients under tight bidding deadlines.

Analytical & Detail-Oriented: Highly organized with an exceptional eye for detail, ensuring zero-error calculations in cost sheets, pricing models, and technical compliance matrices.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, etc.). Opportunities for career advancement within a rapidly growing, industry-leading organization. A collaborative and innovative work environment with exposure to a wide variety of engineering technologies and market sectors.

We believe in the power of people with amazing ideas, tireless energy, unstoppable drive, unrelenting grit and a desire to improve our world. We endeavor to earn trust every day by being honest in our dealings and acting with integrity regardless of how hard the challenge. We speak with candor and always strive to be better tomorrow. Partnership - We aspire to be connected for life with our customers and suppliers, and we embrace the responsibility that comes with that. We know they lean on us for essential, vital and mission-critical solutions. We pride ourselves on continuous value-creation for our partners. Success - While we are many companies, we are one team. jobs.description:
Creative Strategist (Paid Social)

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm, minimum 4 hours overlap with UK GMT

Contract Type: Independent contractor

We're looking for a data-driven Creative Strategist to join our performance marketing team. If you obsess over what makes ads convert, can analyse performance data, and turn insights into winning creative briefs, keep reading.

This is not a purely creative role. It's a performance role. Data guides everything.

About Purolabs

Purolabs is a fast-growing DTC supplements brand based in the UK with over 350,000 happy customers.

We create clean, science-backed supplements that actually work. No fillers, no nasties, just real results.

Featured in Vogue, Women's Health, and Evening Standard, our UK-made products are trusted by health-conscious people who refuse to compromise on quality.

The Role

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to join our performance marketing team, with a heavy focus on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) paid social.

You'll be responsible for developing high-performing ad concepts, analysing what's working in our ad accounts, and translating data insights into creative briefs that convert. This role requires strong experience in direct-response creative, a deep understanding of buyer psychology, and the ability to work at pace.

You'll collaborate closely with our Performance Marketing Manager, designers, video editors, and UGC creators. The ideal candidate comes from a high-performing DTC brand, ideally within wellness or similar sectors.

Beyond paid social, you'll contribute to landing page strategy, brand creative direction, organic social content, and website messaging. But make no mistake, the core of this role is paid advertising performance. Everything else supports that goal.

Key Responsibilities

Paid Social Creative (Primary Focus)

  • Develop high-performing ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts for Meta paid campaigns
  • Write persuasive direct-response copy (short-form and long-form)
  • Analyse winning ads, competitor angles, creative trends, and performance data to guide new iterations
  • Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators
  • Test, iterate, and optimise creatives based on performance data
  • Apply direct-response principles and proven frameworks (AIDA, PAS, etc.) to ensure ads convert at scale
  • Follow winning structures rather than reinventing for creativity's sake
  • Present weekly creative performance reports with clear recommendations
  • Maintain and improve creative pipeline, briefs, and internal processes

Supporting Responsibilities

  • Contribute to landing page messaging and structure for paid campaigns
  • Provide creative direction for website content and product pages
  • Guide organic social content strategy to support broader brand goals
  • Ensure creative consistency across the customer journey

What We're Looking For

Essential

jobs.title: Staff Engineer / AI Builder
jobs.excerpt: We’re looking for a Staff AI Builder to lead the design and delivery of AI/ML systems.
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Staff AI Builder to lead the design and delivery of AI/ML systems. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who thrives on architectural decisions, can confidently own systems end-to-end, and contributes to technical leadership across the team.

In this role, you will work as a key technical leader on a cross-functional team, defining AI architecture, leading model development and optimization, and solving challenging integration problems. You’ll be joining real, in-flight work where reliability, security, and scalability are critical. You’ll establish engineering standards, raise the bar on how we build AI systems, and contribute to the technical decisions that shape how our AI work scales over time.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You'll Do

Agentic & GenAI Engineering

  • Design and build agentic workflows — reasoning loops, tool/function calling, and orchestration across single- and multi-agent architectures — with clear judgment on which pattern fits the problem and which doesn't
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines: chunking strategy, embeddings, vector search (OpenSearch), re-ranking, and staleness/refresh handling for dynamic knowledge sources
  • Integrate with AWS Bedrock and Agent Core, including MCP-based tool design — writing tool descriptions precise enough that an orchestrator routes correctly every time
  • Write and iterate on production system prompts — structured role framing, output constraints, and few-shot design — not just prompt tinkering
  • Build eval and observability into every agent you ship: golden datasets, RAGAS-style metrics, LLM-as-judge (as both a runtime guardrail and an offline eval), and tracing via LangFuse/LangSmith or equivalent
  • Design for LLM failure, not just LLM success: retries with backoff and jitter, circuit breakers, fallback models, and a clear user-facing story when something upstream degrades

Full-Stack & Platform Engineering

  • Build backend services in Python and Node.js, including serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) that support agentic workflows
  • Design DynamoDB single-table schemas — composite keys, transactional writes — for conversation state, agent memory, and session history
  • Support event-driven orchestration (Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge) for asynchronous agent operations, with an eye toward reliability and clean error handling
  • Contribute to frontend integration points so agentic features land cleanly for end users, and write clean, well-tested code across the stack
  • Support deployment, monitoring, and production troubleshooting in cloud-native environments (AWS, Docker), with guidance from senior engineers where needed

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Bring informed technical judgment to architecture discussions — naming the real trade-offs of a pattern (e.g., gateway centralization vs. latency, single- vs multi-agent design) rather than defaulting to what's familiar
  • Partner with product, design, and delivery leads across global teams to scope and ship features end-to-end
  • Mentor other engineers on the pod and help raise the bar on agentic engineering practices, including AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code
  • Own assigned features and releases end-to-end — including the unglamorous parts: debugging, hardening, and keeping production systems trustworthy

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful time shipping GenAI/LLM-powered systems in production — not just prototypes
  • Real, hands-on depth in agentic AI: reasoning loops, tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, and a considered point of view on when single-agent design beats multi-agent, and why
  • Practical RAG expertise: chunking strategies, embeddings, vector databases (OpenSearch or similar), cosine similarity search, and re-ranking — you can explain the mechanism, not just the terminology
  • Experience building evaluation and observability for LLM systems: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, RAGAS or comparable metrics, and tracing tools like LangFuse/LangSmith
  • Strong prompt engineering skills — you can write a production system prompt with real structure and constraints on request, not just describe the concept
  • Hands-on experience with the AWS GenAI stack: Bedrock, Agent Core, Lambda, DynamoDB (single-table design), S3, SQS, EventBridge, Step Functions
  • Strong Python and Node.js skills, with experience building full-stack applications and RESTful APIs
  • Solid understanding of production reliability patterns for LLM-backed systems: retries/backoff, circuit breakers, fallback models — as a bundle, not a single tactic
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud-native deployment
  • Comfort owning ambiguous, integration-heavy problems, and the ability to go a level deeper when someone pushes on your answer instead of staying abstract

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Direct experience with Amazon Bedrock Agent Core — agent registration, MCP tool wiring, memory/session management, gateway provisioning
  • Experience in a regulated or high-stakes domain (education, healthcare, financial services) where evaluation rigor and reliability carry real consequences
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Step Functions, Sequencer, or similar state-machine-based systems
  • A point of view on LLM observability tooling, gained from actually running it in production rather than reading about it

  • Provides feedback to leadership on opportunities to improve appropriate level of care and medically necessity based on clinical policies and guidelines
  • Reviews member’s transfer or discharge plans to ensure a timely discharge between levels of care and facilities
  • Collaborates with care management on referral of members as appropriate
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Clinical knowledge and ability to determine overall health of member including treatment needs and appropriate level of care preferred.

jobs.title: Project Director, PMO
jobs.excerpt: NAPA Safety Solutions provides industry-leading digital solutions for enhancing the safety and efficiency of ship operations, with a strong focus on the passenger ship segment.
jobs.description:
NAPA Safety Solutions provides industry-leading digital solutions for enhancing the safety and efficiency of ship operations, with a strong focus on the passenger ship segment. Our products are trusted by over 10,000 users onboard the global fleet of international cruise ships.

The solutions streamline onboard processes, simplify compliance and connect shipboard data with shoreside operations in real time. They include NAPA Stability, NAPA Logbook, NAPA Permit to Work and NAPA Checklist. We are now looking for a Project Director, PMO, to build one common way of running projects across our teams.

The role and the team

As Project Director, PMO, you are the single accountable owner of the project management practice in NAPA Safety Solutions. Your purpose is to strengthen the systematic approach to project management by defining, introducing and embedding a common way of running projects, and by making sure it is genuinely used and recognized as valuable by the people who run them.

The role starts as a supportive and enabling PMO, focused on standards, coaching and transparency, and moves toward agreed governance as maturity grows. You may also take direct project or program leadership of selected complex deliveries.

Location and work mode

The position is based in Germany and it’s 100% remote. This is a full-time, permanent position.

Your team and cooperation

You will be part of the global NAPA Safety Solutions Services team. You will work across all NAPA Safety Solutions teams involved in project delivery, and with the account teams at the front end.

You support and coach the project managers and build a community of practice. The project managers keep the accountability for their own projects. You provide portfolio-level visibility and resource load transparency to NAPA Safety Solutions leadership.

Your responsibility areas

  • The end-to-end project management process for NAPA Safety Solutions, including stage gates, decision rights, roles, responsibilities and expectations

  • Information flow across the full delivery chain: sales and account teams, project execution, service and support

  • The client communication and expectation management model across project stages

  • The project delivery toolset, templates and standards, plus portfolio-level visibility and resource load transparency for Safety Solutions leadership

  • Change management and adoption: coaching, community of practice, lessons learned and continuous improvement

  • Development of the project management capability and career path in Safety Solutions, building on the IPMA training program decided in June 2025

Your first 6-12 months

Your indicative priorities for the first 6-12 months are to:

  • Create one documented project management process, with clear steps, stage gates, responsibilities and expectations. Minimum viable first, then iterate.

  • Define and implement functioning handovers (account team to delivery, delivery to service and support) with agreed content and acceptance.

  • Agree a client communication and expectation management model for each project stage.

  • Build a small, usable set of templates (charter, plan, status, handover, closure) and basic portfolio and resource load visibility.

  • Run an adoption program: pilot projects, coaching, a project manager community and a working lessons learned loop, aligned with the IPMA training already under way.

What we expect from you

You have:

  • A Master's degree in engineering, technology, business or an equivalent field, or equivalent experience

  • At least 10 years of experience leading large, complex, multi-stakeholder projects or programs, with clear personal accountability for the outcome

  • Experience of designing and documenting a project management process (stage gates, decision rights, responsibility models) in a real organization and seeing it through to use

  • Ownership of the full project lifecycle, from pre-sales and scoping through delivery to handover into service and support

  • A track record with programs of many repeated deliveries to the same customer across multiple sites, units or vessels

  • Experience of leading projects delivered through several internal teams and subcontractors without line authority

  • Fluency in scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, resource and dependency management, and the ability to explain them in plain language

  • Experience in change management and adoption: embedding new ways of working, coaching project managers, building a community of practice and measuring adoption

  • The ability to lead without direct authority, credibility with senior technical experts, and experience with distributed, multicultural teams

  • Customer-facing and stakeholder skills at project and steering group level

Depth of project management and PMO experience is the decisive criterion.Your industry background is open: marine, maritime and class experience are useful but not required, and software, technology, engineering, industrial or regulated-industry delivery are all relevant.

It is an advantage if you have:

  • A recognized senior-level project management certification, for example IPMA Level B or A, or PMP.

  • Experience of a company transitioning from small and hands-on to larger and more structured (a strong advantage)

  • Commercial and contractual competence: scope change and variation handling, acceptance criteria, penalties

  • Project recovery experience: taking over a troubled project and bringing it back to a defensible position

  • Working knowledge of IPMA, PMI and ITIL, and familiarity with maturity models such as P3M3 or IPMA Delta

  • Experience with project and portfolio planning, resource planning and reporting tools such as Power BI or equivalent

  • Comfort working in a Microsoft 365 environment

  • A change management certification, for example Prosci, or process improvement credentials such as Lean or Six Sigma

It is also a plus if you have:

  • Hybrid delivery experience: stage-gated customer projects combined with agile product development

  • Skills in Jira and Confluence at workflow-design level

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation. You need to be located and eligible to work in Germany.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

  • You are the single accountable owner of the project management practice in NAPA Safety Solutions, responsible for both its design and its adoption.

  • The projects are, in practice, programs: NAPA Stability, NAPA Logbook, NAPA Permit to Work and NAPA Checklist rollouts across whole fleets, with high customer visibility.

  • You build on existing strengths: the people of Safety Solutions, a documented delivery and commissioning process that is in use, and IPMA training already under way.

  • You can stay close to delivery by leading selected complex deliveries yourself, both to earn credibility and to test the process in practice.

Ready to get on board and join the NAPA crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the "Apply for this job" button on the job ad page), but no later than1 November 2026. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, you can call Jan Wasastjerna (Director, Services, NAPA Safety Solutions, tel. +358 40 9220602) on Wednesday 14 October at 11.00 - 14.00 or on Thursday 22 October at 13.00 - 15.00. (CEST).

NAPA as a company and employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 240 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

With over 90% of new vessels built by NAPA customers, NAPA’s ship design software is the global de facto standard in shipbuilding. Furthermore, NAPA is a market leader in ship stability management and safety data services for passenger ships, and its cloud-based solutions for ship performance monitoring and voyage optimization support shipping’s decarbonization journey. For more information, visit.

Meaningful work

We are proud to play our part in creating a sustainable world, and a career at NAPA means working with a purpose. We focus on building the best possible products for our customers, with whom we have close and long-lasting relationships. We protect the environment and human life at sea by powering safer and greener vessels with our technology.

NAPA way of working

At NAPA, we lead and manage the company together. We help and learn from each other, while making impactful decisions for a cleaner, safer maritime industry.

At its heart, our co-leadership philosophy is founded on trust. We trust that our people are smart enough that if they make a decision, having consulted the right people, it will be good for our company. And if it's not the right decision on that occasion, that's fine too. We trust that we'll make it right, learn from the decision, and grow as a company as a result.

Enjoy working together

...is one of our core values. Learning from and respecting each other provides a healthy and pleasant working environment. We, as NAPArians, share our knowledge and help each other when needed. NAPA has offices and customers around the world, and you will be able to meet people from many different cultures. We are a diverse team with a shared goal.

Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Our AI-powered security solutions integrate advanced video analytics, machine learning, and embedded intelligence to enable proactive threat detection, enhanced situational awareness, and automated decision-making.

Reporting to the VP of AI for Motorola Solutions, the Principal Technical Program Manager - Computer Vision will be a critical, high-impact leader who thrives on turning highly ambiguous concepts into enterprise-scale Computer Vision solutions. They will be responsible for defining and driving the strategy, roadmap, and measurable success of our core Computer Vision Platform. This role is pivotal in partnering with internal product leaders to define the platform's requirements and drive the adoption of central AI models and foundational AI infrastructure across Motorola's product portfolio. This includes technical program management for our enterprise-scale cloud and edge AI platforms, ensuring our AI investments translate into quantifiable, improved customer and business outcomes. This role also includes product ownership for select end-to-end computer vision-based products.

Key Responsibilities
The Principal Technical Program Manager will own the strategy, definition, and roadmap across the following core areas, with an emphasis on the Computer Vision Platform:

  • Platform Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for the Computer Vision Platform, ensuring alignment with Motorola Solutions' overall product portfolio and strategic business goals.
  • Internal Partner Management & Alignment: Serve as the primary product leader for the platform, engaging with internal product leaders and teams across Motorola to understand their computer vision needs, define platform requirements (APIs, capabilities, scalability), and drive adoption of platform services.
  • Product Definition & Requirements: Author high-quality Market Requirements Documents (MRDs), Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), and user stories for core platform capabilities (e.g., model serving, data pipelines, edge-to-cloud synchronization) and for select end-to-end computer vision products.
  • AI Model Lifecycle Ownership: Own the product lifecycle for central, reusable computer vision models and foundational AI infrastructure, from ideation and research collaboration through deployment, adoption, and deprecation.
  • Platform Success Metrics: Define, implement, and track key business, customer, and technical metrics (e.g., platform adoption, performance, latency, cost-efficiency, and quantifiable customer outcomes) to measure the success and health of the platform and drive continuous improvement.
  • Market & Customer Insights: Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer/partner discovery along with Product Management team to identify new opportunities, validate product concepts, and inform strategic build-versus-buy decisions.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of technical program management experience, with a focus on platform products, AI/ML, or complex, cross-functional technical domains.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as an individual contributor building machine learning models, production ML pipelines, computer vision algorithms, or software engineering for ML or data-oriented products.
  • Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of computer vision and machine learning, machine learning lifecycle (MLOps), data platforms, and the challenges of building and deploying central, reusable AI infrastructure and models. Demonstrated ability to engage in technical discussions with engineering teams, understand architectural trade-offs, and define clear, measurable product requirements.
  • Product Strategy & Metrics: Proven experience defining product vision, strategy, and roadmaps. Expertise in defining and implementing metrics frameworks (KPIs, OKRs) to measure product success (adoption, revenue, customer value) and drive organizational change and accountability.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience working with AI performance metrics (e.g., Precision/Recall), real-time video processing, and inference optimization.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to operate at a Principal level, influence senior leaders across organizations, drive consensus, and communicate complex technical and strategic concepts clearly and concisely, including presenting roadmap elements and business cases.
  • Customer-focused with a track record of building strong relationships and conducting early-stage discovery to understand internal and external customer needs.
  • Domain Knowledge: Experience in video analytics for security or for retail or manufacturing operations is a plus.
  • Pathfinding: Experience bringing initial definition to "highly ambiguous" product concepts and conducting early-stage discovery for emergent initiatives.

“You know how to open doors, build trust, and close deals that matter. Ready to do that for a company whose technology helps keep critical energy infrastructure safe?”

Intero Integrity is a global provider of inspection, industrial, and environmental services for the energy industry. We build and deploy our own in-house technology and software so pipelines, and other critical assets can be inspected and maintained safely and efficiently. In practice, that means our customers trust us to tell them exactly what condition their infrastructure is in, and what to do next.

As a Sales Account Manager, you will focus on our in-line inspection (ILI) technology using robotic Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL) tools for natural gas utility customers across North America. This is a fully remote role, attached to our office in Houston Texas. We prefer candidates based in California, Nevada, or Arizona to keep time zones aligned with the team and our customer base, but strong candidates elsewhere are welcome to apply. You will report to the Manager of Global Sales, MFL Robotics.

Sales Account Managers typically work within a regional pod of roughly 2-5 people, reporting through Manager Global Sales MFL, with close day-to-day collaboration with a Business Development team. There are no direct reports to this position. Expected annual revenue will be $7M - $10M USD (2027)

What You Will Do

  • Build new relationships with natural gas utility customers and grow business from existing key accounts to hit our growth targets.

  • Map and penetrate accounts to connect with decision makers and influencers.

  • Act as the main point of contact for your customers from first conversation through project delivery.

  • Prepare proposals and financial justifications and respond to requests for quotes promptly and professionally.

  • Lead post-project review meetings to check in on client experience and satisfaction.

  • Work closely with Sales, Commercial Operations, Marketing, Business Development, Project Management, Operations, and Data Analysis to make sure every deal you close turns into a project delivered well.

  • Keep the Intero CRM (Salesforce) up to date and report progress clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Represent Intero professionally within the industry, with clients, competitors, regulators, and industry peers.

  • Every account you grow strengthens the trust our technology depends on, and every handover you manage well sets our Operations team up to deliver what you promised.

What You Bring

Must-haves:

  • ILI experienced person 3 – 5 years in this industry.

  • 3+ years of successful B2B sales experience, both winning new accounts and growing existing ones.

  • A proven ability to move prospects through a full sales process.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, both in person and virtually.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 35% of the time.

  • Comfortable working in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

  • Experience selling pipeline inspection.

Nice to have:

  • A track record selling to natural gas utilities in the USA.

  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM software.

  • A post-secondary degree or diploma.

Growth & What We Invest in You

We invest in the people who grow our accounts. You will have a clear path to build a track record in the field, along with support for relevant training and certification, along with sponsored attendance at industry conferences such as AGA or PPIM.

What We Offer

  • Base salary of $115,000–$140,000 USD, depending on experience, plus bonus.

  • 401(k) match with immediate vesting.

  • Extended healthcare coverage, including dental and vision, from day one.

  • Life insurance, AD&D, and short-term disability insurance.

  • Flexible work hours and paid time off.

  • Company credit card.

  • A technical, professional, and challenging environment where individual and team performance are both recognized and rewarded.

How to Apply

jobs.description:
Technical Delivery Manager

Fully Remote within India

Long Term Contract

Shift Timings: 2:00 pm to 11:00 pm IST

Experienced Technical Delivery Manager - lead the end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives. The Technical Delivery Manager will be responsible for translating business objectives into executable technology delivery plans, establishing delivery governance, managing dependencies and risks, and ensuring projects and programs are delivered on time, within scope, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

This role requires a strong combination of technical understanding, program/project management expertise, stakeholder leadership, and execution discipline. The candidate must be comfortable operating in a highly technical environment and working with engineering teams. A strong technical person with deep understanding of application architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  1. End-to-End Delivery Management

  • Own delivery of technology projects and programs from discovery and initiation through implementation, release, stabilization, and closure.

  • Translate business requirements and strategic objectives into actionable delivery plans.

  • Establish project objectives, milestones, deliverables, timelines, resources, and success criteria.

  • Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans across multiple technical and business workstreams.

  • Coordinate delivery across engineering, product, architecture, DevOps, infrastructure, data, security, QA, TNI, operations, and third-party teams.

  • Ensure delivery remains aligned with business priorities and expected outcomes.

  • Track progress against milestones, critical paths, dependencies, and key deliverables.

  • Drive delivery decisions and remove blockers that could impact timelines or outcomes.

2. Technical Program Leadership

  • Work closely with engineering and architecture leadership to understand technical scope, constraints, trade-offs, and delivery complexity.

  • Translate technical concepts into clear business-level communication for executives and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Understand system architecture, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, data flows, security requirements, environments, CI/CD, testing, and production operations to manage technical delivery effectively.

· Provide Architecture alignment and solution guidance.

  • Challenge estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and technical delivery plans when appropriate.

  • Facilitate technical decision-making.

  • Identify technical risks early and ensure mitigation strategies are developed and executed.

  • Coordinate cross-system and cross-team integration activities.

  • Ensure non-functional requirements such as performance, scalability, availability, security, resilience, observability, and compliance are incorporated into delivery plans.

3. Planning and Execution

  • Establish delivery methodology appropriate to the initiative

  • Build realistic delivery schedules based on team capacity, technical complexity, dependencies,

  • Manage sprint, release, milestone, and program-level planning.

  • Coordinate planning across multiple engineering teams and vendors.

  • Monitor delivery velocity, throughput, capacity, and milestone performance.

  • Identify schedule slippage and implement recovery plans.

  • Ensure delivery teams have clear priorities and understand expected outcomes.

  • Maintain accurate delivery documentation and status reporting.

4. Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management

  • Own the program-level risk, issue, assumption, action, and dependency management process.

  • Identify delivery risks proactively rather than waiting for issues to materialize.

  • Assess probability, impact, severity, and business consequences of risks.

  • Establish mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans.

  • Escalate material risks and issues at the appropriate time with clear recommendations.

  • Manage cross-team dependencies and ensure dependency owners understand required dates and commitments.

  • Track technical debt and delivery constraints that may affect future releases.

5. Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary delivery point of contact for key technology initiatives.

  • Manage expectations across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Facilitate executive-level discussions and provide concise, fact-based updates.

  • Communicate delivery status, risks, decisions, dependencies, and required actions clearly.

  • Create transparency around delivery performance and emerging challenges.

  • Resolve conflicts between teams and stakeholders constructively.

  • Establish clear governance and escalation paths.

6. TDM as Scrum Master and Technical Delivery Facilitator

The Technical Delivery Manager will apply Scrum Master practices while maintaining responsibility for effective technical delivery, cross-team coordination, and alignment with the approved solution architecture.

  • Partner with the Product Owner to translate the product vision, business objectives, and technical architecture into prioritized epics, features, user stories, technical enablers, and clear acceptance criteria.

  • Facilitate Product Backlog refinement and ensure backlog items are clear, appropriately prioritized, technically feasible, and ready for implementation.

  • Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective, and other agile delivery forums as required.

  • Guide developers and delivery teams in understanding architectural intent, technical dependencies, non-functional requirements, security requirements, implementation priorities, and expected delivery outcomes.

  • Identify, track, remove, or escalate technical and organizational impediments that affect delivery.

  • Coordinate with the Product Owner, developers, architecture, security, TNI, DevOps, QA, infrastructure, and other stakeholders to resolve dependencies and delivery risks.

  • Use sprint metrics, delivery outcomes, stakeholder feedback, and empirical evidence to improve backlog planning and delivery predictability.

7. Governance and Reporting

  • Establish appropriate delivery governance based on project size, complexity, risk, and organizational requirements.

  • Lead project/program steering committees wherever required.

  • Maintain governance documentation, decision logs, action registers, and delivery artifacts.

  • Ensure appropriate approvals and stage gates are completed.

  • Maintain delivery documentation where required.

8 . Resource Management

  • Support resource forecasting and capacity planning.

  • Identify resource constraints and negotiate appropriate allocation.

9. Release and Production Readiness

  • Own program-level release planning and coordination, including Program Increment Planning where a scaled Agile framework is used.

  • Establish release readiness criteria and checkpoints.

  • Coordinate technical, business, security, compliance, operational, and support readiness.

  • Ensure testing, defect management, deployment planning, rollback strategies, monitoring, and support processes are established.

  • Coordinate go-live planning and execution.

  • Manage hypercare and post-production stabilization.

  • Conduct post-implementation reviews and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into future delivery.

10. Quality Management

  • Ensure quality is embedded throughout the delivery lifecycle.

  • Partner with QA and engineering teams to establish appropriate testing strategies.

  • Track defects, technical issues, performance concerns, and production incidents related to the program.

  • Ensure quality gates are established before major releases.

  • Monitor quality trends and recurring issues.

  • Drive root-cause analysis where delivery or production problems occur.

11. Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, engineering collaboration, governance, and organizational efficiency.

  • Establish delivery standards, templates, playbooks, and best practices.

  • Use delivery metrics and retrospective findings to drive measurable improvement.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in technical delivery, program management, or project leadership within technology consulting, professional services, or a complex enterprise environment.

  • Strong technical understanding of solution architecture, enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data flows, security, environments, CI/CD, testing, and production operations. A strong technical person with deep understanding of application architecture.

  • Proven experience leading the end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives, from discovery and planning through implementation, release, stabilization, and closure.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives and solution architecture into delivery plans, epics, features, user stories, technical enablers, acceptance criteria, and implementation activities.

  • Proven ability to guide engineering teams, facilitate technical decision-making, challenge estimates and assumptions, and ensure delivery remains aligned with the approved architecture and technical standards.

  • Experience managing multiple technical and business workstreams involving engineering, product, architecture, security, infrastructure, DevOps, data, QA, operations, and third-party teams.

  • Strong experience managing risks, issues, assumptions, actions, dependencies, technical debt, delivery constraints, and escalation paths.

  • Demonstrated experience with Agile and Scrum delivery, including backlog refinement, Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews, Sprint Retrospectives, release planning, and continuous improvement.

  • Experience coordinating release readiness, testing, defect management, deployment planning, rollback planning, operational readiness, go-live, hypercare, and production stabilization.

  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, application lifecycle management, production support, and incident, problem, and change-management processes.

  • Experience with delivery and service-management tools such as Azure DevOps and ServiceNow, or equivalent platforms.


Nice to Have

  • Project or program management certification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, or an equivalent credential.

  • Scrum Master certification, such as PSM, CSM, or an equivalent Agile certification / Agile delivery certification or experience with scaled Agile delivery frameworks (SAFe).

  • Experience with one or more major cloud platforms, including Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Familiarity with modern solution patterns, including microservices, API-led integration, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native applications.

  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, or Site Reliability Engineering practices.

Familiarity with ITIL and IT service-management frameworks, including incident, problem, change, request, and release-management processes.

Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

  • Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.

  • Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.

  • Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

  • Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.

  • External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.

  • GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.

  • Attorney and law firm requests for evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation are completed accurately and on time, with the practice expecting effectively zero preventable errors.

  • Follow-ups, portal uploads, records requests, and outstanding tasks are consistently tracked through completion, with clear End-of-Day reporting and reliable backup coverage for scheduling and intake when needed.

We are unable to support remote international applicants or routinely sponsor work visas.

The compensation range for this job is:

$161,475.00 - $215,299.00

POSITION SUMMARY

Directs and manages the teams and programs responsible for planning, engineering, design, records accuracy, and lifecycle stewardship of network infrastructure supporting the ACS network. This role has complete ownership and accountability for Layer 1 infrastructure planning and design, including outside plant facilities, inside plant infrastructure associated with the network, fiber routes, ducts, conduits, structures, DC power capacity, rack location and availability, capacity, records, and related construction engineering. The role is also accountable for coordinating end-to-end network infrastructure plans across Layer 2 and Layer 3 domains, in partnership with the Sr. Director of IP Engineering and the Network Architects, to ensure physical infrastructure, transport, aggregation, routing, resiliency, and growth plans are aligned to business, customer, operational, and capital priorities.

The Senior Director, Network Infrastructure & Planning translates business demand, network strategy, service delivery requirements, reliability objectives, and funded project commitments into actionable infrastructure plans, budget inputs, engineering priorities, and implementation readiness. The position emphasizes accountable ownership of Layer 1 outcomes while providing shared planning accountability for Layer 2 and Layer 3 network evolution.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Essential Functions Statement(s)

  • Owns end-to-end planning and design accountability for Layer 1 network infrastructure, including OSP fiber, copper where applicable, ducts, conduits, poles, handholes, manholes, facility routes, splice plans, capacity, and physical network records.
  • Owns planning and availability accountability for inside plant infrastructure associated with the network, including DC power capacity, rack location, rack availability, physical space readiness, and related facility dependencies needed to support network growth, resiliency, and implementation readiness.
  • Ensure Layer 1 infrastructure plans support network reliability, route diversity, resiliency, serviceability, maintainability, constructability, permitting readiness, and economic utilization of facilities.
  • Oversees analysis of available and existing facilities, route constraints, capacity exhaust, customer demand, traffic growth indicators, and funded project requirements to determine new construction, rearrangements, removals, or augmentation needs.
  • Develops, maintains, and improves sustainable facilities records processes with the goal of complete, accurate, timely, and electronically accessible network records.
  • Provides shared accountability for Layer 2 and Layer 3 network planning with the Sr. Director of IP Engineering and network architects, ensuring Layer 1 infrastructure plans are coordinated with transport, aggregation, routing, peering, resiliency, and capacity strategies.
  • Partners with IP Engineering leadership and architects to translate strategic network architecture into practical infrastructure needs, including site readiness, fiber availability, route diversity, physical path constraints, equipment location requirements, and capital planning inputs.
  • Facilitates decision-making and escalation when Layer 1 infrastructure constraints affect Layer 2 or Layer 3 design alternatives, schedule, budget, resiliency, or service delivery commitments.
  • Develops budgetary inputs, capital forecasts, and business case support for approved and proposed network infrastructure projects.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

Competency Statement(s)

  • Leadership – Ability to influence others to perform their jobs effectively and to be responsible for making decisions.
  • Accountability - Ability to plan, organize, measure, and coordinate multiple tasks to deliver the budget for product line, revenue, and profit.
  • Adaptability - Ability to adapt to change in the workplace.
  • Analytical Skills - Ability to use thinking and reasoning to solve a problem.
  • Creative - Ability to think in such a way as to produce a new concept or idea.
  • Detail Oriented - Ability to pay attention to the minute details of a project or task.
  • Judgment - The ability to formulate a sound decision using the available information.
  • Problem Solving - Ability to find a solution for or to deal proactively with work-related problems.
  • Responsible - Ability to be held accountable or answerable for one’s conduct.
  • Technical Aptitude - Ability to comprehend complex technical topics and specialized information.
  • Time Management - Ability to utilize the available time to organize and complete work within given deadlines.

SKILLS & ABILITIES

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in related fields, such as Engineering, Business or Construction. Equivalent experience may be substituted for schooling on a year-for-year basis.

Experience: Twelve (12) years of telecommunications engineering/construction experience. Equivalent education may be substituted for years of experience.

Computer Skills: Demonstrated proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite, to include Word, Excel, Outlook, and Access. Demonstrated proficiency using OSP Insight and AutoCAD.

While pursuing his MBA at Wharton, Chris met his future co-founder Adam Pardes, and the two agreed – even the most engaging digital mental health apps in the world wouldn’t truly change the problem; only a solution that systematically integrated behavioral health into the full healthcare ecosystem could create meaningful change. And so they created NeuroFlow.

What We Do:

We pride ourselves on partnering with healthcare leaders to assist in driving better outcomes, lowering total cost of care, and making behavioral health risk more predictable and transparent. NeuroFlow exists to make sure no one who needs behavioral health support falls through the cracks.

We build more than just engaging digital health tools for self-care: we create platforms that identify population behavioral health risk early, engage individuals with acuity-specific resources, and enable care teams to make smarter and more efficient decisions. Together, NeuroFlow’s solutions arm healthcare organizations with the insights they need to overcome the systemic challenges in today’s healthcare ecosystem.

How We Do It:

The award-winning culture at NeuroFlow is one built around encouragement and daring to be great. Our core values have been displayed in our office since day one, and each team member is responsible for carrying out these values and keeping each other accountable to them. We succeed through our flexibility and agility, navigating and transforming an industry ripe for change where “no” or “can’t” is too often the default. NeuroFlow offers unique opportunities to work in a fun and challenging fast-paced environment with direct, meaningful impact on helping to close the divide between mental and physical health.

NeuroFlow is looking for motivated master's-level clinicians working toward full licensure in New Jersey who want more than just supervised hours — they want to develop into measurement-informed practitioners from day one.

At Quartet Medical (a NeuroFlow practice), measurement-based care isn't a checkbox. It's how we understand our patients, guide clinical decisions, and demonstrate the impact of our work. If you're someone who gets excited about tracking progress, interpreting symptom trends, and using outcomes data to inform your clinical approach, you'll thrive here.

We are offering part-time positions—with the flexibility to fit your schedule and career goals. Work entirely via telehealth from anywhere in New Jersey, and receive high-quality clinical supervision to help you build the skills and hours you need.

Even better? Once you obtain your full clinical licensure, we're committed to offering you a continuing role with NeuroFlow, allowing you to grow your career with us.
