jobs.title: Account Executive (Chicago)
jobs.excerpt: The AI-powered OS for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.
jobs.description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty,

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

The Role

We’re looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive to join our growing commercial team.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting through to closing, helping beauty and wellness businesses unlock growth through Fresha’s platform.

This is a high-impact role suited to someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building relationships from scratch, and is motivated by hitting and exceeding targets.

What You'll Do

  • Own a high-volume sales pipeline from prospecting through to close
  • Generate new business through outbound (calls, email, walk-ins) and inbound leads
  • Run efficient, tailored demos that clearly communicate value
  • Close deals quickly while maintaining a high-quality customer experience
  • Understand SMB pain points and position Fresha as a growth solution
  • Build trust with business owners and decision-makers
  • Consistently exceed monthly targets and activity metrics
  • Maintain clean pipeline management and accurate forecasting in CRM
  • Share market insights to help refine messaging and product direction
    • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What We're Looking For

    • 2+ years of experience in SMB sales, business development, or account executive roles
    • Proven ability to hit or exceed quota in a high-velocity environment
    • Strong prospecting and closing skills (you’re comfortable owning the full cycle)
    • A natural hunter who is also confident running consultative conversations
    • Excellent communication skills—especially with small business owners
    • Highly organized and able to manage multiple deals at once
    • Comfortable in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience in SaaS, marketplaces, or payments
      • Exposure to beauty, wellness, or local services industries

This Role Is a Great Fit if You

  • Enjoy high-activity, high-reward sales environments
  • Take ownership of your number and pipeline generation
  • Are motivated by closing consistently, not occasionally
  • Can balance speed with quality in customer conversations
  • You're competitive. You keep score and you want to win, but you also lift the people around you
  • You have a growth mindset. You want feedback, you act on it, and you get better every week
  • You're a self-starter. You don't need to be managed, you need to be supported and given room to perform
  • You're curious, ask great questions, and genuinely want to understand the businesses you're selling to
  • You're excited about being early.
    • Joining a rapidly scaling team means you'll have real influence on how we build and what we become.
    At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview Process

  • Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30m)
  • Skills & Experience - Virtual interview with one of our commercial leaders (45m)
  • Culture Fit - Video-call with the General Manager (30m)
  • Presentation - Interview with the Commercial leadership team (60m)
    • We aim to finalize the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
    Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

jobs.excerpt: 我们的愿景作为全球⼗⼤数字资产交易所之⼀（仍在上升🚀），我们在交易、安全 和区块链产品创新⽅⾯提供⼀流的服务体验。 我们的⽬标是让所有⼈都能参与到加密市场的建设中来，使得最前沿的、最有潜⼒的加密货币项⽬得以安全上线并交易。你有兴趣加⼊这样⼀⽀去中⼼化团队吗？ 岗位职责• 1.
jobs.description:
我们的愿景

作为全球⼗⼤数字资产交易所之⼀（仍在上升🚀），我们在交易、安全 和区块链产品创新⽅⾯提供⼀流的服务体验。
我们的⽬标是让所有⼈都能参与到加密市场的建设中来，使得最前沿的、最有潜⼒的加密货币项⽬得以安全上线并交易。你有兴趣加⼊这样⼀⽀去中⼼化团队吗？

岗位职责

  • 1. 合规产品规划与管理
  • 负责数字货币交易所合规产品的规划、设计与管理，确保平台产品符合各地法律法规与行业规范。
  • 负责分站产品的规划与管理，协同各区域团队，推动产品本地化与合规适配，满足不同市场的合规要求。
  • 2. 合规政策与法规研究
  • 持续跟踪全球主要市场的数字货币合规政策与法规变化，评估与分析对公司业务的合规风险影响。
  • 根据各国监管要求，协调内部资源，推动合规政策落地及产品调整，确保业务持续合规。
  • 3. 合规性与风控产品设计
  • 设计并优化合规功能模块，如用户身份认证、反洗钱（AML）、了解客户（KYC）等，提升平台合规性与安全性。
  • 开发并完善合规工具与系统，提升合规流程的自动化与审查效率，保障用户数据安全。
  • 4. 跨部门协作与需求管理
  • 与技术、法务、风控、运营等团队紧密协作，平衡合规要求与业务需求，推动合规性优化。
  • 独立撰写合规产品需求文档（PRD），并协调各方资源完成设计、开发与上线。
  • 5. 分站本地化与市场适配
  • 负责不同区域市场的分站产品规划与执行，依据当地合规要求进行产品调整与服务优化。
  • 与本地运营及市场团队紧密合作，了解用户需求与市场差异，推动本地化产品开发与落地。
  • 6. 合规性风险评估与监控
  • 参与平台业务的合规风险评估，制定合规性提升计划与应对策略。
  • 监控产品上线后的合规执行情况，确保持续符合各地区监管要求。
  • 7. 合规数据与报告管理
  • 设计与优化合规数据监控与报告系统，确保数据准确及时，为管理层决策提供支持。
  • 定期向管理层汇报合规产品进展、问题与优化建议，提供专业合规支持。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历，法律、金融、计算机、国际贸易等相关专业优先。
  • 2年以上互联网产品管理经验，至少1年以上合规或分站产品管理经验。
  • 熟悉数字货币行业，了解交易平台运营合规性要求及相关法规（如AML、KYC、数据保护等）。
  • 具备较强的合规风险意识，能主动识别并解决产品中的合规问题。
  • 熟悉产品全生命周期管理，能独立撰写PRD并推动产品落地。
  • 具备良好的跨部门沟通与协作能力，能与法务、风控、技术、运营团队紧密合作。
  • 英文能力优秀者优先。

Gate价值观

我们崇尚价值⾄上的原则，您的知识、愿景和⾃主性将在这⾥充分发挥， 我们专注于使⽤最好的产品和服务来赢得全球客户的赞誉，并将去中⼼化的理念带到世界各地。
我们的价值观包含正直、洞察、创新、求知与合作，在Gate我们致⼒于打造独特的Gate风格，并寻找与Gate价值观相契合的你。

我们的公司

Gate成⽴于2013年，是领先的加密货币交易所之⼀，在全球范围内提供 与多种领先数字资产交易相关的服务。Gate拥有超千万的注册⽤户，被认为是全球最安全和最可靠的加密货币平台之⼀。 Gate已经过区块链透明度验证，根据流动性和交易量 ，⼀直稳居全球⼗⼤加密货币交易所⾏列（CoinGecko）。

【岗位职责】

一、钱包账户体系

1.负责钱包账户系统的架构设计与演进，统一管理助记词、私钥、硬件、MPC、托管（Turnkey 等）、机器人钱包、保险箱等多类账户形态。

2.主导异构账户体系的融合与抽象，沉淀统一的账户模型与 Web3 ID 能力，支撑钱包及其他业务方的接入需求。

3.设计对外可接入的钱包能力，对其他业务线开放标准化的账户、签名、交易接口，避免业务方重复自建。

二、钱包核心服务

1.负责钱包核心后端服务的设计与开发，覆盖资产管理、代币列表、交易历史、上链广播、Gas 策略等关键链路。

2.负责大规模钱包数据（账户、资产、交易历史等亿级数据量）的存储设计、查询性能与版本兼容性。

3.负责钱包与中台基础能力（行情、Token、节点 RPC、资产）的集成与解耦，推动公共能力下沉、钱包业务上浮。

三、多链支持与上链

1.负责钱包多链支持的接入与维护，覆盖 EVM、Solana 及其他主流公链。

2.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障在网络拥堵、Nonce 冲突等场景下的稳定性。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理；具备亿级数据量场景下的存储设计与查询优化经验。

4.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地，具备账户、订单、资产等核心域的建模经验。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网钱包或交易系统的实战经验。

8.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、钱包专项

1.熟悉主流钱包账户体系，包括助记词 / 私钥 / 硬件钱包 / MPC / 托管钱包等的原理与差异，理解各类账户的安全模型与使用场景。

2.具备钱包后端的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过账户系统、资产模块、交易历史等核心模块的设计与落地。

3.具备多账户体系融合、抽象与对外开放能力建设的经验，或对此方向有清晰的方法论。

三、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有 MPC / TSS 钱包后端的开发经验，或熟悉 Turnkey、Fireblocks、Privy 等托管钱包方案。

2.有 AA 智能合约钱包（EIP-4337 / EIP-7702、Safe、Biconomy 等）相关的开发经验。

3.有亿级数据量下的数据迁移、版本兼容、双写切换等实战经验。

4.有钱包安全相关经验（密钥管理、签名风控、欺诈检测等）。

5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

Exciting Opportunity to be a part of Offshore Financial Services Audits

Are you an experienced audit or accounting professional ready to take your career global — without leaving home? EY is looking for talented professionals with experience in Insurance, Banking, and Wealth & Asset Management to join our Special Project Team — a uniquely focused, offshore audit practice supporting EY teams around the world.

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction, and consultancy services, we're using our expertise and systems we've developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better.

Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. If you can conﬁ dently demonstrate that you meet the criteria stated, please contact us as soon as possible.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead or be part of a global audit engagement team - virtually - working with EY teams in Europe and US sub-regions
    • Work with world-class audit tools and proprietary EY technology platforms applying the globally accepted audit methodology
  • Get an in-depth understanding of the ﬁnancial services industry and be trained by experts in the ﬁeld
    • Work full time from the comfort of your home based in Sri Lanka
    • Gain opportunities for short-term/long-term secondments or permanent relocation to offshore EY ofﬁces, if you’re a high performer

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Performing complex and speciﬁc audit procedures, while developing effective, client-focused audit strategies
    • Plan, conduct and manage audit and assurance engagements in accordance with relevant international accounting and auditing

standards

  • Proactively building relationships that support our ability to provide tailored services that meet a wide range of assurance needs and contribute to new business development
    • Prioritize and handle multiple assignments in challenging environments

Skills and Attributes for Success:

  • Strong leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in audit and assurance services, having used audit software applications
  • A passion for delivering exceptional client service

What Working at EY Offers:

  • Growth and learning opportunities

• Flexible working arrangements

  • Global exposure

• Purpose-led work

What’s in it for you?

We offer a ﬁxed term employment opportunity while supporting the completion of your training requirements with leading professional body such as CASL or ACCA.

How to Apply?

If you're driven, detail-oriented, and looking to audit global ﬁnancial giants while enjoying the ﬂexibility of remote work - this is your chance. If interested, please email your resume to including details of three non-related referees to reach us on or before 1st September 2026, stating "Special projects team Audit & Assurance" in the subject line of the email.

jobs.title: 交易引擎负责人 (Head of Trading Engine)
jobs.excerpt: 我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。 我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。 目前我们希望重构核心撮合引擎，正在寻找杰出的专业人士加入我们，我们希望你是（其中之一）： 1、大厂中负责高性能，高并发系统的 2、传统金融负责高频交易系统的（HFT 做市商、衍生品交易所、清算系统） 3、Crypto顶级交易所负责撮合引擎和高并发优化的 4、低延迟基础设施（交易所技术服务商、金融云基础设施）负责底层优化的 核心职责 • 主导新一代撮合引擎的架构设计与落地：从撮合模型、订单簿数据结构到内存管理与无锁并发，全程负责最高技术决策，对系统核心性能指标直接担责。 • 建立延迟与吞吐的极致工程标准：定义并量化 TPS、P99/P999 延迟等核心指标，通过技术手段驱动团队持续逼近物理极限，打破性能天花板。 • 构建高可用灾备与全链路故障恢复机制：设计多活架构与业务连续性方案，确保系统在极端行情冲击、硬件损坏或网络分区等极端场景下实现“零中断”。 • 搭建并领航一流工程团队：输出顶级的工程师文化，通过技术深度与工程方法论带动团队整体维度的能力升级。 理想候选人画像 • 对微、纳秒级延迟有近乎偏执的执念：你不会满足于“足够快”，而是会主动深挖 CPU 缓存行、网络协议栈底层及内核细节，寻找每一处可压榨的空间。 • 极端压力下的系统性思维者：在行情剧烈波动的毫秒级战场上，能冷静进行架构取舍与指挥协调，而非陷入被动的“救火模式”。 • 理论与实战的高度统一：既具备从零推演最优撮合模型的理论功底，也深谙真实生产环境下的工程约束，能在理想与现实间做出精妙的平衡。 • 追求卓越的参照系：见过世界顶级系统的样子，对“行业最佳”有清晰的定义，并拥有缩小差距的实战方法论。

jobs.title: 交易风控策略专家
jobs.excerpt: 岗位描述1、负责核心交易产品的风控模型与策略体系建设，覆盖事前预警、事中拦截、事后分析全链路 2、针对交易场景设计并迭代风控策略，利用高频数据识别并实时对抗价格操纵、洗单、虚假挂单、跨市场套利滥用等异常交易行为 3、基于订单簿数据、成交流水、用户持仓、资金划转等多维交易数据，进行特征工程与变量挖掘，构建交易行为风险画像 4、参与保证金风控模型建设，包括强平模型优化、爆仓预警阈值优化、穿仓风险控制等保证金风控核心模块 5、运用图计算与社区发现算法，识别协同操盘团伙、关联账户刷量等群体，结合链上资金追踪形成完整风险闭环 6、建立交易风控指标监控体系，持续跟踪市场异常信号，输出可解释的风险评估结论，支撑业务与合规决策 7、探索 AI/LLM 技术在交易风控场景的落地应用，如异常订单行为智能检测、策略规则自动推荐、风险事件归因分析 任职要求1、全日制本科及以上学历，计算机科学、统计学、数学、金融工程或相关专业；3 年以上风控模型/策略开发经验，有交易所或券商交易风控背景者优先 2、熟练掌握至少一种编程语言Python、Java、Go，具备扎实的数据处理与建模能力，能独立完成从数据清洗、特征工程到模型上线的全流程工作 3、熟悉主流机器学习模型（XGBoost、LightGBM、逻辑回归、时序异常检测等）及其在高频交易数据场景下的工程化落地 4、熟悉图数据库（Neo4j、NebulaGraph 等）及社区发现算法（Louvain、LPA 等），有关联账户识别或团伙挖掘实战经验 5、熟悉实时流处理技术（Flink、Kafka 等），具备生产级别的毫秒级风控策略落地能力，覆盖从数据预处理、特征工程、模型训练到策略应用的全流程，能够保障在极端行情或高频交易场景下实现实时风险阻断 加分项 1、熟悉TradFi 品种金融规则：熟悉股票、ETF、外汇市场的交易规则，能有效将传统合规风控模型迁移至 TradFi 风控场景。 2、AI/LLM 应用经验：有将 LLM 实际用于风控场景的真实案例（用户异常行为识别、策略自动生成、风险报告自动化）。
jobs.description:
岗位描述

1、负责核心交易产品的风控模型与策略体系建设，覆盖事前预警、事中拦截、事后分析全链路
2、针对交易场景设计并迭代风控策略，利用高频数据识别并实时对抗价格操纵、洗单、虚假挂单、跨市场套利滥用等异常交易行为
3、基于订单簿数据、成交流水、用户持仓、资金划转等多维交易数据，进行特征工程与变量挖掘，构建交易行为风险画像
4、参与保证金风控模型建设，包括强平模型优化、爆仓预警阈值优化、穿仓风险控制等保证金风控核心模块
5、运用图计算与社区发现算法，识别协同操盘团伙、关联账户刷量等群体，结合链上资金追踪形成完整风险闭环
6、建立交易风控指标监控体系，持续跟踪市场异常信号，输出可解释的风险评估结论，支撑业务与合规决策
7、探索 AI/LLM 技术在交易风控场景的落地应用，如异常订单行为智能检测、策略规则自动推荐、风险事件归因分析

任职要求

jobs.title: Sales Executive - Supply Chain Solutions
jobs.excerpt: NXTPoint Logistics provides a complete range of end-to-end supply chain solutions spanning from distribution, warehousing and fulfillment to managed logistics, transportation and final mile delivery.
jobs.description:
NXTPoint Logistics provides a complete range of end-to-end supply chain solutions spanning from distribution, warehousing and fulfillment to managed logistics, transportation and final mile delivery. It leverages broad 3PL capabilities, market-leading technology and deep vertical industry expertise to help both large and small clients reach greater levels of efficiency, service and profitability. With over 30 owned facilities, more than 3.5 million square feet of warehouse space and an extensive partner network, NXTPoint Logistics offers the broad capabilities and reach of a large 3PL company while maintaining its commitment to being the most flexible and responsive provider in the industry. Learn more at nxtpointlogistics.com.

NXTPoint is seeking a high performing Sales Executive for the Supply Chain Solutions (SCS) Line of Business. In this role you will support the strategy and vision of the SCS vertical as it relates to new business opportunities and customer diversification. This work includes establishing and nurturing new customer relationships, supporting and executing our Go-to-Market strategy, and supporting the execution of the NXTPoint Commercial Strategy.


The Sales Executive will be responsible for driving new business development within NXTPoint’s specialized logistics and 3PL solutions portfolio, with a focus on Furniture, Fixtures &Equipment (FF&E), B2B final-mile, and transportation management services. This role requires a consultative sales approach to deliver tailored solutions for Customers requiring white glove project management solutions.


This position will be reporting to the Vice President of Business Development.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan targeting customers in:
    • FF&E logistics (retail, restaurant, convenience store, healthcare, commercial projects)
    • New store openings/closures, rebranding/remodel project management, fixture rollouts, forward deployed warehouse consolidation
    • Consolidation and distribution programs/projects in the defined sectors
    • B2B Final-mile and white-glove delivery solutions
  • Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities within SCS and NXTPoint offerings
  • Conduct consultative discovery to understand complex customer needs and design tailored logistics solutions while leveraging the complete service offering of NXTPoint Logistics
  • Partner with operations and engineering teams to develop custom 3PL solutions
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including:
    • Prospecting
    • Solution design
    • Proposal development
    • Contract negotiation
    • Onboarding assistance
  • Establish and maintain strong Customer relationships through high emotional intelligence and service orientation
  • Stay informed on market trends within freight forwarding, FF&E logistics, and specialized supply chain services
  • Participate in and lead sales presentations and negotiations.
  • Meet or exceed annual individual sales goals and objectives within the prescribed time frame
  • Complete required reports in a timely and accurate manner and maintain data in the Customer Relationship Management system (Hubspot
  • Leverage sales enablement tools (Zoominfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to create prospects based on the ideal customer profile.
  • Participate in specified industry conferences on a national, regional and local basis.
  • Work closely with the Marketing Department in leading proposals, presentations, RFPs and other collateral materials, as required.
  • Work closely with Sales and Contracts team on pricing, contract terms and conditions.
  • Develop and maintain a positive and professional working relationship with all members of the team, to include customers, service partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Accept additional job assignments and participates in project work as requested.
  • Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Education & Experience:

College degree or equivalent work experience required; Minimum 3 (three) years business development experience in relevant sales role within industry; Proven track record of developing prospects and securing new Customers; Prior familiarity with freight forwarding, FF&E logistics, consolidation/distribution, final-mile B2B white glove delivery & Project/Installation Services.


Travel:

Travels to support marketplace activity and company requirements – 25%-40% travel requirements.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Demonstrated Sales and Leadership skills. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret prospective client relocation policies and contract documents. Excellent verbal and written communication skills for collaborating with prospect contacts and others as appropriate. Ability to effectively present information to senior management, prospects, and/or public groups. Highly customer service oriented/driven interpersonal skills. Ability to prioritize and re-prioritize as situations and needs change throughout the workday. Ability to multi-task and organize workflow to meet deadlines and prioritize work. Knowledge of Microsoft Office suite and related appropriate programs and software. Demonstrated ability to work across cultures. Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.


PHYSICAL/ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Physical Activity Level:

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, see clearly and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds unassisted.


Working Conditions:

Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Work is performed climate-controlled environment in an office setting with adequate ventilation.

national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

  • Write unit tests or integration tests (Vitest)

About the role

Most backend roles touching “AI” mean a chatbot bolted onto a CRUD app. This one is different: the agentic workflows are the product surface.

You’ll work on an established enterprise asset-and-metadata platform, building the AI engine that proposes metadata across the active project estate, the automated logic that reassigns or retires ownerless systems, and a live inventory of every agent and MCP server running across production and endpoint environments — all exposed through the platform API.

It’s Go on AWS, against a real production codebase with real users. A large part of the job is reading code you didn’t write, understanding how it behaves, and then extending, refactoring or decommissioning it without breaking anything.

What you’ll own

  • AI-suggested metadata engine — proposing metadata across the active project estate, then tuning it until engineers actually accept the suggestions.
  • Automated ownership reassignment and deprecation — logic that finds ownerless or relinquished systems and acts on them safely.
  • Agent and MCP inventory — complete coverage across production and endpoint environments, accessible programmatically.
  • First-party product inventory and critical-user-journey mapping — making ownership and metadata trustworthy enough to decide on.
  • Legacy refactoring and decommissioning — with unit and integration tests covering everything you ship.
  • Sprint delivery alongside program and customer teams.

Requirements — check yourself against this list

You should be able to say yes to essentially all of these:

  1. 5+ years professional backend software engineering
  2. Go as a working language — you’ve built and shipped scalable backend services and APIs in it
  3. PostgreSQL — schema design and real querying
  4. MongoDB — schema design and real querying
  5. AWS — working knowledge of the services plus their client libraries and APIs

  8. Data classification standards, dependency mapping, functional framework mapping

About Knotch

Knotch is redefining the future of websites in the age of AI.

The way people discover, engage with, and consume content is fundamentally changing. Customers now find information and make decisions through AI, increasingly with an agent acting on their behalf. Most brand digital presences were never built for this journey. Knotch is the AI-native infrastructure that closes that gap, giving brands the ability to meet every customer, and every agent, with the right experience at the right moment, and to adapt as fast as AI and consumer behavior keep changing.

Our platform combines content intelligence, measurement, and agentic AI to show enterprises what content works, continuously optimize their sites, and deliver measurable business outcomes. At the center is ACE (Agentic Content Engine), which moves brands beyond static websites toward intelligent, adaptive ones that keep improving.

We work with some of the world’s most recognizable companies. Our culture is fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly adaptable. We move quickly, test ideas, and evolve with our customers. We’re looking for exceptional people who want to help shape how leading brands show up in an AI world.

Knotch is seeking an experienced, strategic Senior Account Director to lead and grow a small portfolio of our largest and most important enterprise customers, including Fortune 500 organizations.

You will focus deeply on a handful of highly strategic relationships, developing executive partnerships, driving transformational initiatives, and identifying opportunities to significantly expand Knotch's footprint

You will also serve as the leader of a dedicated cross-functional account pod, bringing together professionals across strategy, client operations, analytics, and consulting. You will be responsible for setting direction, managing team performance, aligning priorities, and ensuring your pod delivers exceptional outcomes for customers.

  • Maintain executive visibility into progress, value delivered, risks, and future opportunities.
  • Champion new ways of working that leverage AI, automation, and Knotch's evolving capabilities to improve customer outcomes and team effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or in a related role, preferably supporting software implementations or SaaS environments.

Property Description

Davidson Hospitality Group is a dynamic and innovative hospitality management company that is constantly seeking top talent to join its team. With its headquarters located in the heart of the hospitality industry in Atlanta, Georgia, Davidson Hospitality Group is a leader in hotel and resort management, providing comprehensive and results-driven services to a diverse portfolio of properties across the United States. As a job applicant, you can expect to work in a collaborative and supportive environment that encourages creativity, growth, and professional development. With a strong commitment to excellence in guest service, employee engagement, and financial performance, Davidson Hospitality Group offers a rewarding and fulfilling career path for individuals who are passionate about the hospitality industry. Whether you are seeking a corporate role in operations, sales and marketing, revenue management, finance, human resources, or other areas, Davidson Hospitality Group offers a wide range of career opportunities for motivated and talented individuals. Join the team at Davidson Hospitality Group and be a part of a dynamic and growing organization that is dedicated to delivering exceptional hospitality experiences.

Overview

Are you a hotel marketing leader who thrives on stepping into a new environment, quickly assessing the opportunity, and making an immediate impact?

Davidson Hospitality Group is seeking a Corporate Task Force Director of Marketing to provide dedicated, hands-on marketing leadership to hotels and venues across our portfolio during periods of transition, leadership vacancies, business need, or other defined periods of support.

Serving as the property marketing leader, you’ll own the day-to-day marketing function and work closely with hotel leadership, Revenue Management, Operations, ownership, agency partners, and Davidson’s above-property marketing team to develop and execute strategies that support the hotel’s business and revenue goals.

This role is about much more than providing additional marketing resources. You’ll bring continuity, strategic direction, and hands-on execution to each assignment, ensuring the hotel’s marketing strategy remains active, relevant, and performance-driven.

This is a remote-based position with periodic travel. The expectation is for this individual to be deployed on task force assignments on a full-time basis, with individual assignments typically ranging from several weeks to several months depending on business needs. When not actively deployed to support specific hotel(s) needs, you’ll support strategic portfolio initiatives such as enterprise implementations, marketing audits, agency reviews, hotel onboarding and transitions, and other special projects.

If you enjoy variety, thrive in changing environments, and can quickly build relationships while turning strategy into action, this is an opportunity to make an impact across a diverse portfolio of hotels and resorts.

Responsibilities

As Corporate Task Force Director of Marketing, you will focus on the following:

  • Marketing Strategy & Business Leadership

    • Create, manage, and continuously enhance the marketing plan.
    • Develop integrated, omni-channel marketing strategies aligned with the hotel’s business objectives, revenue strategy, positioning, and key priorities.
    • Translate strategy into actionable marketing tactics and campaigns across the traveler journey.
    • Identify opportunities to build awareness, demand, engagement, and conversion.
    • Participate in weekly revenue management meetings and collaborate with commercial leaders to align marketing activity with business needs.
    • Participate in ownership meetings and provide clear visibility into marketing strategy, priorities, performance, and results.

    Campaign & Channel Management

    • Develop and deploy marketing tactics that support the overall marketing strategy.
    • Manage email marketing initiatives and campaigns.
    • Manage and maintain hotel websites, including updates and content optimization.
    • Manage social media channels when agency support is not in place.
    • Ensure marketing activity is coordinated across paid, earned, owned, and social channels.
    • Manage hotel assets within the VAULT and ensure content is current, relevant, and readily available for use.
    • Coordinate the development and deployment of marketing materials in partnership with internal and external resources.

    Agency & Partner Management

    • Serve as the primary hotel contact for marketing agencies and partners, including Public Relations, Paid Digital, Social Media, and other specialty partners.
    • Provide direction, priorities, and strategic context to agency partners.
    • Review agency recommendations, deliverables, and performance to ensure alignment with hotel objectives.
    • Coordinate with Davidson’s above-property marketing resources and specialty teams as appropriate.

    Activation, Community & Brand Engagement

    • Forge and maintain relevant community partnerships that support hotel and venue awareness and business objectives.
    • Partner with hotel operations to identify and execute activations, programming, promotions, and experiences that strengthen the guest experience and support commercial goals.
    • Identify opportunities to bring the hotel’s brand and positioning to life through relevant storytelling and experiences.

    Marketing Operations & Financial Management

    • Manage the hotel’s marketing budget, including expense tracking, budgeting, and forecasting.
    • Manage marketing technology, platforms, and tool integrations.
    • Maintain marketing calendars, workflows, and deployment schedules.
    • Ensure marketing initiatives are executed accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with established brand and company standards.

    Reporting & Performance

    • The Task Force Director of Marketing provides consistent visibility into marketing activity, priorities, and performance through weekly and monthly reporting.

Ready to Make an Impact?

This isn’t a traditional corporate marketing role—and that’s exactly what makes it exciting.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio, tackle new challenges, influence hotel performance, partner with talented hospitality leaders, and make a measurable impact wherever the business needs you most.

Apply today and bring your hospitality marketing expertise to hotels across the Davidson Hospitality Group portfolio.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years progressive hotel marketing experience.
  • Experience with Marriott and Soft-brands required.
  • Experience with Independents and Hilton a huge bonus.
  • 5+ years' hospitality marketing leadership experience, director level preferred.
  • Excellent understanding of paid media, website optimization, social media and email marketing concepts and best practices
  • Professional appearance and confidence.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook.
  • Experience with major Hospitality Marketing Systems and Paid Media Platforms.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills at all levels of the hotel and externally.
  • Understand and have a working knowledge of statistical data
  • Conflict management skills.
  • Able to manage and refine process to address changing business needs.
  • Time management skills. Being able to work on multiple projects with desired outcome for each.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with public, employees and ownership teams.
  • Ability to meet all deadlines internally and externally every time.
  • Experience with independent hotels, Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt is helpful but not all are required.
  • Ability to travel to support needs as needed.

Benefits

Davidson Hospitality Group is an award-winning, full-service hospitality management company overseeing hotels, restaurants, dining and entertainment venues across the US. A trusted partner and preferred operator for Hilton, Hyatt, Kimpton, Marriott, and Margaritaville, Davidson offers a unique entrepreneurial management style and owners’ mentality that provides the individualized personal service of a small company, enhanced by the breadth and depth of skill and experience of a larger company. In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value, Davidson is comprised of four highly specialized operating verticals: Davidson Hotels, Pivot, Davidson Resorts and Davidson Restaurant Group.

In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value to its owners and team members, Davidson offers a rich benefit program with a variety of benefits designed to enrich the lives and well-being of our team members and their families.

  • Multiple Tiers of Medical Coverage
  • Dental & Vision Coverage
  • 24/7 Teledoc service
  • Free Maintenance Medications
  • Pet Insurance
  • Hotel Discounts
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, bereavement, and Holidays).
  • 401K Match

Working at Davidson is like nowhere else. It’s less of a job, more of a calling. It’s part career, part revolution. Because whatever you do here, you play a part in helping redefine the way quality hospitality is delivered to our guests, our clients, our partners, and each other.EOE AA- Minorities/Females/Vet/Disability/Gender Identity/Sexual OrientationDavidson Hospitality is a drug free workplace. Please review the following job description:

The Senior Director, Agentic Engineering serves as the executive leader of Forge's agentic engineering organization and is accountable for the technical vision, engineering execution, and operational excellence behind Truist's enterprise AI agent ecosystem. This leader owns the engineering function responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating production-grade AI agents, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform how teammates and clients interact with the Firm.

This is a highly technical player-coach leadership role that combines executive organizational leadership with deep hands-on engineering expertise. The Senior Director leads the engineering function, establishes technical direction, drives work planning and execution, and serves as the ultimate escalation point for architecture and engineering decisions across the agentic engineering portfolio.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience building large-scale software and AI systems, including expertise in Python, modern systems languages such as Go, agentic frameworks, LLM orchestration, retrieval architectures, and enterprise AI platform engineering. This leader will be responsible for shipping production agentic systems, not simply defining roadmaps, ensuring all solutions meet Truist standards for security, scalability, resiliency, observability, governance, and regulatory compliance.

The Senior Director partners closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Risk, and executive leadership teams to translate business strategy into enterprise-scale AI capabilities while building and mentoring a world-class team of agentic engineers.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

1. Lead the Agentic Engineering function, providing executive leadership, organizational design, technical governance, delivery accountability, and talent leadership across all agentic engineering initiatives.
2. Own the technical direction for Forge agentic solutions, establishing architecture standards, engineering patterns, and development practices for enterprise AI agents and multi-agent systems.
3. Drive work planning, prioritization, execution management, and delivery outcomes across the agentic engineering organization, ensuring teams consistently deliver high-quality production systems aligned to business commitments.
4. Serve as the final engineering authority for architecture decisions, engineering standards, and critical code review escalations across the agentic engineering portfolio.
5. Design and govern enterprise patterns for agent orchestration, tool invocation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory management, prompt architecture, workflow automation, reasoning frameworks, evaluation pipelines, observability, and operational support.
6. Lead the engineering strategy for enterprise agent platforms including Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and other emerging agentic technologies required to support the Forge roadmap.
7. Partner with Product, Technology, Security, Risk, Architecture, and Data leaders to ensure AI solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.
8. Build and mentor a high-performing engineering organization through hiring, performance management, succession planning, coaching, career development, and technical leadership.

9. Establish and enforce engineering excellence standards including software craftsmanship, testing strategies, release management, architecture review, secure development practices, operational readiness, and reliability engineering.

10. Drive engineering execution across complex cross-functional initiatives involving application engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, cyber security, and enterprise architecture teams.

11.Champion engineering rigor through measurable quality controls, system reliability objectives, operational metrics, and continuous improvement practices.

12. Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, models, and engineering approaches, identifying opportunities to accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and strengthen enterprise capabilities

13. Represent Agentic Engineering in executive governance forums, architecture review boards, risk committees, vendor engagements, regulatory discussions, and industry working groups.

14. Manage organizational budgets, vendor relationships, workforce planning, engineering tooling investments, and resource allocation to support strategic objectives.

15. Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, engineering excellence, continuous learning, and responsible AI development across the organization

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
1. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent education, training and work-related experience.
2. Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in technology operations.
3. Broad leadership and management experience leading complex technology operations teams.
4. Proven ability to manage complex operational initiatives across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications
1. Experience leading enterprise Agentic Engineering, AI Platform Engineering, Applied AI, Intelligent Automation, or Emerging Technology organizations.

2. Deep expertise in multi-agent systems, agent orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, reasoning architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory systems, agent evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

3. Experience building production AI applications using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Agent Engine, or similar platforms.

4. Experience operating enterprise-scale AI platforms supporting thousands of users and mission-critical business processes.

5. Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI principles, AI security controls, and enterprise AI operating models.

6. Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards, mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders, and build a culture of technical excellence.

7. Experience delivering solutions across cloud-native ecosystems using Azure and modern DevOps, platform engineering, and software delivery practices.

8. Experience driving architecture modernization and transformation initiatives within large enterprises.

9. Experience in financial services, fintech, cybersecurity, or other heavily regulated industries.

10. Demonstrated participation in industry forums, technology communities, open-source initiatives, vendor partnerships, or executive technology councils.

Together, we take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment.

About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above New Mexico. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need.

You Will Get To:

  • Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements.

  • Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation.

  • Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners.

  • Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations.

  • Leverage Zillow’s CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement.

  • Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently.

  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication.

  • Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions.

  • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

  • This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license.

  • Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test – National Component with Uniform State Content.

  • Physically located in and working remotely from New Mexico.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

The mission of our client is to enable renowned media companies (e.g. BBC, Disney, Discovery, Paramount) worldwide to bring content to the viewer in the most efficient and future-proof way with the help of our broadcast management system.

To support media companies in their growth in this fast-paced media world, we deliver innovative software solutions on premise or web-based in the cloud that optimize the life cycle of their content across channels and services.

Client's Cloud Operations Team is looking for a System Administrator, who will help us further develop in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment. Are you energized by being part of a team that manages our Customer Cloud environments from A to Z together with the 1st, 2nd and 3rd line support staff?

Grab your chance!

Your challenge

  • You'll be collaborating with our Cloud Operations Team on installation/configuration, operation and maintenance of systems, middleware and software.
  • You'll be responsible for the maintenance, growth and operational performance of our Customer Cloud environments, together with our team and our external partners.
  • Your goal is to assure performance and availability by allocating the available resources and keeping your cool in emergency situations.
  • Within our ticketing system you'll be able to research root causes of incidents, develop final solutions and engage in proactive problem management by analyzing trends or historical data.

Our wishlist

Our offer

  • We offer a competitive salary, including many benefits. A health insurance, provident fund, mobile phone subscription, a bonus and 20 days of holidays are part of your package!

jobs.title: Systems Engineer III - Design
jobs.excerpt: Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale.
jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Systems Engineer III - Design 

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States 

JOB SUMMARY 

The Systems Engineer III - Design provides technical support to plan, schedule and execute design document deliverables for building automation system (BAS), electrical power monitoring system (EPMS), and software integration design projects in hyperscale data center and similar mission critical / technology sectors.    

 

This Systems Engineer III - Design will work with internal and external MEP/FP engineers, ICT engineers, equipment representatives, equipment vendors, BIM / Revit / AutoCAD production resources and client staff to ensure proper design and acceptance of Building Automation Systems.  

 

The Systems Engineer III - Design will receive general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments.  May work independently or under immediate supervision.  May serve as lead on routine projects of limited scope. 

 

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.  

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS 

Assist in Production of Building Automation Systems Engineering Documents (70%) 

  • Support designs for DDC and PLC based building automation and electrical power monitoring systems for one or more projects  
  • Support designs for controls network / system architecture including IT / OT requirements  
  • Support selection of instrumentation, sensors, actuators, valves and other field devices  
  • Support creation of and review project book and sheet specifications   
  • Support creation of and review sequence of operations  
  • Support creation of and review system diagrams and points / alarm lists 
  • Work with client IT departments to ensure safe and secure systems to meet best practices 
  • Utilize Revit software to prepare drawings and visual aids 

Construction Related Process, Deliverables and Submissions (20%)  

  • Participate in planning and execution of Construction Administration (CA) phase activities remote and on site 
  • Participate in building automation focused design reviews and page turns 
  • Participate in internal and external quality control and peer reviews 
  • Review and respond to RFIs 
  • Review shop drawings and submittals 
  • Review and complete punch lists and project close out documents 

Reporting and Communication (10%) 

  • Contribute to project communication and reporting  
  • Prepare development of project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders  
  • Manage personal hours using company tools 

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget 

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned 

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (INTERMEDIATE LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING) 

  • Knowledge of designing building automation / electrical power monitoring systems 
  • Knowledge of IoT or smart building solutions 
  • Knowledge of Revit  
  • Knowledge of Networking including Addressing, VLANs, LANs, Switches and Routers 
  • Knowledge of opensource protocols (BACnet, Modbus and SNMP)  
  • Knowledge of DDC systems including Distech, Honeywell, and Tridium Niagara  
  • Knowledge of PLC systems including Schneider Electric and Allen Bradley 
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management 
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail 
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation 
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace 
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements  
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence 
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)  
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision  
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines  
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS   

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.   

 

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is 
  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools 
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position 
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces 
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment 
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment 
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds   

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS 

  • Approximately 10%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states  
  • Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS 

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or related discipline  

OR 

  • Two years of experience with hands-on engineering, programming, testing, validation and troubleshooting of controls infrastructure 

PLUS 

  • Minimum of three years additional BAS / EPMS engineering experience 

BENEFITS

  • Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include
  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is STC's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

Smart Tech Contracting is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

STC does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to STC in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where STC has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of STC and STC will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.description:
ProcessUnity is the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) company. Our software platforms and data services protect customers from cybersecurity threats, breaches, and outages that originate from their ever-growing ecosystem of business partners. By combining the world’s largest third-party risk data exchange, the leading TPRM workflow platform, and powerful artificial intelligence, ProcessUnity extends third-party risk, procurement, and cybersecurity teams so they can cover their entire vendor portfolio. With ProcessUnity, organizations of all sizes reduce assessment work while improving quality, securing intellectual property and customer data so business operations continue to operate uninterrupted.

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Product Marketing to own how we position and message our solutions to the market. In this role, you will turn complex risk and cybersecurity concepts into clear, compelling stories that win deals and build our brand. This is primarily an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product marketing team as the function grows. The Director of Product Marketing reports to the Senior Vice President of Marketing.

What You'll Do:

  • Define product positioning and messaging across our portfolio and for each buyer persona, including CISOs, TPRM program leaders, GRC and compliance executives, and procurement
  • Partner with Product Management to plan and execute go-to-market launches for new products, features, and AI capabilities
  • Build a sales enablement program that gives our sellers and business development representatives the knowledge, talk tracks, and tools to lead with value
  • Create and maintain sales tools, including pitch decks, battlecards, solution briefs, datasheets, and demo narratives
  • Conduct ongoing market, customer and competitive analysis, and turn insights into recommendations for product and marketing strategy
  • Support analyst relations by preparing briefings, inquiries, and submissions for firms such as Gartner and Forrester
  • Develop thought leadership content, including whitepapers, guides, blogs, and webinars, in partnership with Demand Generation
  • Work with Customer Marketing to capture customer proof points, case studies, and voice-of-customer insights
  • Represent ProcessUnity at industry events, webinars, and customer meetings
  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, content creation, and enablement, and build AI-assisted workflows that let a lean team deliver at scale
  • Grow the function over time by hiring and mentoring product marketing team members as the business scales

Qualifications

  • A bachelor's degree in marketing, business administration, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of product marketing experience in B2B software, with a track record of successful product launches
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts clear and compelling
  • Proven ability to build sales enablement programs that sellers actually use
  • Strong market and competitive research skills, with a data-driven approach to positioning decisions
  • Hands-on fluency with generative AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot) and a track record of using them to work faster without sacrificing quality. Experience positioning AI-powered products preferred

  • Strong presentation skills and the confidence to represent ProcessUnity with customers and at industry events
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.com and marketing automation platforms such as Marketo
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and industry events
  • Experience working with industry analysts preferred
  • Experience in Third-Party Risk Management, cybersecurity, GRC or risk management strongly preferred

Compensation Range: $135,000 - $165,000 depending on experience

ProcessUnity is committed to providing an inclusive and equitable workplace where people of all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences can thrive. ProcessUnity is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Diretor Conservação – Amazônia Brasileira (Program Director III)
jobs.excerpt: Localização: Home office no Brasil, com preferência para a Amazônia Legal.
jobs.description:
Localização: Home office no Brasil, com preferência para a Amazônia Legal.


O Que Alcançaremos Juntos

A/O Diretora (o) Conservação é responsável por definir, liderar e responder pelos resultados estratégicos de um portfólio de programas de conservação que abrangem uma geografia ampla, complexa e/ou iniciativas de relevância nacional e global.

Exerce liderança de equipes multidisciplinares e gestores, orientando a estratégia, a priorização de iniciativas para as mudanças necessárias no bioma, a alocação de recursos, o desenho organizacional e o desenvolvimento de capacidades técnicas e gerenciais necessárias para assegurar impacto duradouro da conservação.

Específica

A Diretoria de Conservação da Amazônia Brasileira é a principal responsável por liderar e entregar as ambiciosas metas de conservação da TNC para o bioma, assegurando que os resultados sejam alcançados de forma efetiva, justa, equitativa e durável. Para isso, promove a integração entre estratégias, equipes, parceiros e investimentos, orientando a tomada de decisão e a alocação de recursos para maximizar o impacto da organização na região.

Atuaremos para promover a conservação da Amazônia Brasileira em escala, contribuindo para a proteção da biodiversidade, o combate e adaptação às mudanças climática e a construção de modelos sustentáveis de desenvolvimento para a região.

Para alcançar esses resultados, desenvolveremos e integraremos estratégias, atores, parcerias e soluções capazes de gerar mudanças sistêmicas duradouras, atuando sobre os principais fatores que influenciam a conservação e o uso sustentável dos recursos naturais na Amazônia.

Em estreita colaboração com governos estaduais e federal, consórcios, alianças, organizações representativas de povos indígenas, quilombolas, extrativistas e outras comunidades tradicionais, setor privado, produtores rurais, instituições financeiras, academia e organizações da sociedade civil, promoveremos a construção de agendas comuns, o fortalecimento de capacidades locais e a implementação de iniciativas capazes de gerar impacto de conservação em larga escala.

Também atuaremos para fortalecer políticas públicas, mecanismos financeiros, estruturas de governança e ambientes institucionais favoráveis à conservação, buscando ampliar investimentos, influenciar processos decisórios e criar as condições necessárias para a manutenção de resultados duradouros para as pessoas e a natureza.

Responsabilidades e Escopo

Gerais

Estratégia, Portfólio e Resultados

  • Definir e desdobrar a estratégia de conservação para a área sob sua responsabilidade, em alinhamento às diretrizes institucionais locais, nacionais e globais da TNC.
  • Responder pelos resultados estratégicos, indicadores de impacto e desempenho operacional dos programas e iniciativas de conservação.
  • Orientar prioridades, gerir riscos e tomar decisões estratégicas considerando cenários complexos, ambíguos e de longo prazo.
  • Garantir que ciência, dados, evidências e inovação fundamentem o desenho e a implementação das estratégias de conservação.

Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas

  • Liderar, desenvolver e avaliar gestores, coordenadores e equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo alto desempenho, accountability e desenvolvimento de talentos.
  • Definir estruturas organizacionais, papéis, responsabilidades e capacidades necessárias ao alcance dos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Promover cultura organizacional alinhada aos valores da TNC, incluindo ética, diversidade, equidade, inclusão e respeito a povos e comunidades locais.

Governança, Gestão Institucional e Orçamento

  • Supervisionar a gestão de recursos financeiros e orçamentos programáticos, assegurando uso eficiente, conformidade e sustentabilidade.
  • Garantir governança adequada dos programas, incluindo monitoramento, avaliação, aprendizagem e adaptação contínua.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com outras diretorias, gerências e áreas transversais da organização.

Parcerias, Captação de Recursos e Representação

  • Desenvolver e manter parcerias estratégicas com governos, organizações da sociedade civil, setor privado, academia, comunidades locais e financiadores.
  • Liderar ou apoiar a captação de recursos, incluindo identificação de oportunidades, relacionamento com doadores e negociações institucionais.
  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC em fóruns estratégicos, negociações e espaços de tomada de decisão relevantes.

Contexto Operacional

  • Seguir e promover o Código de Conduta e os procedimentos internos da TNC, assegurando conformidade com valores institucionais, políticas internas, requisitos legais, segurança, uso de recursos e prestação de contas.
  • Garantir a integridade, organização e confidencialidade de informações, assegurando precisão e rastreabilidade dos dados gerados no contexto dos projetos.
  • Realizar viagens nacionais e internacionais conforme necessidade programática e estratégica.
  • As atividades podem ocorrer em condições climáticas e de terreno variadas, incluindo locais remotos e fisicamente desafiadores.

Específicas

  • Liderar a implementação da estratégia e da Teoria da Mudança da Amazônia Brasileira, assegurando o alcance dos resultados e metas de conservação do bioma.
  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC junto a governos, povos indígenas, quilombolas, comunidades tradicionais, setor privado e demais atores estratégicos da região.
  • Influenciar políticas públicas, processos de tomada de decisão e mecanismos de governança relevantes para a conservação e o desenvolvimento sustentável da Amazônia.
  • Promover a articulação entre diferentes setores e parceiros para ampliar a escala, a efetividade e a durabilidade dos resultados de conservação.

O que você trará / Qualificações mínimas

  • Escolaridade mínima: Superior completo e 10 anos de experiência em gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, economia ou áreas afins.Idioma mínimo: Inglês avançado (oral e escrito).
  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de equipes gerenciais, incluindo supervisão de gestores e equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência sólida em definição de estratégias, gestão de portfólio, priorização e tomada de decisão estratégica.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de parcerias com ONGs, setor privado, grupos comunitários e/ou órgãos governamentais, negociações complexas e relacionamento com financiadores.
  • Experiência em negociações complexas.
  • Experiência em gestão financeira e orçamentária de programas de grande porte.
  • Experiência desenhando e liderando a implementação de estratégias em grandes paisagens.
  • Experiência com relações governamentais e na implementação de políticas públicas.


Qualificações desejadas

Buscamos pessoas candidatas que atendam a todas ou a parte das qualificações listadas abaixo. Mesmo que você não reúna todos os requisitos, incentivamos a que se inscreva e apresente como suas habilidades e experiências podem contribuir para esta função.

  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em práticas de desenvolvimento socioeconômico e/ou conservação, ou formação equivalente, por meio da implementação de programas complexos e com resultados de impacto mensuráveis no Brasil, em organizações do terceiro setor, setor privado, governos e/ou agências multi-laterais.
  • Experiência em influência de políticas públicas e articulação multissetorial no bioma Amazônia.
  • Experiência comprovada com finanças estruturadas, corporativas ou mais de 10 anos de atuação direta no setor privado.
  • Capacidade referência de negociações altamente complexas, mediações de conflito e representação institucional de alto nível
  • Talento gerencial comprovado em orçamento, gestão de equipe e desempenho
  • Experiência em captação de recursos.
  • Pessoa energética, criativa, com visão de futuro e altos padrões éticos.
  • Escolaridade desejada: Desejável Pós-gradução em áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma desejado: Desejável inglês fluente e bons conhecimentos em Espanhol (a função exige interações constantes, apresentações e participação ativa em eventos realizados em inglês)

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

At Young Life, our mission is to introduce adolescents to Jesus Christ and help them grow in their faith. We invite you to join us in this life-changing work, building relationships and creating spaces where young people feel seen, known, and loved.
