jobs.description:
Fully Remote | Full Time | AI Biotechnology | Supports the Founder and CEO, reports to the VP of Operations

Compensation: $125,000 to $150,000 depending on experience | West Coast hours preferred

About the Company

Our client is an AI driven biotechnology company building the data and models that help drug developers identify the best targets for their programs, accelerating the discovery of treatments for some of the hardest diseases in medicine. They move fast, think differently, and operate at the frontier of AI and biology.

The company is in a period of real growth. The team has gone from four people to twelve, the board and investors are happy with the trajectory, and a fundraise is about to kick off. This is a genuine ground floor seat at a company that is scaling right now. (Company name is shared with candidates who advance in the process.)

Position Summary

We are seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to serve as the right hand to the founder and CEO. This role is deliberately broader than a traditional executive assistant seat. It pairs high level support of the CEO with real ownership of operational functions across finance, contracts, people operations, communications, and general business operations. Roughly eighty percent of the work is professional and operational, and twenty percent is personal support.

You will be the operational center of gravity around one of the most driven leaders in the industry. The CEO does not like long meetings and communicates primarily over Slack and email, so this is not a role where someone hands you a task list. You are expected to read the room, read the thread, and know what needs to happen next.

This is not a role for someone looking to coast. The CEO operates at an extremely high standard and moves at a relentless pace. The right person is energized by that. If you are always several steps ahead and take pride in flawless execution, you will do the best work of your career here.

What Success Looks Like

You connect the dots without being handed all of them

This is the single most important quality in this role. Information will be incomplete. You will be copied on a thread with no instruction attached and be expected to work out what it means for the CEO and what you need to do about it. The best people in this seat gather the facts first, then act, rather than answering quickly and correcting later.

You are proactive rather than responsive

You are not waiting for the ask. You see the problem forming, you solve it, and the CEO learns about it after it is already handled.

You own outcomes, not tasks

The operational side of this role is yours to run. Invoices get paid, contracts get signed, vendors get answered, and the website stays current because you carry them to completion, not because someone reminded you.

You stay composed

The pace is high and the standard is exacting. You do not get flustered, you do not take directness personally, and you stay professional under pressure.

You present well

You bring the CEO clean, clear, well organized information. How you package an answer matters as much as the answer.

Executive Support

  • Act as a true extension of the CEO across both professional and personal domains.
  • Own and orchestrate a complex, constantly shifting calendar across time zones, protecting the CEO’s time and priorities. Scheduling volume in this role is heavy.
  • Manage inbox, communications, and follow ups on the CEO’s behalf with sound judgment and discretion.
  • Draft, edit, and polish emails, presentations, memos, and reports on behalf of the CEO.
  • Coordinate and run board meetings end to end, including agendas, briefing materials, and follow up action items.
  • Plan leadership offsites, investor meetings, strategic planning sessions, and team events.
  • Compile and build business development and investor slides, particularly with a fundraise starting.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel, meeting logistics, and event preparation.
  • Manage conference and speaking engagement registration and logistics, and keep the CEO’s professional network, contacts, and LinkedIn current.
  • Serve as a liaison between the CEO and internal teams, investors, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Manage confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion.

Operations Support

This is a substantial and defining part of the role. The company runs lean, so the person in this seat is a genuine operational resource for the business rather than support for one executive alone. You will work closely with the VP of Operations across the functions below.

Finance and Procurement

  • Process purchase orders and route them for approval.
  • Submit and track invoices through to payment and reconciliation, and pay bills through Ramp.
  • Support vendor management and finance workflows, keeping documentation accurate and current.

Contract Administration

  • Coordinate the routing and execution of contracts, non disclosure agreements, statements of work, and amendments.
  • Track contract status, manage reviews, and maintain organized, audit ready records.
  • Work with legal, finance, and department leads to keep everything moving on time.

People Operations and Recruiting

  • Support the company’s recruiting engine. There is no internal HR function, so this role coordinates candidate scheduling for technical searches, follows the interview protocol, and makes sure the right forms are attached to the right candidate in the applicant tracking system.
  • Run onboarding and offboarding logistics, including scheduling, documentation, and equipment.
  • Maintain people files and assist with compliance requirements.
  • Help coordinate internal communications and employee engagement.

Marketing, Communications, and Web

  • Assist with social media posting and scheduling alongside communications and marketing.
  • Update the company website, including job postings, team bios, and news items.
  • Support public relations and investor communications logistics, such as media kits and inquiries.

General Operations and Systems

  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers as needed.
  • Manage software accounts, internal documentation, and operational workflows.
  • Serve as a cross functional resource for operational questions and coordination.
  • Drive process improvement. Where something is manual and repetitive, you build the better way to do it.

Personal Support

Approximately twenty percent of the role keeps the CEO’s life running smoothly so her attention stays on the company.

  • Manage personal appointments, household tasks, and family scheduling.
  • Oversee prescription refills, medical appointments, insurance forms, reimbursement claims, and communication with healthcare providers.

About Us:

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

This position is REMOTE within US Only - Equipment provided


The Clinical Reviewer supports the WISeR Prior Authorization Program by performing comprehensive clinical reviews, validating documentation accuracy, and supporting physician determination activities in compliance with CMS requirements, WISeR guidelines, and organizational policies. This role is responsible for ensuring clinically sound, timely, and compliant prior authorization determinations.

The Clinical Reviewer combines clinical expertise with strong analytical and documentation skills while collaborating with physicians, nurses, quality teams, customer service, and technology partners. This position operates within a 24/7 review environment and plays a key role in supporting quality assurance initiatives and technology‑enabled clinical review workflows.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Clinical Review & Prior Authorization Support

  • Perform clinical reviews of prior authorization requests in accordance with CMS, WISeR, and internal policies and procedures.
  • Evaluate clinical documentation to determine medical necessity, service appropriateness, and alignment with applicable LCDs, NCDs, and coverage criteria.
  • Validate AI‑assisted review outcomes, identifying gaps, inconsistencies, or documentation deficiencies requiring escalation.
  • Prepare cases for physician review by summarizing clinical findings, identifying risks, and supporting accurate determinations.
  • Review and validate expedited prior authorization requests & prepayment reviews, ensuring urgency criteria are met, documentation supports expedited handling, and CMS turnaround time requirements are maintained.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Participate in quality assurance activities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance across clinical determinations.
  • Identify trends, documentation gaps, and recurring issues affecting review quality or outcomes.
  • Provide feedback to leadership and quality teams to support process improvement and reviewer education.
  • Assist with development, review, and adherence to clinical SOPs, Work Instructions, and review standards.

Coding & Documentation Accuracy

  • Review and interpret CPT procedure codes and ICD‑10 diagnosis codes in relation to clinical documentation.
  • Ensure accurate alignment between documentation, coding, and authorization determinations.
  • Identify documentation deficiencies and recommend corrective actions to support compliant decision‑making and audit readiness.

Operational & Cross‑Functional Support

  • Support a clinical review operation, including participation in non‑traditional scheduling as needed to ensure continuous coverage.
  • Assist with workload prioritization, expedited case handling, and operational continuity.
  • Collaborate with physicians, customer service, quality, and technology teams to meet turnaround time (TAT), service level, and quality expectations.
  • Escalate operational or clinical risks appropriately and in a timely manner.

Technology & Workflow Collaboration

  • Provide structured clinical feedback on AI‑assisted review outputs to improve model accuracy and clinical relevance.
  • Collaborate with Product and Development teams on workflow optimization, system enhancements, and clinical validation initiatives.
  • Participate in testing and validation of technology used to support clinical review and prior authorization processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Certification through either the AAPC or AHIMA - preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing clinical documentation for medical necessity and appropriateness of care.
  • Working knowledge of CPT and ICD‑10 coding.
  • Ability to apply clinical judgment within regulated utilization management or prior authorization workflows.
  • Proficiency with healthcare technology platforms and electronic clinical systems.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Coding or Auditing credential from AAPC or AHIMA

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in LCD, Medicare coverage requirements
  • Utilization management, quality assurance, audit support, or clinical validation roles.
  • Exposure to AI‑enabled clinical decision support or healthcare technology initiatives.
  • Experience working in high‑volume or highly regulated healthcare environments.

Work Requirements

  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, or holidays as operationally required.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, technology‑driven environment.
  • Strong collaboration and teamwork skills across clinical, operational, and technical teams.

Generates coding queries to physicians to clarify patient condition(s) when conflicting or ambiguous information is reflected in the patient record. Understands their role in quality performance measures and serves as a resource to the Business Office in the reconciliation and resolution of problematic accounts.

Essential Job Duties

  • Outpatient:

Required Qualifications

Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

jobs.excerpt: The Strategic Client Manager (SCM) will lead executive relationships(as an Individual Contributor) for top (Acute) enterprise clients, with deep expertise in Acute-basedrevenue cycle management services and accountability for value realization across the broader TruBridge portfolio, including the EHR and third-party solutions.
jobs.description:
The Strategic Client Manager (SCM) will lead executive relationships(as an Individual Contributor) for top (Acute) enterprise clients, with deep expertise in Acute-basedrevenue cycle management services and accountability for value realization across the broader TruBridge portfolio, including the EHR and third-party solutions. The SCM will use revenue cycle leadership experience to improve operational and financial performance while advancing EHR adoption, solution integration, and overall client outcomes.


This role is NOT a leadership position, rather this person will own client-specific success and recovery plans, drives measurable improvements across the revenue cycle and broader solution portfolio, coordinates cross-functional execution, manages escalations and risk, supports retention and growth, and ensures clients can demonstrate value from the TruBridge partnership.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop and implement client success plans with defined retention, satisfaction, risk-reduction, and growth objectives.
  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of each client’s organization and healthcare environment to strengthen strategic relationships and advance documented client outcomes.
  • Measure client satisfaction and engagement through structured feedback, executive conversations, solution adoption, service performance, and relationship indicators.
  • Create and maintain value realization reporting that demonstrates client ROI, supports executive business reviews, identifies satisfaction or adoption gaps, strengthens renewal decisions, and informs responsible growth opportunities.
  • Align qualified clients with the TruBridge reference program.
  • Own executive-level performance reviews with client financial and operational leaders, translating revenue cycle data into prioritized actions that improve cash collections, accounts receivable performance, denial outcomes, billing effectiveness, and overall financial health.
  • Lead cross-functional TruBridge Financial Health teams and subject matter experts in diagnosing client performance challenges, establishing corrective action plans, assigning clear ownership, removing barriers, and holding internal and client stakeholders accountable for timely execution and measurable results.

These goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to work dynamically within a team structure and perform other job-related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change.


All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA, and other regulations, as appropriate.


Essential Functions: In addition to working as prescribed in our performance factors specific responsibilities of this role include:


  • Proven ability to build and maintain complex client relationships, including strategic partnerships with C-suite leaders and stakeholders across client organizations.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end healthcare revenue cycle operations, including patient access, charge capture, coding, billing, claims management, denials, accounts receivable, cash collections, underpayments, write-offs, and payer or contractual performance.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience in managing operational processes and driving growth strategies.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple client priorities, focusing on common results.
  • Highly organized and efficient in time management.
  • Connected to all life cycles of client relationships, including sales, implementation, and support.
  • Develop and establish best practices for client profitability management, including invoicing, accounts receivable, cash collections, write-off processes, and contractual interactions.
  • Serve as the executive escalation point for material RCM service and performance issues, rapidly assess business impact, mobilize the appropriate operational leaders and subject matter experts, establish recovery milestones, and communicate progress through resolution.
  • Own the client relationship and overall execution for assigned clients, with direct accountability for retention, renewal readiness, client satisfaction, risk reduction, and responsible growth.
  • Maintain a disciplined client risk management process using service, financial, operational, relationship, and contractual indicators; identify emerging risks early; quantify retention and financial exposure; establish mitigation plans with accountable owners and deadlines; and escalate unresolved risks through measurable resolution.
  • Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, including appropriate upsell or cross-sell options, based on client priorities, adoption, performance, and demonstrated value; partner with sales to reach mutually beneficial agreements that protect trust, retention, and long-term growth.
  • Team-oriented, focusing on constructive feedback, process improvement, and developing best practices.

Minimum Requirements:

Education/Experience/Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field (preferred).
  • Ability to travel up to 40-60%
  • Demonstrated experience improving healthcare revenue cycle performance, with working knowledge of key measures such as cash collections, accounts receivable aging, denial performance, billing quality, and payer or contractual outcomes.
  • Proven success improving client satisfaction, protecting renewals, reducing preventable attrition, and recovering at-risk client relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify emerging client issues, establish clear resolution plans, maintain accountability across stakeholders, and follow through until risk is mitigated and the client confirms an acceptable outcome.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively, engaging the appropriate subject matter experts to resolve client needs and achieve shared outcomes.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to listen and connect the dots for client benefit.
  • Experience advising and influencing hospital CFOs, revenue cycle executives, and operational leaders on performance gaps, competing priorities, recovery plans, and financial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze revenue cycle performance trends, identify root causes of underperformance, quantify financial impact, and present clear recommendations and accountable recovery plans to client and internal leaders.
  • At least 7 years of healthcare revenue cycle experience, including at least 3 years leading client-facing RCM services, operations, performance improvement, or complex account recovery initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in strategic account management, healthcare technology, or health information systems that complements the required healthcare revenue cycle leadership background.

Individual Contributor

jobs.description:
Sr Manager, Data & Analytics


We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.


A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

The Senior Manager, Data & Analytics leads one or more teams of analysts, engineers, data scientists, and developers to deliver high-impact data insights that drive strategic business decisions. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: the Senior Manager stays close enough to the architecture and implementation to guide technical decisions, review approaches, and jump in when needed, while leading the team and translating business priorities into execution. This role involves overseeing complex operations, ensuring projects are completed on time and strategically aligned with organizational goals. The Senior Manager is expected to contribute to defining and driving the long-term strategic vision for the analytics function, and to influence senior leadership on data-driven decision-making. They collaborate with senior executives and cross-functional teams to translate overarching business strategies into large-scale analytics initiatives. The Senior Manager guides and mentors more junior managers, team leads, and data scientists, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement while establishing and scaling best practices in data management and analysis. They are accountable for setting and tracking performance metrics, driving organization-wide data initiatives, and delivering high-impact results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Additionally, they play a key role in shaping data governance policies and ensuring that analytics efforts are scalable and aligned with long-term business objectives.

Your Responsibilities on the Team

  • Lead, mentor, and develop one or more teams of data analysts, engineers, and scientists, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Foster a collaborative and innovative team culture, promoting continuous learning and professional growth.
  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of data and analytics projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and meet business requirements.
  • Prioritize and allocate resources effectively to meet project demands, balancing short-term needs with long-term strategic objectives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and translate business needs into actionable analytics projects.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment on project goals and outcomes.
  • Ensure adherence to data governance policies, standards, and regulatory requirements, maintaining the integrity and security of data.
  • Implement and enforce best practices for data management, quality, and privacy within the team.
  • Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for the team's projects and initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Provide regular updates to senior leadership on the progress and impact of analytics efforts.
  • Contribute to the strategic direction of the data and analytics function by identifying new opportunities for leveraging data to drive business value.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, applying innovative approaches to enhance the team's capabilities.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve processes, tools, and methodologies to increase the team's efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Ensure that the team's operations are streamlined and aligned with overall business priorities.


Associates in this role typically have a high degree of autonomy in managing their teams and projects. They are responsible for making decisions on resource allocation, project prioritization, and team development without needing direct supervision. While they collaborate closely with senior leadership for strategic direction and stakeholder alignment, they have the authority to shape the day-to-day operations and long-term plans of their team. This autonomy allows them to respond quickly to changing business needs and drive continuous improvement within the data and analytics function.

Your Toolbox

  • Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Certifications in data analytics, data management, or project management (e.g., Certified Analytics Professional (CAP), Project Management Professional (PMP), or relevant technical certifications) can be advantageous.
  • A strong foundation in quantitative analysis, data manipulation, and business applications of data is essential.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, data science, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in a leadership or managerial role, overseeing data teams and projects.
  • Ability to lead, mentor, and develop one or more diverse teams of data professionals.
  • Proficiency with data analytics tools, programming languages (e.g., Python, SQL), and data management platforms.
  • Proven experience in managing complex data projects, including resource allocation and timeline management.
  • Ability to translate business needs into actionable data strategies.
  • Expertise in implementing and enforcing data governance and compliance policies.
  • Strong ability to convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to derive actionable insights.
  • Ability to stay current with industry trends and adapt to changing business needs.
  • High attention to detail to ensure accuracy and quality in data outputs.

Strong Technical Experience with:

This role requires enough hands-on depth in the areas below to guide architecture decisions, review technical approaches, and contribute directly when needed.


  • Advanced Python Development: Writing clean, object-oriented, and production-grade Python code for complex data manipulation, automation, and API communication.
  • AWS Platform & Containerization:
    • Hands-on experience deploying, managing, and scaling containerized data workloads using AWS ECS (Elastic Container Service) and ECR.
    • Core AWS architecture: S3, IAM, Lambda, EC2, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail.
    • AWS Certification is a strong plus.
  • Snowflake Data Cloud:
    • Account administration, optimal virtual warehouse clustering strategies, and budget-optimization.
    • Expert feature implementation: Data Sharing, Time Travel, and Zero-copy cloning.
  • dbt (Data Build Tool):
    • Managing multi-repository dbt projects and configuring dbt Cloud environments.
    • Creating, documenting, and optimizing advanced dbt models and custom macros.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering & Data Tools:
    • Daily proficiency with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude/OpenAI APIs) to maximize development efficiency.
    • Familiarity with cloud-native AI services (e.g., Snowflake Cortex or AWS Bedrock) for embedding LLM capabilities directly inside the data layer.
    • Exposure to frameworks used for AI data preparation (e.g., LangChain, Vector Databases, or text embedding generation).
  • Data Ingestion & Integration:
    • Incremental loading and Change Data Capture (CDC) methods.
    • Extensive experience querying and integrating with complex external REST APIs.
  • Version Control & CI/CD: Advanced Git/GitHub branching strategies, pull request enforcement, and automated deployment pipelines.

Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements:

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

They specialize in managing a focused portfolio of high-value accounts, achieving quotas by building deeper relationships and understanding each account's unique business needs. Qualifications

Skilled in executing both top-down and bottom-up selling motions, effectively identifying and engaging champions and economic buyers to drive deal momentum and influence outcomes.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Member Relations Manager serves as ATI’s proactive voice of the member, identifying concerns early, coordinating timely solutions and helping prevent member attrition. Reporting to the General Manager, Member Programs, this role spends the majority of its time engaging directly with members, gathering feedback, resolving issues and closing the loop. The Manager owns ATI’s voice of member survey programs and translates recurring feedback into recommendations and programmatic improvements. This role partners closely with Coaching, Training, Peer Groups, Partnership Programs and other ATI teams to create a more responsive, consistent member experience.

Areas of Responsibility

  • Build and maintain a consistent outbound member-engagement cadence, proactively contacting members to understand their experience, surface concerns and identify emerging risks.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for member concerns, listening carefully, documenting the issue, assessing urgency and coordinating a clear path to resolution.
  • Own ATI’s voice of member survey programs, including survey planning, deployment, response follow-up, insight reporting and continuous improvement of the feedback process.
  • Track member issues, commitments and follow-up actions in detail, ensuring members receive timely updates and every concern is carried through to closure.
  • Identify patterns across individual member feedback and recommend programmatic, process or service changes when issues affect multiple members.
  • Partner with Coaching, Training, Peer Groups and Partnership Programs to resolve member needs and strengthen the consistency of the overall member experience.
  • Build productive relationships across ATI and with external partners to remove barriers, coordinate solutions and ensure accountability for member commitments.
  • Create clear reporting on member sentiment, recurring issues, attrition risks, resolution progress and opportunities for improvement.
  • Escalate high-risk or unresolved concerns to the General Manager, Member Programs with relevant context, recommended actions and a defined follow-up plan.
  • Represent ATI with energy, empathy and credibility in every member interaction, reinforcing confidence that concerns are heard, owned and acted upon.

jobs.description:
Cayenta, a division of Harris; is seeking a Consulting Manager who will lead Cayenta CIS software implementation and professional services engagements from inception through go-live and stabilization.

This role manages a team of Application Consultants (AppCons) delivering utility and municipal customer information system (CIS) implementations - spanning billing, customer service, field operations, and integrations with adjacent systems such as Customer Self-Service Portal), MWM (mobile workforce management), and ERP/financial systems. This role drives delivery methodology, provides solution oversight, ensures projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, and maintains high client satisfaction across the utility and municipal client base.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean.

Salary:

90K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

Team Leadership, Mentorship & Resource Optimization

  • Lead, mentor, and coach Application Consultants (AppCons) and project resources across all consulting tiers to achieve project and business unit objectives.
  • Provide solution oversight across multiple concurrent Cayenta CIS implementations and mentor all consultants within that portfolio, with the goal of enhancing consultant skills to deliver the best possible project outcomes.
  • Allocate and balance AppCon resources across concurrent client engagements, optimizing utilization and billable ratios while preventing burnout - particularly during peak go-live and cutover periods.
  • Foster an agile, accountable team culture focused on problem-solving, continuous learning, and career growth within the Cayenta consulting tier structure.
  • Assist functional managers with mid-year and year-end performance evaluations (e.g., formal feedback through Workday).
  • Monitor overall team performance by tracking and analyzing statistics and trends (utilization, billability, ticket/incident volume in CayStone), providing reporting to the senior Management Team.

Implementation Methodology & Execution

  • Drive standard, repeatable delivery frameworks - including Cayenta's fit-to-standard configuration approach, pre-configured utility/municipal industry templates, and training-first user adoption - rather than defaulting to custom, waterfall-style delays.
  • Lead the effort on complex or "greenfield" CIS solutions and custom modifications on projects or in new markets (e.g., new utility types, new regulatory/rate environments, first-time integrations).
  • Review proposed solution architecture - including CIS configuration, integration design (CSS Portal, MWM, Financial Systems, AMI/MDM, IVR), and data conversion approach - for projects under their purview; able to influence internal and client resources when difficult decisions need to be made.
  • Own and drive continuous improvement of Cayenta's implementation methodology - evaluate what is and isn't working across active projects, partner with Directors on formal changes, revise methodology as agreed, update documentation, and train staff.
  • Lead client workshops to explain the Cayenta CIS product and gather requirements for configuration or customization as required.
  • Partner across departments (including Project Managers) to ensure smooth sales-to-services handoffs and seamless post-go-live transitions to Customer Support.
  • Conduct post-implementation retrospective summaries and coordinate handoffs per standard Cayenta methodology.

Financial & Budget Oversight

  • Establish, track, and manage Cayenta CIS implementation project budgets, cost estimations, and allocations.
  • Monitor project health, milestone completion, expected go-lives, and variance reporting to support monthly Estimate to Complete (ETC) aligned with percentage of completion (POC), in coordination with Finance.

Client Engagement & Escalation Management

  • Positively contribute to client relationship management with utility and municipal clients; coach project resources on good client relationship management (CRM) practices.
  • Maintain regular, transparent communication with executive sponsors (e.g., client VPs, Directors, CFOs/Controllers) and client steering committees, providing consistent status updates.
  • Proactively identify delivery risks (e.g., data conversion issues, integration defects, rate/billing configuration gaps), conduct mitigation planning (including implementation "pre-mortems"), coordinate change control documentation, and resolve client escalations swiftly.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships across the utility/municipal client portfolio.

Knowledge Sharing & Training

  • Apply broad knowledge across numerous Cayenta CIS client implementations and configurations to new situations - essentially "has seen it all" across utility and municipal deployments.
  • Be highly involved in planning and delivering internal training sessions for other Cayenta consultants, as well as the Harris user conference (as requested).

Operational Modernization & Efficiency

  • Champion modern, AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot, etc.) to streamline administrative burdens - such as Statement of Work drafting, status report generation, test case documentation, meeting summaries, and variance analysis - enabling the team to focus on proactive client delivery and strategic relationship management.
  • Develop and implement best practices, standards, and processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness of the Cayenta professional services team.

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in a professional services or consulting role, ideally within utility/municipal software implementations (CIS, billing, customer service, or related ERP/EAM systems).
  • 4+ years of experience in a senior/managing consultant role, with a track record across 4 or more complex CIS implementation projects (or 20+ successful upgrades) - or 2+ years of formal leadership experience for candidates coming from a people-management track.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent software implementation projects for utility or municipal clients.
  • Working knowledge of the utility customer-to-cash lifecycle (meter-to-cash, billing, collections, customer service) and/or public sector implementation environments.
  • Financial Acumen: Demonstrated capability in managing project P&L, budget forecasting, consultant utilization, and contract scope control.
  • Methodologies & Tools: Practical knowledge of software implementation methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid); experience with PSA/project and test management tools (e.g., Jira, CayStone/SpiraTest, ServiceNow, Power BI, Excel).
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage executive client relationships and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.

What would make you stand out:

  • Direct experience with Cayenta CIS or comparable utility/municipal CIS platforms.
  • Familiarity with adjacent Cayenta ecosystem products (SilverBlaze customer self-service portal, MWM mobile workforce management) and common client-side integrations (IFS, AMI/MDM, IVR, print/lockbox vendors).
  • Familiarity with modern productivity and AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar AI assistants) for reporting, plan generation, status reports, and workflow acceleration.
  • Comfort exploring and adopting new AI-enabled workflows to improve service delivery efficiency.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!

About Cayenta:

Cayenta is a leading provider of enterprise resource management solutions in the local government, utility and financial industries. Cayenta’s products, services and customer relationships provide the foundation for continued innovation and growth.

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: SCADA Engineer Intern – I – Critical Infrastructure

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States, Atlanta, GA, or Dallas, TX

Summer 2027 Internship Dates: May 17th, 2027- August 13th, 2027

JOB SUMMARY

The SCADA Engineering Intern supports the development, testing, and documentation of SCADA systems for mission-critical (Data Center) infrastructure projects.

This is a hands-on learning opportunity for students or recent graduates interested in software development, industrial automation, controls, and AI-enabled engineering. The intern will work under the guidance of experienced engineers and contribute to clearly defined project assignments.

Previous professional SCADA experience is not required. Candidates should demonstrate technical curiosity, attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and an interest in industrial automation.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

SCADA Development & Support

  • Assist with developing SCADA graphics, tags, alarms, scripts, templates, and reusable components
  • Support basic PLC and SCADA integration activities
  • Help translate documented requirements and sequences of operation into functional SCADA configurations
  • Follow established development standards, naming conventions, and engineering processes
  • Make corrections and improvements based on engineering review and feedback

Testing & Documentation

  • Execute assigned test procedures and document the results
  • Support quality reviews, defect tracking, and basic troubleshooting
  • Verify completed work against documented requirements
  • Assist with technical documentation, test records, tag lists, alarm lists, and engineering notes
  • Clearly communicate identified issues, questions, and completed work

Development Tools & AI

  • Use Git for source control, including branches, commits, and pull requests
  • Use Docker and VM environments to create and develop projects
  • Use Azure DevOps to manage work items, repositories, testing, and documentation
  • Use approved generative AI and agentic AI tools for coding, testing, research, documentation, and workflow improvement
  • Review and validate AI-generated work before using it

Training & Technical Growth

  • Gain practical exposure to Rockwell Automation PLCs and other industrial control systems
  • Learn SCADA architecture, HMI design, alarming, scripting, data modeling, industrial networking, and communications
  • Participate in technical discussions, demonstrations, and supervised project activities
  • Apply feedback and demonstrate continuous improvement

Project Support

  • Communicate progress, questions, and technical issues to the assigned engineer
  • Participate in supervised testing, commissioning, or field activities when available
  • Follow established engineering, cybersecurity, safety, and quality requirements
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (BEGINNER LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED)

  • Basic understanding of programming, networking, databases, controls, or automation
  • Familiarity with Git or another source-control tool
  • Foundational understanding of generative AI or agentic AI concepts
  • Interest in SCADA systems, PLCs, industrial automation, and mission-critical infrastructure
  • Ability to follow technical instructions and documented processes
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn
  • Ability to communicate questions, progress, and technical issues clearly
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering and project teams
  • Ability to protect confidential company and customer information

PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)

oExposure to Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, C#, or a similar programming language

oExperience with Git, GitHub, Azure Repos, or Azure DevOps

oFamiliarity with Docker, containers, Kubernetes, or container orchestration

oFamiliarity with APIs, JSON, databases, or AI-assisted development

oExposure to PLCs, HMIs, SCADA platforms, or industrial communication protocols

oFamiliarity with Ignition, Rockwell Automation, Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, REST API or MQTT

  • SCADA graphics, alarming, scripting, data modeling, testing, and system integration

this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential

functions.

The Senior Solution Architect is responsible for designing automation solutions that help clients transform customer experiences, improve operational efficiency, and unlock measurable business value. This role serves as a trusted consultant, leading discovery and due diligence sessions to understand end-user needs, identify automation opportunities, build business cases, support proposals, and contribute to contract-ready solution content.

In this role, you will partner closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Finance, Legal, and client stakeholders to shape compelling, practical, and differentiated solutions.

  • Develop the solution approach, including estimated timelines, ROI models, presentation materials, and supporting documentation.
  • Identify, manage, and resolve issues that may impact solution quality, delivery timelines, resources, or client expectations.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance teams to evaluate pricing strategies, determine recommended approaches, and support approval processes.
  • Understand and escalate potential risks across solution components, working with the Solutions Director to identify risk mitigation alternatives.
  • Contribute content for scope of work documents, proposals, and contract-related materials.
  • Facilitate meetings to review pricing, staffing, timelines, contracts, and presentation materials requiring stakeholder alignment.
  • Attend client site visits in various locations with the Sales Representative and other key team members, as needed.
  • Conduct research on current and prospective clients, verticals, and industries to provide subject matter expertise and identify opportunities to differentiate the Concentrix solution.
  • Support Sales Representatives in gathering appropriate resources to follow Concentrix processes and protections, including Non-Disclosure Agreements, Deal Review, Legal, Security Risk/Controls, and related requirements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the opportunity management process to help the team work more efficiently and deliver effective messaging.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or 8+ years of related experience in one or more of the following areas: consulting, user-centered design, voice/digital bots/channels, customer experience, industry verticals, contact center operations, cloud services, sales support, or marketing.
  • Experience with bots, self-service applications, and communication channels such as Voice/IVR and Messaging/Chat/Omni.
  • Knowledge of user experience design and customer experience best practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio.
  • Proven ability to organize and prioritize projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven business environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, show ownership, and focus on continuous improvement.
  • Strong customer service mindset, professional presence, and consultative approach.
  • Solid understanding of business operations and industry dynamics, with demonstrated business acumen.
  • Demonstrated ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret information to support solution development and decision-making.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d) – Personal.manager / Klinik / Dienstplanung
jobs.excerpt: deine rolleDer Personal. manager ist unsere cloudbasierte Lösung für Dienstplanung, Personaleinsatzplanung und Zeitwirtschaft im Krankenhaus.
jobs.description:
deine rolle

Der Personal.manager ist unsere cloudbasierte Lösung für Dienstplanung, Personaleinsatzplanung und Zeitwirtschaft im Krankenhaus. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die die Produktverantwortung übernimmt und Projekte rund um das Produkt plant und steuert.

Du hast Lust auf Themen, wie Dienstplanung, Abwesenheiten, Regelwerke und Schichtbetrieb, und kannst das in saubere Produktarbeit übersetzen: Backlog pflegen, User Stories schreiben, mit dem Team im Scrum-Prozess arbeiten, Stakeholder steuern und Roadmap-Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Mission
Du führst den `Personal.manager` produktseitig so, dass wir in einer komplexen Krankenhausrealität klar priorisieren, sauber entscheiden und verlässlich liefern können.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Kollegen zusammen, die das Produkt und die Domäne seit Jahren kennen, aber die PO-Rolle zeitlich nicht in der nötigen Tiefe ausfüllen können. Die fachliche Erfahrung und das Produktwissen sind also vorhanden. Was fehlt, ist eine dedizierte Person, die Produktverantwortung in Vollzeit übernimmt, Entscheidungen vorbereitet, den Backlog führt und die Delivery im Alltag steuert.

Kurz gesagt:

Du machst aus Komplexität ein steuerbares Produkt.

Worum es in der Rolle wirklich geht
Der "Personal.manager" bildet produktive Prozesse in Kliniken ab: Dienstplanung, Personaleinsatz, Abwesenheiten, Arbeitszeit- und Tariflogik, Qualifikationssteuerung und Integrationen in gewachsene Systemlandschaften. Das ist fachlich komplex, regulatorisch anspruchsvoll und für die Kunden operativ kritisch.

Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der diese Domäne versteht und gleichzeitig das Handwerk mitbringt: User Stories formulieren, Akzeptanzkriterien ausarbeiten, das Backlog sauber halten, Refinements vorbereiten und moderieren, im Sprint-Alltag mit dem Team arbeiten und nach Gesprächen mit der Entwicklung wissen, worum es geht, richtige Fragen stellen und Entscheidungen treffen, hinter denen man steht. Seniorität heißt hier nicht „nur noch strategisch denken", sondern die fachliche Tiefe mitbringen, die es braucht, damit die operative Produktarbeit stimmt.

das wirst du tun

Produkt & Roadmap

  • Du verantwortest Roadmap und Priorisierung, triffst klare Produktentscheidungen und machst Zielkonflikte transparent.
  • Du schreibst User Stories mit testbaren Akzeptanzkriterien, pflegst den Backlog und klärst offene Fragen früh mit Fachseite und Entwicklung.
  • Du übersetzt Feedback aus Nutzung, Support und Betrieb in priorisierte Verbesserungen.

Projekte

  • Du planst und steuerst Projekte wie Kundeneinführungen, Migrationen, Integrationen oder interne Initiativen.
  • Du verantwortest Meilensteine, Ressourcen und Abhängigkeiten und behältst dabei Zeit, Budget und Qualität im Blick.
  • Du erkennst Risiken früh, eskalierst rechtzeitig und berichtest transparent, auch in Lenkungskreisen.

Delivery – agil und klassisch

  • Du arbeitest aktiv in den Scrum-Formaten mit und moderierst Refinements, aus denen lieferfähige Arbeit entsteht.
  • In Kunden- und Einführungsprojekten steuerst du klassisch oder hybrid, je nachdem, was zum Projekt passt.
  • Du begleitest Releases und koordinierst die Kommunikation zu geplanten Änderungen.

Stakeholder

  • Du bündelst Anforderungen aus Management, Support, Operations und Kundenprojekten sowie von externen Partnern.
  • Du bereitest Themen entscheidungsreif auf und kannst freundlich, aber bestimmt „nein“ oder „nicht jetzt“ sagen.

Warum die Rolle spannend ist

Du arbeitest an einem Produkt, das in einem hochrelevanten und operativ anspruchsvollen Umfeld eingesetzt wird. Gute Produktarbeit hat hier direkten Einfluss auf Planbarkeit, Fairness, Alltagstauglichkeit und Umsetzbarkeit in Kliniken.

Du bekommst in dieser Rolle echten Gestaltungsspielraum. Du kannst mitprägen, wie professionell, klar und wirksam Produktarbeit im "Personal.manager" funktioniert.

das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager, Projektmanager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit echter Verantwortung
  • Erfahrung mit Software im Krankenhaus oder in einem nahen, regulierten klinischen Umfeld
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Dienstplanung, Personaleinsatzplanung, Zeitwirtschaft oder Schichtbetrieb
  • Praxis in agilem und klassischem Projektmanagement; User Stories schreibst du auch selbst
  • Die Fähigkeit, unklare Anforderungen in klare, testbare und umsetzbare Arbeit zu übersetzen
  • Souveränität im Umgang mit Stakeholdern auf Fach-, Projekt- und Management-Ebene
  • Technisches Verständnis, um mit der Entwicklung auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren
  • Sehr starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Deutsch auf C2-Niveau


Das wäre besonders hilfreich
  • Erfahrung mit B2B-SaaS im Gesundheitswesen
  • Erfahrung in größeren Einführungs- oder Transformationskontexten
  • Verständnis für Integrationslandschaften, z. B. im SAP- oder HR-nahen Umfeld
  • Erfahrung mit Produktmetriken, Support-Signalen und datenbasierter Priorisierung

das bieten wir dir

  • Du arbeitest in einer Unternehmensgruppe mit kurzen Wegen & echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Du findest bei uns keine starre Konzernlogik, sondern die Möglichkeit, Dinge wirksam zu gestalten und sichtbar voranzubringen.
  • Und du arbeitest an Lösungen, die einen echten Unterschied machen – für Unternehmen, für Prozesse und am Ende für Menschen.
  • Maximale Flexibilität beim Arbeitsort: 100 % Remote, Hybrid oder 100 % vor Ort in St. Wendel – so, wie es zu Deinem Leben passt
  • Regelmäßige Schulungen und Weiterbildungen, damit Du fachlich und technologisch am Ball bleibst
  • Ein kollegiales, pragmatisches Team mit echtem Gestaltungswillen und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Ein faires Gehalt, das Deiner Erfahrung, Verantwortung und Rolle entspricht
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Für nicht remote arbeitende Menschen: Modernes Büro mit Dusche, Waschmaschine und einer hochwertigen Siebträgermaschine

unsere ansprüche und ziele

  • Roadmap und Priorisierung sind für alle relevanten Stakeholder nachvollziehbar und belastbar.
  • Anforderungen gehen klar vorbereitet in die Umsetzung, und Refinements führen zu Entscheidungen statt zu neuer Unschärfe.
  • Projekte laufen planbar: Meilensteine werden gehalten, Risiken werden früh sichtbar und Abweichungen rechtzeitig eskaliert.
  • Kunden und interne Beteiligte wissen jederzeit, wo ein Projekt steht.
  • Releases und Änderungen werden transparent und verlässlich kommuniziert.
  • Produkt- und Projektentscheidungen orientieren sich an der Klinik- und Nutzerrealität, nicht an der Lautstärke einzelner Anforderungen.

bewerbung

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und gern ein paar kurzen Hinweisen auf Produkte, Kontexte oder Verantwortungsbereiche, in denen du bereits Produktverantwortung in komplexen, erklärungsbedürftigen oder regulierten Umfeldern übernommen hast.

Uma fábrica de software com sólida experiência em transformar negócios de ponta a ponta. Com um time de especialistas em diversos setores, construímos um produto adequado às necessidades do negócio do cliente, com a cabeça no futuro, e os pés no presente.

Bora fazer parte do nosso #DreamTeamItix?

O Analista de Processos será responsável por:

Mapear, redesenhar e sustentar os processos que suportam os produtos e operações da empresa, conduzindo jornadas AS IS → TO BE de ponta a ponta e transformando diagnósticos em ganhos mensuráveis de eficiência, custo, qualidade e aderência regulatória. Atua junto aos squads de Produtos.

Principais responsabilidades:

- Levantar e documentar processos AS IS com as áreas operacionais, comerciais e jurídicas, identificando gargalos, retrabalho, riscos e pontos de controle;

- Garantir que os processos redesenhados atendam aos requisitos regulatórios do negócio (BACEN, ANTT), em conjunto com Jurídico e Compliance;

- Identificar oportunidades de automação e de uso de IA aplicada, priorizando por impacto e esforço;

- Conduzir a implantação: plano de mudança, treinamento, procedimentos e acompanhamento da adoção;

- Manter backlog de melhorias priorizado, gestão à vista e status report executivo recorrente.


São requisitosobrigatórios:

- Experiência sólida em mapeamento e redesenho de processos (BPMN, SIPOC, mapeamento de fluxo de valor) em empresas de grande porte e alta complexidade;

- Projetos de melhoria contínua conduzidos de ponta a ponta com resultado mensurado (Lean, Six Sigma, PDCA, Kaizen);

- Atuação direta com áreas de negócio em diferentes níveis de maturidade digital, incluindo liderança executiva;

- Leitura de dados e de relatórios gerenciais (DRE, receita, custo, faturamento) para sustentar casos de melhoria e redução de custo;

- Vivência em ambiente ágil, trabalhando com squads, backlog e sprints;

- Experiência com OKRs e indicadores de desempenho;

- Uso prático de IA no dia a dia de trabalho.

  • Ferramentas:

Modelagem de processos em BPMN 2.0: Bizagi, Lucidchart, Visio ou equivalentes;

Gestão de backlog e demandas: Jira, Azure DevOps ou equivalentes;

Documentação e colaboração: Confluence, SharePoint, Miro;

Análise e indicadores: Excel avançado e Power BI.

São requisitosdesejáveis/diferenciais:

- Vivência em transporte, logística, mobilidade, meios de pagamento ou serviços financeiros;

- Conhecimento do ecossistema: torre de controle, tracking, seguros, débitos veiculares, vale-pedágio, CIOT, antecipação de recebíveis e de frete, cartões, conta digital;

- Process mining e automação de processos (RPA, Power Automate, workflows);

- Design Thinking e facilitação de workshops;

- Certificação ágil (CSPO, PSPO ou Kanban).

Informações adicionais

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.

Our mission is to Profoundly change the standard of care by creating a tomorrow where clinicians can confidently ablate tissue with precision; a tomorrow where patients have access to safe and effective treatment options, so they can quickly return to their daily lives. Changing the standard of care is part of our fabric. We are a group of energetic, problem-solvers focused on innovation, and looking to change the world. The Capital Sales Executive is responsible for selling TULSA-Pro to both new and existing hospital and imaging center accounts within the assigned territory.   • Ensure that pipeline supports achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual goals.
  • Manage the complex sales process into new hospitals, HW, SW and service upgrades and additional systems into existing hospitals
  • Build clinical and administrative support through presentations, executive meetings, marketing events, and reimbursement support.
  • Effectively manage transition of initial sale and installation to the account management team to drive procedural volume and growth.
  • Achieve quarterly sales targets with a goal of closing 3 new programs with a purchase of packs with a strategic plan within a year.

  • Initiate contact with C suite and senior hospital administrators.
  • Drive market awareness and increase sales of TULSA-Pro within the assigned territory.
  • Generate a high volume of sales activity, including in-person prospecting, product evaluations, phone calls, proposal and contract generation, customer presentations, and negotiations.

What success looks like in this role:

Curiosity, creativity, and a relentless drive to improve are at the heart of this role. As a Digital Intelligence Analyst, you'll help manage and administer the Marketing Insight technology stack for Unisys, working directly with our Marketing Digital intelligence Senior Manager. It's a hands-on role with real room to grow: you'll become an expert in the platforms that power our targeting, and you'll help shape where our data and reporting go next.

Unisys is a global technology solutions company focused on delivering high-performance, security-centric solutions that improve how people live and work. Our people are at the forefront of everything we do - driving client success, contributing to our communities, and making the world more secure. If you believe in better outcomes and better lives, we would love for you to join us.


What you’ll do:

  • Administer our Marketing Insight and Intelligence tech stack day to day, including Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360), Intentsify, ZoomInfo, and RingLead, keeping each platform running reliably.
  • Build and activate audiences in Salesforce Data Cloud, troubleshoot issues, and develop deep enough expertise to become the team's go-to resource.
  • Monitor marketing data quality across systems, flag inconsistencies, and help resolve them.
  • Maintain our target account list in partnership with marketing and sales.
  • Build reports and dashboards that turn campaign data into clear, actionable insight.
  • Partner with marketing, sales, and partner/alliances teams to fulfill audience requests for campaigns and programs.
  • Support intent data platforms and vendor relationships to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Support website tagging using Google Tag Manager.
  • Get a front-row seat to our data modernization, including our move to Databricks and Power BI, and help represent marketing's needs as the platform takes shape.
  • Spot manual or inefficient processes and suggest improvements.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

You'll be successful in this role if you have:


  • A BA/BS degree and 2–4 years of experience in marketing operations, sales or revenue operations, marketing analytics, or a related role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 1–2 years of hands-on Salesforce experience
  • Experience building segments or audiences in a CDP, marketing automation platform, or ad platform (Salesforce Data Cloud a strong plus)
  • Exposure to intent or data enrichment tools such as ZoomInfo, Intensify, 6sense, or Bombora
  • A data-curious mindset: you like finding gaps, asking why, and figuring out the fix

Nice to have: Google Tag Manager, Power BI or Tableau, SQL, or exposure to Databricks, Snowflake, or Azure

Job Requisition ID #

Position Overview

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The sales leader you support will rely on you for insight into the number. Autodesk’s sales organization is measured every week on where the year will land. For Global Sales, you will explain that number: what moved, why, what the risk is and what to do about it. You are the Global Sales leader’s source of insight on their forecast, their pipeline and their performance. You work alongside the operations business partner who supports the same leader: they run the operating rhythm, and you bring the analysis and intelligence behind it. You are also the leader’s route into everything else the Forecasting & Revenue Intelligence team produces, from account intelligence to targets and reporting. You work inside their business day to day, using methods and standards shared across the whole sales organization, so results are comparable from one business to the next. This is one of four such roles, one for each major part of the sales organization.


Location: United States (remote). Eastern or Central time zone preferred.

Organization: Revenue Operations


Responsibilities

  • Provide the analysis behind the weekly Global Sales forecast: an independent view of where the quarter and year will land, the commentary, and the risks and upside behind the number submitted to executive leadership
  • Prepare the sales leader for the forecast call and executive review, working with the operations business partner who runs the cadence, with risks, upside and gaps already identified
  • Explain week-over-week movement by cause: new pipeline, slipped and pushed deals, losses, deal size, timing, or a change in judgment
  • Analyze pipeline health: coverage, generation, stage conversion, velocity, slippage and linearity, and whether pipeline is enough for future quarters
  • Identify risk before it appears in reported results, with the evidence and a recommended response
  • Measure and report forecast accuracy and bias for this part of the business
  • Run deep dives by geography, segment, product, route to market and team that end in a decision
  • Provide the insight and analysis for this business’s quarterly business reviews, growth priority reviews and deal reviews, working with the operations business partner
  • Bring recurring needs back to the central team so they are built once and shared across all four businesses

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or business field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience forecasting and analyzing performance for a large sales organization, including presenting insight to senior sales leaders

UX Research & Product Discovery

UX/UI Design

Accessibility & User Experience

Product Optimization

Collaboration & Developer Handoff

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Excellent problem-solving and UX decision-making skills.
  • Strong visual design skills with attention to detail.
  • Comfortable balancing business objectives with user needs.
  • Collaborative communicator who works effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Passionate about scalable systems, accessibility, and continuous improvement.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Skills

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. As a Senior Manager, Commerce Media, you will lead commerce media strategy and activation for a broader slice of accounts while managing and developing a team of Commerce individual contributors. You’ll be accountable for consistent, high‑quality delivery across retail media platforms (e.g., Amazon, Walmart, Criteo and similar), and for raising the team’s craft in planning, testing, measurement‑informed optimization, and client communication. You’ll stay hands‑on where it matters most (major launches, complex troubleshooting, high‑stakes client moments), while spending more of your time coaching, reviewing, standardizing best practices, and partnering cross‑functionally so commerce media work is integrated into the broader client strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

People Leader:

  • Build and lead a strong team: set clear goals, run regular 1:1s, provide coaching and feedback, and develop career paths for both emerging and more senior talent (IC and manager tracks).
  • Review and elevate the quality of client‑facing outputs across your slice (plans, performance narratives, testing agendas, readouts), ensuring work is defensible and consistent.
  • Lead hiring and talent evaluation for your area: participate in interviewing, define role‑ready skill expectations, and provide recommendations for promotions, stretch assignments, and targeted development.
  • Promote cross‑training to build bench strength and flexibility (e.g., Amazon Search + DSP, Walmart + Amazon, onsite + offsite patterns), partnering with Talent Development and senior leaders as needed.

Client-Centric:

  • Own integrated commerce media planning and execution across your client accounts, ensuring strategies ladder to client business objectives (growth, profitability, retention, new‑to‑brand/customer acquisition where applicable).
  • Lead or co‑lead commerce media portions of senior client touchpoints: explain what’s happening, why it matters, and what you recommend next with clear trade‑offs and expectations.
  • Ensure commerce media work connects to broader full‑funnel and cross‑channel plans (Search, Social, TVAD, Creative, CRM, Retail/Marketplace strategy), partnering with Client Partners and channel leads to align priorities and timing.

Channel Specific Expertise & The Tinuiti Way:

  • Standardize how your teams plan, execute, and report across retail media: launch readiness, QA discipline, pacing hygiene, change logs, and clear documentation so quality is repeatable.
  • Own the implementation of Commerce Media Tinuiti Way for your clients: enforce practical standards and coaching for platform roles, retail event playbooks, and day‑to‑day operational excellence.
  • Create a strong collaboration cadence across adjacent teams so commerce media isn’t siloed; ensure teams understand dependencies and handoffs.

Product-Led:

  • Drive team-wide proficiency in Tinuiti tools and core commerce platforms; ensure the team uses technology, automation, and (where appropriate) AI to improve speed, consistency, and insight quality.
  • Sponsor adoption of reusable templates and workflows (brief intake, launch checklists, reporting views, testing templates) to reduce manual work and rework.
  • Collect structured platform and workflow feedback from the field and route it to senior commerce leadership and product/ops partners, prioritizing issues that unlock scale and reduce friction.

Data & Measurement Data-Driven:

  • Ensure teams use data to make decisions, not just report: diagnose drivers (pacing, CPC/CPA, ROAS/ACoS, NTB, share‑of‑voice/brand signals where available), surface trade‑offs, and recommend actions with simple success criteria.
  • Set expectations for testing rigor and learning loops: clear hypotheses, clean setups, defined read timing, and documentation of what changed and what we learned.
  • Oversee measurement alignment and ensure learnings roll back into next‑cycle plans.

Owner Mindset:

  • Love Growth: Identify and scale growth plays across multiple client accounts (new formats, retail event strategies, audience expansion patterns, creative/placement learnings) and turn wins into reusable playbooks.
  • Hate Waste: Reduce recurring waste patterns (inefficient spend, repeated QA errors, slow reaction to pacing issues, poor inventory patterns) by installing standards, safeguards, and coaching that sticks.
  • Lead 1–2 cross‑account initiatives per half that improve commerce media consistency or efficiency (e.g., QA upgrades, reporting standardization, testing ladders, retail event readiness processes).

Professional & Technical Qualifications:

  • 7–10+ years in commerce media / retail media / paid commerce, including meaningful experience across major retail media ecosystems (e.g., Amazon and/or Walmart plus others).
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams (ICs and potentially first‑line managers), including performance management, QA oversight, and capability building.
  • Strong command of commerce media optimization and measurement concepts (ROAS/ACoS, NTB where available, incrementality concepts, experimentation basics, retail seasonality/event dynamics).
  • Demonstrated ability to standardize ways of working across multiple accounts and maintain high quality under changing priorities.
  • Strong communication and executive-ready storytelling skills; able to translate complex performance drivers into clear actions and expectations for clients and internal leadership.

SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Design Engineer II, Transmission owns the preliminary transmission line design and engineering lifecycle for assigned utility-scale solar, BESS, and related interconnection projects. This role serves as the primary technical owner from BD kickoff through Design-to-Preconstruction handoff, aligning preliminary design, scope, schedule, risk, and technical assumptions before execution begins.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned


Position Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Preliminary Transmission Line Design and Technical Ownership
    • Own the first-pass preliminary transmission line and gen-tie design approach for assigned pursuits and projects by reviewing all applicable requirements and project-specific inputs to define the design basis, key assumptions, route and point of interconnection requirements, line configuration, conductor and shield wire assumptions, structure and foundation assumptions, clearances, quantities, risks, and open items needed to support the 10% design deliverable.
    • Review client provided documents, technical exhibits, PPAs, interconnection agreements, utility and ISO handbooks, owner standards, and related project information to identify requirements, assumptions, risks, opportunities, and scope outside of SOLV standards.
    • Serve as the primary transmission line subject matter expert for assigned projects and coordinate technical inputs from engineering consultants, survey and geotechnical teams, environmental and permitting teams, land and right-of-way stakeholders, substation design, procurement, estimating, scheduling, utilities, and other specialty subcontractors.
    • Lead development of the 10% transmission line design, including routing, conductor and structure sizing, and related refinements, to support estimating with pricing.
  • Estimate and Scope Alignment
    • Coordinate with estimating and scheduling to ensure the preliminary transmission line design, route length, structure quantities, conductor and hardware assumptions, scope narrative, schedule, and commercial assumptions are aligned.
    • Review estimates for technical completeness and identify gaps, exclusions, owner-furnished equipment, allowances, contingencies, route or point of interconnection uncertainty, and scope items that require clarification or escalation.
    • Deliver the owner reviewed preliminary transmission line design to estimating and BD in accordance with the project stage-gate schedule.
  • Client and Project Engagement
    • Participate in routine client meetings to review technical exhibits, explain preliminary transmission line design assumptions, identify risks, and clarify route, point of interconnection, utility, and other requirements outside of SOLV standards.
    • Support contractual exhibit reviews, markups, and technical responses needed to facilitate LNTP, while escalating material commitments, non-standard requirements, and significant risk.
    • Communicate transmission line design decisions, open items, risks, and required owner or utility inputs clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • EOR and Engineering Consultant Coordination
    • Prepare and issue proposal requests to transmission line EORs and engineering subcontractors.
    • Review received proposals for technical scope, deliverables, exclusions, assumptions, and commercial alignment.
    • Align EOR and subcontractor proposals with the project scope, route and point of interconnection assumptions, estimate, schedule, and LNTP requirements, and submit the final proposal information to BD, scheduling, estimating, engineering controls, and other required stakeholders.
  • Handoff and Early Execution Readiness
    • Prepare the transmission line engineering scope, proposal information, schedule inputs, EOR or consultant coordination details, route and point of interconnection assumptions, risks, and open items needed for handoff to the Preconstruction Engineering team.
    • Support the handoff process by clearly transferring RFIs, client and utility comments, design risks, procurement constraints, required decisions, and unresolved technical items to the HV engineering team.
  • Quality Assurance, Value Engineering, and Documentation
    • Review and approve preliminary transmission line design deliverables for assigned projects and verify alignment with NESC, IEEE, utility, ISO, owner, SOLV, AHJ, and vendor requirements.
    • Propose cost-effective, reliable, and constructible alternatives for route selection, conductor and shield wire, structure systems, foundations, crossings, access, and point of interconnection interfaces, and resolve design challenges in collaboration with internal teams, EORs, consultants, vendors, and clients.
    • Maintain accurate documentation of route evaluations, design iterations, technical decisions, client and utility comments, proposal revisions, assumptions, risks, and handoff materials.
    • Use established checklists and standards, identify recurring issues, and recommend improvements for incorporation into department processes and standards.
  • Team Leadership and Development
    • Assign and coordinate work for transmission line designers, engineers, interns, and technical support staff on assigned projects; review work for quality, completeness, and schedule compliance.
    • Mentor junior team members and identify training or development needs related to transmission line routing, line design criteria, conductor and structure selection, clearances, utility requirements, RFP review, estimating support, and project handoff.

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, civil, or related engineering from an accredited institution.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) licensure or equivalent certification is a nice-to-have, not a must.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in transmission line design or engineering, utility-scale renewable energy, gen-tie, or related power engineering.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in transmission line design software (PLS-CADD, PLS-POLE, PLS-TOWER, AutoCAD, MicroStation, GIS, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of transmission line design principles, routing, conductor and shield wire selection, sag-tension, clearances, structure systems, foundations, and industry standards (NESC, IEEE, etc).
  • Thorough understanding of local, state, and federal regulations related to transmission line design, utility infrastructure, and solar development.
  • Familiarity with utility interconnection requirements, point of interconnection requirements, right-of-way and permitting considerations, and contract language.
  • In-depth knowledge of applicable engineering principles and industry best practices.
  • Effective communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver results under tight deadlines.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%
