jobs.excerpt: About the Company Anza is a revolutionary platform that empowers solar and energy storage equipment buyers and developers to use advanced data and technology to compare more products and make confident decisions faster.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Anza is a revolutionary platform that empowers solar and energy storage equipment buyers and developers to use advanced data and technology to compare more products and make confident decisions faster. The result is increased profit, reduced risk, and massive time-saving. With Anza, clients can focus on higher-value work without chasing down data or using manual tools. They can access real-time pricing and extensive technical, trade risk, counterparty, and contract term data from 95% of the U.S. module supply. Anza’s Effective $/Watt analytics enable users to evaluate modules based on production and installation costs. It provides energy storage lifecycle cost analytics across AC and DC battery systems. Anza’s vision is to help every utility-scale and DG buyer and developer make optimal design and procurement decisions.

Anza was born from internal tools at Borrego that maximized the financial value of its own projects. In 2021, Anza launched as a standalone application for broader industry use, furthering the company’s mission of accelerating the deployment of renewable energy.

At Anza, we don’t accept the status quo. We are driven by a culture of teamwork, a growth mindset and continuous improvement as we pursue our mission. Since its inception, we have surpassed our growth goals and are looking forward to continuing to build a great team and platform. We believe in having an ownership company culture, so we have implemented an attractive equity program. Join us!

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll design and build well-considered technical solutions across our full stack. You'll take ambiguous, complex requirements and turn them into shippable, maintainable software - owning features end to end from design through production.

We're a growing company in a fast-moving industry, which means priorities shift, systems evolve, and the most valuable engineers are the ones who treat that as the job rather than a disruption. You'll raise the bar for engineering quality through your code, your reviews, and your influence on how we build.

The problems are genuinely hard: helping customers instantly compare and optimize across a vast space of solar and storage products demands thoughtful architecture and careful modeling. We're cloud native (GCP), and our stack is TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL. We care deeply about developer experience and invest extensively in CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code. We expect our senior engineers to have demonstrated experience with some or all of this stack — and to be unafraid of the parts they haven't touched yet.

How We Build

We use LLMs heavily across our engineering workflows but we don't defer our thinking to the robots. The engineers who thrive here have embraced agentic engineering as a force multiplier while maintaining a deep, first-principles understanding of the code they ship. We're looking for a lead who can set that bar; someone who knows when to let the tools accelerate them and when the judgment has to be their own.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate closely with product owners, designers, QA, and other engineers to define pragmatic technical solutions within our agile process
  • Own the design, implementation, and delivery of significant features and services that solve real business challenges
  • Write high-quality, thoroughly tested code, deliver well-considered Pull Requests, and contribute to scalable, maintainable architecture
  • Champion technically sound and well-designed product decisions that meet our customers’ needs and contribute to the overall health of the platform

What You'll Bring

While no one individual will possess them all, the successful candidate will bring many of the following experiences, skills, and attributes::

  • 5+ years of hands on technical experience
  • 3+ years of Node.js and React experience (Typescript)
  • Strong knowledge of relational data modeling, API design, and software architecture
  • Experience developing cloud native applications (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • A flexible, adaptable mindset - comfortable pivoting quickly when direction or approach changes, and energized rather than intimidated by touching systems you didn't build
  • A pragmatic bias toward shipping: you weigh trade-offs, pick the solution that fits the moment, and avoid over-engineering

Compensation & Benefits

Anza uses an internally equitable and externally competitive total cash approach to compensation. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, health, life, and disability insurance; a comprehensive wellness program; 401(k) plan with company match and immediate vesting; continuing education and professional development assistance; and self-managed flexible work schedules and time-off policies.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Anza provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetics, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state, federal and local laws. In addition to federal law requirements, Anza complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. EEO M/F/D/V.

A Note to Third-Party Recruiters

Anza's team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. Anza does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. Resumes are only accepted from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies if a signed agreement is in place AND if external recruiting assistance is authorized by the Anza team for a specific position. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Anza. Anza is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Safety Technology Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Safety Technology Analyst, you will drive the strategic implementation and operational excellence of Parexel's pharmacovigilance safety technology systems. This position plays a critical role in ensuring regulatory compliance, system optimization, and the delivery of advanced safety solutions that protect patient safety and accelerate clinical research. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Safety Operations, IT, Quality Assurance, and external auditors, following industry-standard processes and regulatory frameworks. Responsibilities include designing and implementing complex technology solutions, managing system integrations, leading change management initiatives, and providing expert guidance on safety database platforms and emerging pharmacovigilance technologies.


You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing patient safety, driving operational excellence, and shaping the future of clinical research technology. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Safety Technology Administrator can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology, regulatory compliance, and strategic system implementation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the setup, configuration, and support of Parexel's safety database and associated systems, including new study implementations, periodic and ad-hoc report generation, expedited report rule configuration, and comprehensive end-user support
  • Direct the planning and execution of safety database handovers from clients to Parexel and from Parexel to clients at project completion, ensuring seamless transitions for complex pharmacovigilance operations
  • Design and deliver complex integration solutions between Parexel safety technologies and other applications to enhance operational capabilities and drive service excellence
  • Represent Safety Technology Management in cross-functional collaboration with IT, Quality Assurance, and external auditors, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, security standards, and quality protocols
  • Lead change management initiatives aligned with Software Development Life Cycle principles, including impact assessments, testing methodologies, system validation, and software updates
  • Develop and deliver presentations and technical documentation for safety technology solutions, including authorship and review of standard operating procedures and controlled documents
  • Lead issue resolution and collaboration with Parexel IT, vendors, Safety Services staff, and clients for proper analysis and closure of technical issues across supported systems
  • Train, coach, and provide work directions to team members in system administration, database support, and strategic implementation activities
  • Collaborate with Global Pharmacovigilance Intelligence Office to ensure safety systems maintain regulatory compliance and proactively meet evolving requirements

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Advanced technical expertise in pharmacovigilance safety technology systems, including complex configurations, system administration, and application support
  • Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels

jobs.description:
Regional Investigative Reporter


A regional investigative reporter at NEWSWELL will serve a statewide California audience and support our local newsrooms with a stream of high‑impact accountability and investigative reporting.


This job is part of a new standalone investigative team that serves the Western newsrooms in NEWSWELL’s nonprofit collective.


This experienced reporter will focus on investigative reporting that emanates from ongoing news in our local sites or on unique regional or statewide reporting that can be of service to our local audiences.


The team’s work may focus on a core topic area including:

  • housing and income disparity
  • urban policy and disruption
  • health care and health disparity
  • agriculture and immigration
  • education and child development
  • technology influence and malfeasance
  • criminal justice and rule of law

This reporter has the skills to originate, scope and execute sophisticated accountability projects that examine how power, money, decisions and public systems shape life across California and the West.


This reporter will use advanced reporting techniques — complex public records work, deep sourcing, data analysis and document‑driven research — and help elevate investigative standards across the team and our local newsrooms. This reporter/editor demonstrates skill at mentoring colleagues and collaborating on digital presentation, packaging and impact tracking.


This reporter may collaborate with the team’s senior statewide reporter, other team members and staffers from NEWSWELL’s local newsrooms, and should bring a mentorship sensibility to the role.

Every piece of our team’s work will focus on two equal priorities: impact and audience connection:


IMPACT: All our efforts should pursue righting a wrong and demonstrating the power of journalism to improve public life.


AUDIENCE CONNECTION: Everything we publish should also be in pursuit of strengthening audience ties to our newsroom, through two-way dialogue, public events, uses of new platforms or other methods to demonstrate public outreach.


NEWSWELL helps newsrooms become nonprofit and for-community, providing strategic guidance, innovative solutions and operational support so journalists can focus on what matters most: serving their communities. Through partnerships with Arizona State University — named the nation’s most innovative university for 11 years in a row — NEWSWELL brings cutting-edge ideas, research and tools to reinvent local news and strengthen democracy.


Our innovative model has earned us support from journalistic and philanthropic organizations nationwide. This new team’s work is designed to leverage and grow that support, so that we can grow and transform local journalism.


Submission Requirements

A cover letter explaining the key contributions you would bring to the role and explaining how your clips shed light on the path to that role.


A resume explaining your professional skills and background.


At least three clips demonstrating aptitude for investigative impact and audience connection.



The pay rate for this role is $70,000-$80,000 annually.



What you’ll do

  • Conceive, develop and produce original investigative and accountability stories that deliver exclusive findings, reveal systemic issues or influence and have measurable civic impact.
  • Mentor and coach local newsrooms and collaborate on local reporting.
  • Integrate solutions journalism, audience interaction and other innovative techniques into the investigative workflow.
  • Execute complex public records reporting.
  • Analyze data at an advanced level or collaborate with others to do so.
  • Develop and protect sensitive sources across government, institutions and communities.
  • Travel as needed to NEWSWELL locations and other reporting locations.
  • Collaborate with editors and the impact producer to present stories to a broad range of audiences.
  • Use multiple digital publishing formats when appropriate.
  • Represent the newsroom at community forums and partner events; engage transparently with readers and stakeholders.
  • Pilot new tools, including responsible AI, to enhance research, document analysis and workflow efficiency.
  • Partner with ASU’s Walter Cronkite School and other academic institutions to create strong student engagement opportunities, including reporting, learning experiences and newsroom collaboration.
  • Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative newsroom culture that values transparency, fairness, equity and community impact.

What you'll need

Investigative mastery: FOIA/OMA strategy, document analysis, source development, meticulous verification.

  • Solutions journalism practice: familiarity with evidence standards, comparative case vetting and transparent limitations; ability to integrate solutions frames without advocacy.
  • Storytelling excellence: ability to distill complex information; strong organization and project management across multi‑month investigations and faster accountability hits.
  • Digital fluency: SEO‑aware writing, smart packaging, social and audience collaboration to maximize reach and comprehension.
  • Risk awareness: strong judgment around legal, safety and trauma‑informed practices.
  • Mentorship: strong sense of collaboration with fellow reporters and other staffers.
  • Proficiency in Associated Press style; commitment to fairness, accuracy, inclusion and community‑centered journalism.

Relevant qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in journalism or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Five years of journalism experience with a record of accountability or investigative work.
  • Demonstrable experience producing exclusive findings, document‑driven reporting, public records work and data‑enhanced stories.

Preferred education and experience

  • Data reporting: spreadsheet manipulation, dataset cleaning, identifying trends; collaborate on charts/maps/visuals.
  • Experience in visual production, shooting or producing your own images, video, social media content or work on other platforms beyond written stories.
  • Experience reporting in California and the West.
  • Experience with cross‑newsroom or regional accountability collaborations.

Preferred skills and abilities

  • Advanced data tools (SQL, R or Python) or mapping software (ArcGIS, QGIS).
  • Fluency in languages other than English.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan with matching employer contribution
  • 22 days of vacation time
  • 11 holidays, including your birthday
  • Parental leave
  • Significant tuition reductions
  • Professional development is highly valued at ASU Enterprise Partners, where employees are encouraged to look across the organization and nurture new areas of interest
  • $30 bi-weekly cell phone reimbursement

Position Title

Senior Fabric Engineer

Position Location

Remote – work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

AI2IO recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

The Senior Fabric Engineer leads the architecture and hands-on build of AI2IO’s next-generation enterprise data platform on Microsoft Fabric. Reporting into the Business Intelligence function, this role is responsible for designing and implementing a governed Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) lakehouse architecture that consolidates data from Deltek Vantagepoint, project performance systems, HRIS, and financial systems into a single, trustworthy foundation for reporting, forecasting, and future AI-enabled analytics.

This is a deeply technical, builder-focused role. The Senior Fabric Engineer partners closely with the Director of Business

Intelligence and a Data Analyst to translate validated business definitions and source-system lineage into a well-modeled,

performant, and maintainable data platform — including ingestion pipelines, Delta Lake table design, dimensional modeling,

and the deployment standards that keep the platform reliable as it scales.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience standing up or significantly modernizing an enterprise data warehouse on the Microsoft data stack, is comfortable working from imperfect or undocumented legacy source systems, and takes pride in building a platform other people can trust.

Essential Functions

Platform Architecture & Implementation

  • Design and Build the Fabric Lakehouse: Architect and implement the Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) layer structure in Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Lake table design, partitioning strategy, and performance optimization
  • Own Data Ingestion & Integration: Design and build ingestion pipelines from source systems — including Deltek
  • Vantagepoint, Power BI semantic models, project performance data, and financial/HRIS systems — into the Bronze layer, with appropriate error handling and monitoring
  • Establish the Dimensional Model: Design and build a proper dimensional (Dim/Fact) model in the Silver/Gold layers that replaces ad hoc, view-on-view logic with clean, conformed dimensions and auditable fact tables
  • Set Deployment Standards: Define and implement CI/CD, version control, environment promotion, and release standards for the data platform in partnership with the BI operating model and Azure DevOps backlog

Platform Engineering & Reliability

  • Ensure Data Quality at the Source: Build validation, reconciliation, and monitoring into ingestion and transformation pipelines so that data quality issues are caught before they reach reporting layers
  • Optimize for Scale and Cost: Monitor and tune Fabric capacity usage, pipeline performance, and storage costs as the platform grows in scope and usage
  • Document the Platform: Maintain clear technical documentation of pipeline logic, table schemas, and lineage from source system through to the Gold layer, in support of the broader KPI certification and governance effort

Partnership & Delivery

  • Partner with the Data Analyst: Translate validated business requirements, KPI definitions, and source-data findings from the Data Analyst into concrete platform design decisions
  • Support Governance: Work with the Director of Business Intelligence and the KPI Governance Council to ensure the platform enforces, rather than works around, agreed-upon metric definitions
  • Enable Forecasting & AI Enablement: Build the platform foundation needed to support enterprise revenue and IT forecasting initiatives, and future AI-assisted reporting and data Q&A capabilities

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

  • Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, and Delta Lake, including Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture patterns
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing dimensional (Dim/Fact) data models for enterprise reporting
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with SQL Server, including reading and reverse-engineering complex, layered legacy views
  • Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines from ERP, financial, or project-based systems (experience with Deltek Vantagepoint or similar professional services ERP systems is a plus)

  • Experience establishing deployment, version control, and release standards for data platforms, ideally using Azure DevOps
  • Ability to work independently from ambiguous or incomplete requirements, and to raise data quality or governance concerns proactively
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical decisions clearly for a non-engineering audience
  • Demonstrated aptitude for learning new technology and adapting to evolving requirements

Travel / Relocation Requirements

  • Up to 5%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related discipline

PLUS

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform roles, including hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, or comparable modern lakehouse platforms

About Vasion

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About the role

Vasion is hiring a Solutions Architect for our regulated and federal business, where the hardest technical problems in our portfolio live. You will be the person who owns the defensible technical answer when a federal customer asks whether something can work inside their authentication, network isolation, and accreditation constraints, and who defines the path forward when the standard answer does not apply.

This is a depth role rather than a breadth role. Architectural fluency without current, detailed product knowledge does not survive contact with a regulated deployment, so we are looking for someone who goes deep on the product and stays there as the portfolio evolves.

What you'll do
  • Build depth on new capabilities ahead of demand: Reach working depth on newly released capability before customers force the question, surfacing integration gaps and unsupported edge cases while they can still be addressed.
  • Be the technical authority on federal and regulated requirements: Own the answer on whether our architecture meets a customer's authentication, authorization, and accreditation requirements, and clearly state where current product capability ends.
  • Codify the patterns that keep recurring: Turn the most complex recurring problems into reusable reference designs, so future engagements inherit proven solutions rather than rediscovering them.
  • Assess technical risk and manage it: Evaluate risk posture, architecture constraints, and deployment feasibility on the highest-complexity opportunities, then define the mitigations, sequencing, or architectural changes that make the solution deployable.
  • Design beyond the standard template: Define architecture, integration points, and cutover approach for environments that exceed what standard delivery patterns cover.
  • Protect context across the handoff: Supply the technical assumptions, constraints, integration points, and success criteria into joint technical kickoffs, so nothing essential is lost between the deal team and delivery.
  • Execute the hardest cutovers: Take the customer environment through cutover where complexity exceeds what standard delivery supports, rather than handing a design over and stepping away.
  • Diagnose root cause on escalations: Supply the definitive technical diagnosis when a deployment stalls or a production issue surfaces, separating root cause from reported symptom.
  • Convert friction into fixes: Classify what you encounter by root cause, then drive recurring patterns into product input, service offerings, or enablement with named owners, so the same problem does not return to you a third time.
Qualifications
  • Deep enterprise deployment experience: Eight or more years deploying infrastructure software into complex enterprise or public sector environments, with clear ownership of outcomes rather than handoffs.
  • Identity and authentication depth: Strong working command of SAML, SSO, directory integration, certificate-based authentication, and common identity providers.
  • Networking fundamentals under pressure: DNS, TLS and certificate chains, firewalls, proxies, VLANs, and the ability to isolate a problem in a network you did not design and cannot fully see.
  • Hyperscale, virtualization, and appliance platforms: Practical command of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP, or comparable hyperscalers), virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, or comparable), and virtual appliance deployment, sizing, and troubleshooting.
  • Linux administration and scripting: Comfortable at the command line, reading logs, and automating with PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
  • Demonstrated learning velocity: Evidence of acquiring new technical domains to real depth, since this portfolio will expand under you.
  • Customer-facing composure: Proven ability to hold a technical conversation with a frustrated customer under real pressure, and to keep it factual and forward-moving.
  • Judgment about what generalizes: A track record of turning one-off solutions into reusable assets rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Public sector deployment experience: Direct work with PIV and CAC authentication, FedRAMP authorized environments, DoD networks, or government cloud regions.
  • Print infrastructure or output management background: Experience with enterprise print management, print protocols, or document output platforms.
  • Workflow automation platforms: Exposure to document workflow, process automation, or integration platforms.
  • Other regulated industry experience: Healthcare, financial services, or comparable environments with badge-based authentication, strict change control, or audit-driven constraints.
  • Cloud and endpoint breadth: Azure, AWS, or GCP, plus VDI platforms and endpoint management tooling.
  • Agentic AI acumen

  • On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.
Our Core Values

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

  • Disruptive Visionaries: Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
  • Relationship Builders: We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
  • Candor Seekers: Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
  • Action Owners: Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.
More about Vasion

jobs.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

As a Product Consultant in Kainos you will be responsible for your teams backlog maturity, taking ownership of features from inception through to delivery. You will drive MVP thinking and communicating the value of it with those in your team, the wider project team and relevant stakeholders. You will be a leader in your team, comfortable running agile ceremonies, encouraging engagement and discussion. You will plan and run workshops, engaging with a variety of stakeholders to facilitate consensus in areas of uncertainty. You will actively participate within the Product capability, supporting the delivery of initiatives. You will also manage, coach and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on managing employee performance.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Experience in bespoke software delivery, operating as a part of an agile team working for an external customer (experience in a client-facing role in a consulting environment is a must-have).
  • UK public sector experience (central government).
  • Experience of the software development lifecycle, involved from analysis through to acceptance, launch and live operations.
  • Excellent facilitator of workshops, able to lead stakeholder groups to achieve focused outcomes.
  • Accomplished at modelling As-is and To-be business processes, able to present these to stakeholders and the team to ensure understanding and to achieve buy-in.
  • Experience in stakeholder management, comfortable challenging decisions when appropriate and tailoring collaboration and communication styles where necessary
  • Responsible for the breakdown of an area of work from inception through to delivery, managing the team's backlog ensuring quality and maturity.
  • Responsible for the elicitation of functional, technical and non-functional requirements, translating these into user stories so they are easily understood across the whole team.
  • Ability to use prioritisation techniques to refine the backlog and manage dependencies.
  • Proven ability to manage scope to meet the required MVP, ensuring value is delivered.
  • Ability to work within commercial constraints for example cost restrictions and project deadlines.
  • Excellent user story writing skills, ensuring quality and consistency of stories across the project.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships both inside and outside of the delivery team, comfortable collaborating on the breakdown of an area into deliverable pieces of work.
  • Experience contributing to sales activities (e.g. working on bids, writing sales proposals etc.).
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and able to mentor those in your team as well as coaching our clients.
  • We are passionate about developing people – a demonstrated ability in managing, coaching and developing junior members of your team and wider community.
  • Experience of explaining technical jargon to non-technical/commercial teams.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Supplier Quality Engineer - Technical Specialist concentrates his/her product specific quality and technical skills to develop complex suppliers and products that can meet customer requirements; requires strong partnerships with the external supply base, with supply chain teams and with engineering to achieve results

Key Responsibilities:

Build strong relationships with all critical partners to improve quality and business outcomes, including: external suppliers, external customers, and internal customers and stakeholders, such as Purchasing, Manufacturing and Engineering; coach and mentor Cummins professionals on how to strengthen the soft skills required to develop effective relationships. Support the cross-functional development of external supply base strategies and the cross-functional supplier selection process for any given component; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products. Provide manufacturing consultation to external suppliers in order to design a Right First Time manufacturing process that enables conformance to the engineering print, engineering standards and customer specific requirements; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products. Apply industry common Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) processes, Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) tools, and Cummins specialty tools to develop zero defect components within the external supply base; coach and mentor Supplier and Cummins professionals on how to improve effectiveness of APQP execution; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products. Embrace continuous improvement in the external supply base by leading complex product and process focused projects that utilize industry proven methodologies, such as lean and six-sigma. Conduct external supplier audits in support of supplier risk mitigation, supplier readiness, and supplier performance improvement; coach and mentor Cummins professionals on how to improve auditing effectiveness. Lead increasingly complex quality improvement plans within the external supply base in order to improve supplier performance. Ensure resolution of increasingly complex external supplier related quality challenges, by leading root cause analysis, by supporting development of corrective actions and by verifying the effectiveness of corrective actions; coach and mentor Supplier and Cummins professionals on how to improve effectiveness of problem resolution.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Media Strategy & Excellence
jobs.excerpt: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back.
jobs.description:
Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.

We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

As the Senior Director, Media Strategy & Excellence, you are accountable for setting and leading the enterprise media strategy across Patient and HCP audiences, brands, indications, and lifecycle stages. You will establish how argenx uses media to connect customer needs and journeys with brand strategy, accelerate launch and growth priorities, and create relevant, measurable experiences across paid and emerging channels.

You will partner closely with the Vice President, Patient Experience; Brand and Indication Leads across Patient and HCP Marketing; Digital; Insights & Analytics; Customer Experience/CRM; Market Access; and agency partners to develop integrated media strategies that maximize the impact of argenx investments and strengthen the connection between media, customer engagement and commercial performance.

This role will establish the strategic direction, standards, operating practices and capabilities required to build media excellence across the organization. The Media Strategy & Excellence Lead will guide portfolio-level media decisions, agency and partner performance, measurement and optimization, audience strategy, data and technology enablement, and innovation across an evolving media landscape.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Media strategy and portfolio leadership

  • Set and lead the enterprise media strategy across Patient and HCP audiences, current and future brands, indications, and assets.
  • Translate enterprise, customer experience, brand and indication priorities into clear media strategies that advance customer engagement, launch readiness, brand performance, and patient impact.
  • Establish a portfolio-level view of media opportunities, customer needs, audience behaviors, channel dynamics, and investment priorities across argenx.
  • Guide media planning across the customer journey, from disease education and pre-launch engagement through branded activation, conversion, and ongoing customer engagement.
  • Set strategic principles and standards for how media is planned, activated, measured and optimized across the organization.
  • Partner with Brand and Indication Leads to determine the appropriate role of media within broader customer engagement and omnichannel strategies.
  • Guide investment choices and trade-offs across audiences, brands, indications, lifecycle stages, and channels to maximize portfolio impact.
  • Ensure media strategies reflect the distinct needs of individual brands and indications while identifying opportunities to create greater consistency, scale, and efficiency across the portfolio.
  • Bring a forward-looking media perspective into strategic planning, launch planning, and resource allocation discussions.
  • Serve as a senior advisor to the Vice President, Patient Experience and other Commercial leaders on media strategy, investment, performance, and emerging opportunities.

Integrated media planning, activation, and performance

  • Lead the development of integrated media strategies that connect Patient and HCP audience needs, customer journeys, brand objectives, creative strategy, channel roles, and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Brand, Patient Experience, HCP Experience, Digital, CRM and other teams to ensure media is integrated into broader customer engagement strategies rather than operating as a standalone channel.
  • Establish audience-first planning approaches that use customer insights, segmentation, and behavioral signals to guide media strategy and activation.
  • Guide the appropriate mix of channels and platforms across traditional, digital, programmatic, streaming, search, social, endemic, point-of-care, and emerging media environments.
  • Lead media strategy across pre-launch, launch, growth and lifecycle phases, adapting investment and engagement approaches based on business needs and in-market performance.
  • Establish clear media KPIs, measurement frameworks, and performance expectations linked to customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Insights & Analytics and agency teams to translate media performance into actionable insights that strengthen brand strategy, customer engagement, and future investment decisions.
  • Establish disciplined performance-review and optimization practices that enable timely decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure media insights are translated into clear, executive-ready narratives and recommendations for Brand, Indication, and senior Commercial leaders.
  • Partner with Digital and Analytics teams to ensure the media data, technology and measurement ecosystem supports effective activation, optimization, and performance evaluation.

Cross-functional, agency and ecosystem leadership

  • Serve as the senior media leader across the Commercial organization, bringing an integrated portfolio and customer perspective into planning and decision-making.
  • Build strong partnerships with Patient Experience, HCP Experience, Brand and Indication Leads, Digital, Insights & Analytics, CRM, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Procurement, and other relevant teams.
  • Lead the strategic relationship with media agencies and key external partners, establishing clear expectations for strategic quality, innovation, performance, transparency, and accountability.
  • Ensure agencies operate as strategic extensions of the argenx team while maintaining clear internal ownership of media strategy, data, and investment decisions.
  • Create effective ways of working across brand teams, shared capabilities, agencies, and external partners to improve planning, decision-making, and execution.
  • Partner with Procurement and Commercial leadership to ensure media investments and agency relationships deliver strong business value.
  • Identify opportunities to scale media best practices, shared approaches, and capabilities across brands, indications, and customer audiences.
  • Resolve cross-brand and cross-functional media priorities and trade-offs where enterprise or portfolio coordination is required.
  • Represent media strategy in relevant internal planning and leadership forums and with external strategic partners.
  • Model collaborative, agile, and non-hierarchical ways of working while maintaining clear accountability for media outcomes.

Media capability building and innovation

  • Define and advance the capabilities required to build a modern, high-performing media organization within argenx.
  • Establish enterprise media standards, frameworks, tools, and ways of working that improve strategic consistency while allowing teams to flex based on customer, brand, and market needs.
  • Build organizational understanding of audience strategy, channel roles, media performance, measurement, and optimization.
  • Maintain a forward-looking perspective on changes in customer behavior, media platforms, search, privacy, identity, data, technology, and regulation that may impact argenx media strategy.
  • Evaluate emerging media platforms, technologies, and partnerships and determine where innovation can create meaningful customer or business value.
  • Guide the responsible use of AI and automation to strengthen media planning, activation, optimization, measurement, and scalability.
  • Shape argenx's evolving approach to search discovery, including the implications of AI-powered search and emerging AEO/GEO environments for patient and HCP engagement.
  • Partner with Digital, Analytics, Legal, Privacy, and agency teams to ensure media capabilities evolve in a compliant, scalable, and future-ready manner.
  • Develop media talent and strengthen strategic media capabilities across internal teams and agency partners.
  • Foster a culture of customer-centricity, accountability, experimentation, learning, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Deep understanding of media strategy, planning, activation and performance across Patient/DTC and HCP audiences within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or similarly regulated healthcare environments.
  • Ability to develop enterprise and portfolio-level media strategies spanning multiple brands, indications, customer segments, and lifecycle stages.
  • Strong understanding of customer journeys, audience segmentation, omnichannel engagement, and the role media plays within an integrated customer experience.
  • Strategic understanding of the full media ecosystem, including traditional, digital, programmatic, search, social, streaming, endemic, point-of-care, and emerging channels.
  • Strong understanding of media investment strategy, portfolio prioritization, and the ability to make informed trade-offs across audiences, brands, and channels.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business, brand, and customer objectives into clear media strategies, investment priorities, and measurable performance expectations.
  • Strong analytical orientation and ability to use customer insights, media performance data, and business outcomes to inform decision-making and optimization.

  • Please always verify communications:

jobs.title: Network Automation & Reliability Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Overview Ontrac Solutions is seeking a Network Automation & Reliability Engineer to operate and automate hyperscale data center, backbone, and out-of-band (OOB) networks.
jobs.description:
Overview
Ontrac Solutions is seeking a Network Automation & Reliability Engineer to operate and automate hyperscale data center, backbone, and out-of-band (OOB) networks. This is a Python-first role: you will spend more of your week writing code that operates the network than typing on a CLI. You will build the tooling, telemetry pipelines, and self-healing automation that keep a global fleet of data centers and POP sites running, and you will carry the on-call pager for the systems you build.
We are looking for an engineer who is genuinely production-grade on both sides of the job — deep routing and switching fundamentals and real, sustained Python software work. Candidates who are strong on one side and thin on the other will not clear screening.
What your application must clearly show
We screen against the requirements below exactly as written — your resume should make these easy to find:

  • Python you actually wrote, described as software, not as a skills keyword.Name the project, what it did, roughly how large it was, and who used it. "Python (scripting)" in a skills list will not clear this bar.A GitHub, GitLab, or public repo link is strongly preferred— we look at code.
  • Thespecific Python network librariesyou have used in production — for example Netmiko, NAPALM, Nornir, pyATS/Genie, Scrapli, ncclient, or a vendor SDK — and what you built with each.
  • BGP in production at scale.Name the policy work: local preference, MED, communities, import/export policy, route reflection, ECMP, or multihoming across carriers.
  • Hands-on withat least twoof Arista EOS, Juniper Junos (QFX / SRX / PTX / MX), or Cisco IOS-XR / NX-OS — named by platform, not just by vendor.
  • Telemetry and observabilityyou implemented: gNMI/gRPC, OpenConfig, streaming telemetry, flow telemetry, or SNMP-to-TSDB pipelines. Say what you subscribed to and what you did with the data.
  • Config-as-code:Jinja2 templating, NETCONF/YANG or REST-API-driven provisioning, golden configs, ZTP, and the Git/CI workflow you shipped changes through.
  • Yournetworking certifications, named, with dates and credential IDs or verification links— we verify certifications.
  • Whether you have carriedproduction on-call, and at what scale (sites, devices, or POPs).

Shortly after you apply you will receive a short role-specific questionnaire — completing it promptly is the fastest way to move into screening.
Required Qualifications:

  • Python — primary requirement:Demonstrated, sustained Python development in a production network or infrastructure environment. You have written and maintained tooling that other engineers depended on: config generation and validation, API integrations, telemetry collectors, automated remediation, or test harnesses. You are comfortable with modules, packaging, testing, code review, and version control — not just single-file scripts.
  • Routing & switching depth:Production experience with BGP (policy, path selection, multihoming), plus IS-IS or OSPF, ECMP, and VXLAN/EVPN or MPLS overlays.
  • Multi-vendor hardware:Hands-on operations across at least two of Arista EOS, Juniper Junos (QFX/SRX/PTX/MX), or Cisco IOS-XR / NX-OS.
  • Automation frameworks:Ansible and Jinja2, plus NETCONF/YANG, RESTCONF, or vendor REST APIs for model-driven configuration management.
  • Telemetry & monitoring:gNMI/gRPC streaming telemetry, OpenConfig models, SNMP, flow telemetry, and dashboarding/alerting on top of them.
  • Linux:Comfortable operating on Linux hosts — networking stack, packet capture, systemd services, and shell scripting.
  • Version control and CI:Git-based workflows with peer review; experience shipping network changes through a pipeline (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions).
  • Production on-call:Experience holding a 24x7 rotation for a live network, including incident command and root cause analysis.
  • Experience level:Roughly 2–5 years in a network production, network reliability, or network automation role. Exceptional early-career engineers with a strong Python portfolio and hyperscale or carrier exposure are encouraged to apply.
  • Location & work authorization:Must be located in the United States and authorized to work in the US.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Out-of-band network experience — console server fleets (ZPE Nodegrid, OpenGear), RS-232 configuration management, or OOB build-out for new data center capacity.
  • Data center or POP build-out and turn-up: new product introduction (NPI) for switching platforms, port channelization and optics selection, cabling and rack density planning, or hardware qualification and stress testing.
  • MACsec, IPsec at scale, or zero-trust segmentation with 802.1X and NAC.
  • Optical or transport exposure — DWDM, Ciena, PON/OLT/ONU, or IXIA/Spirent test automation.
  • Building or contributing to a networksource of truth(NetBox or in-house) aggregating BGP, link-state, and drain-state data.
  • Applying LLM or agentic tooling to on-call workflows — automated triage, runbook execution, or incident summarization.
  • A master's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, or Computer Science.

Key Responsibilities — Network Automation & Tooling (primary focus):

  • Design, write, and maintain Python tooling that provisions, validates, and audits network devices across the global fleet.
  • Build model-driven provisioning libraries using Jinja2 templating with NETCONF/YANG or REST APIs to codify golden configurations and eliminate configuration drift.
  • Develop automated remediation for recurring failure classes — route flaps, hardware faults, optical degradation — triggered by syslog and telemetry.
  • Reduce operational toil: identify manual runbook steps that recur, and replace them with tested, reviewed code.

Key Responsibilities — Backbone, Data Center & Out-of-Band Operations:

  • Operate and scale data center fabrics, backbone links, and out-of-band management networks across a global footprint of data centers and POP sites.
  • Design and tune BGP policy — local preference, MED, communities, import/export policy, default-route propagation — to control path selection and eliminate single-carrier points of failure.
  • Support capacity expansion and site turn-ups: high-level design, port channelization, optics and cabling standards, and hardware qualification.
  • Execute zero-downtime change management in production, including hitless migrations and staged rollbacks.

Key Responsibilities — Telemetry, Observability & Reliability:

  • Operationalize multi-vendor streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, OpenConfig) and tune subscription jobs for signal quality and management-plane efficiency.
  • Build and maintain observability that supports hop-by-hop path tracing, multi-layer fault isolation, and fast root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to a real-time network source of truth aggregating BGP, link-state, and drain-state data.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation; lead incident response, write RCAs, and drive the follow-up automation that prevents recurrence.

Key Responsibilities — Security & Change Governance:

  • Maintain and optimize firewall and ACL policy across multi-vendor platforms, keeping rule sets scoped and performant.
  • Support SIRT/PSIRT CVE remediation through automated regression testing and config-as-code pipelines.
  • Author and maintain technical documentation — designs, runbooks, and API contracts — for the tooling and networks you own.
Salary: $75 – $85 / hour

GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S.Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information. Since 2011, GoodRx has helped consumers save nearly $75 billion on the cost of their prescriptions.

Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.

About this Role:

GoodRx is seeking an Implementation Manager - Data Solutions to join our Pharma Direct team. This role will sit at the intersection of program management, client implementation, and technical execution, with a focus on bringing complex data feeds to life for pharmaceutical and media agency partners.


The ideal candidate brings strong pharmacy claims-level data expertise and hands-on experience working with claims data, with the ability to understand how claims data is sourced, structured, analyzed, and translated into external-facing products and programs. They will also work with physician-level data (PLD) and should be comfortable understanding how provider-level data is structured, matched, and leveraged. They are equally comfortable driving discovery for technical requirements, managing timelines, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and gathering the technical details needed to launch and scale data integrations.


They bring a strong mix of pharmacy claims and physician-level data fluency, program leadership, technical acumen, and strategic prioritization, and can translate business needs into organized data execution plans across Product, Data Engineering, Analytics, Legal, Client Success, and Sales teams.


This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys building structure in ambiguous environments, driving launches from kickoff through go-live, and improving how teams deliver complex data solutions at scale.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end launches of pharmacy claims-level and physician-level data (PLD) integrations, from initial requirements through testing, go-live, and handoff, for pharmaceutical manufacturers and media agency partners
  • Apply strong claims data expertise to understand data sources, structures, specifications, matching, business rules, and downstream use cases, translating complex data requirements into clear implementation plans
  • Partner closely with Product, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Legal, Privacy, Client Success, and Sales to translate business and client needs into scalable, high-quality data solutions
  • Serve as the central point of coordination across internal teams and external partners, keeping data feed execution aligned, dependencies visible, decisions documented, and launches moving forward
  • Triage and drive resolution of high-priority or urgent data issues, coordinating across Client Success, Product, Data Engineering, Data Analytics and external partners to assess impact, determine next steps, and communicate status
  • Balance standardized data specifications and scalable processes with custom client requirements, helping the organization deliver tailored solutions without sacrificing data quality or operational discipline
  • Coordinate data-sharing requirements and contractual workflows across internal and external Legal, Privacy, and Data Security partners to ensure appropriate agreements and approvals are in place to provision data between parties
  • Drive continuous process improvements, documentation, templates and best practices that reduce time to launch feeds

Check Point Firewall Engineer

Contract Duration: 6 month contract

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced WAN, Check Point Firewall & Azure Networking Engineer to join our technology team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, implementation, administration, monitoring, troubleshooting and optimisation of enterprise network and security environments.

The role requires strong hands-on experience across WAN technologies, Check Point firewalls and Microsoft Azure networking, with a focus on network availability, performance, security and resilience.

Key Responsibilities

WAN & Network Infrastructure

  • Design, configure and support enterprise WAN and LAN network environments.
  • Manage WAN connectivity, routing and network performance.
  • Troubleshoot complex network connectivity and performance issues.
  • Configure and manage routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
  • Monitor network availability, capacity and performance.
  • Work with service providers to resolve connectivity and circuit-related incidents.
  • Support network changes, upgrades and migrations.
  • Ensure network infrastructure meets availability, performance and security requirements.

Check Point Firewall

  • Install, configure, administer and maintain Check Point firewalls.
  • Manage firewall policies, NAT, VPNs, access rules and security configurations.
  • Perform firewall rule reviews and optimisation.
  • Troubleshoot firewall and network security incidents.
  • Monitor firewall performance, logs and security events.
  • Implement security changes in accordance with change management processes.
  • Support high-availability firewall environments.
  • Ensure firewall configurations comply with organisational security standards.

Azure Networking

  • Design, implement and support Microsoft Azure networking environments.
  • Configure and manage:
  • Azure Virtual Networks (VNet)
  • Subnets
  • Network Security Groups (NSGs)
  • Azure Firewall
  • Route Tables / UDRs
  • VPN Gateway
  • ExpressRoute
  • Load Balancers
  • Private Endpoints
  • VNet Peering
  • Support hybrid connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and Azure.
  • Troubleshoot Azure network connectivity and routing issues.
  • Assist with Azure network migrations and cloud transformation initiatives.
  • Implement secure and scalable Azure network architectures.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with WAN technologies and enterprise networking.
  • Strong Check Point Firewall administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Strong Microsoft Azure Networking experience.
  • Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN and network security.
  • Experience with BGP, OSPF and routing protocols.
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • Understanding of high availability and disaster recovery principles.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of network security principles and best practices.

Qualifications & Certifications

  • Relevant degree, diploma or technical qualification in IT, Networking or a related field.
  • Check Point certification such as CCSA/CCSE would be advantageous.
  • Microsoft Azure networking certification such as AZ-700 would be advantageous.
  • Cisco certification such as CCNA/CCNP would be beneficial.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a production environment.
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a technical team.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL and change management processes.
  • Excellent attention to detail and security awareness.

Experience

  • 8+ years' experience in enterprise networking and infrastructure.
  • Proven experience supporting WAN environments.
  • Strong hands-on Check Point Firewall experience.
  • Strong experience with Azure Networking and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience working in large, complex enterprise environments is advantageous.

Self-sufficiency is the core qualification. This person supports concept development and shoot planning, then owns execution. They know when a project warrants a full production and when a lightweight approach is the smarter creative choice. If a project calls for it, they can coordinate internal crew resources or lead and manage external vendor support — managing the production, running the set, and owning the visual execution.


This person should jump in wherever needed, bring others into the process, and help educate and elevate the team. This role cares about making great work, whether the task is big or small, and is always looking for ways to improve both the output and the process. Above all, this person is collaborative, entrepreneurial, positive, and kind.


We're not just building the engine, we're inventing one as well.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Position Summary

The Quality Engineer develops and executes test plans, performs exploratory and automated testing, and builds and maintains automated tests for the Evolent Platform web user experience. Working in an Agile, globally dispersed team, this role partners with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand requirements and expected agent behavior, surface quality issues early, and report clearly on quality status.

This individual works with minimal supervision on assigned features, actively learning and adopting the testing methods, automation frameworks, and patterns defined for the role and by the team. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate testing and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on test design and solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning and Execution

  • Develop, document, and execute test plans and test cases for assigned features.
  • Perform exploratory and automated testing to ensure software functionality, reliability, and performance.
  • Conduct regression testing to ensure new code does not adversely impact existing functionality.
  • Collaborate with development teams to understand requirements, expected agent behavior, and human-in-the-loop flows, and identify potential quality issues early.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning, and contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s test systems.

Test Automation and CI/CD

Technology Director — Global Health


ICF's Global Health and Development (GHD) line of business, part of the Health, People, and Human Services (HPHS) Group, is seeking a Technology Director to lead technology modernization efforts across various global health and survey programs. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will own delivery of the program's technology work from end to end. You will also serve as one of its technical leads and architects, designing systems yourself as well as directing the team that builds them. You will bridge ICF's applied AI and software engineers with its survey methodologists, statisticians, field operations staff, and country partners. You will be accountable to the funder for results, including the decision to redirect work that isn't performing and move the funding to work that is.


This position can be remote within the United States, with occasional international travel.


It is contingent upon award of program funding.


Key Responsibilities


Technology Modernization Delivery Leadership

  • Own delivery of the program's AI innovation portfolio. The workstreams cover automated data-to-report production, natural-language data access, multilingual questionnaire design, field data quality, and new measurement approaches.
  • Run the stage-gate process. Lead go/no-go reviews, and make and defend decisions to stop workstreams, publish what they learned, and reallocate their funding.
  • Serve as the principal technical counterpart to the funder. Lead progress reporting and learning reviews. Communicate results candidly, including negative ones.
  • Manage the innovation portfolio, schedule, and risks with the project manager, including inference and cloud operating costs.
  • Coordinate across global development programs. Share successes, failures, and methods with technology partners to avoid duplicating work.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Act as technical lead and architect for a cluster of workstreams. Own their system design, write the design documents, and stay hands-on through prototyping and production.
  • Define acceptance criteria before the work is judged. With survey experts, set the quantitative quality thresholds each tool must meet, and hold the team (and yourself) to them.
  • Set architecture and standards across the portfolio: model selection and routing, privacy-preserving design, offline and low-connectivity deployment, and security.
  • Set engineering practice for the team, including specification-driven development with agentic coding tools, evaluation-first delivery, code review, and testing.
  • Protect data quality and comparability. Work with survey methodologists so that no innovation breaks the comparability of data across countries and over time.
  • Oversee responsible AI, data governance, and ethics. Make sure the program meets ICF security standards, IRB requirements, and partner-country data sovereignty expectations.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and mentor the program's technology team, including applied AI, software, ML, and platform engineers.
  • Bridge technology and survey expertise. Make sure survey methodologists, statisticians, and field teams shape what gets built, and that engineers understand how surveys work.
  • Work with national statistical offices and ministries of health, together with ICF's country engagement leads, to design tools that countries want and can run on their own.
  • Share the program's results openly through public documentation, publications, and presentations at technical and global health conferences.
  • Contribute to business growth efforts including proactive engagement with potential clients, preparation of white papers, and proposal development.

Minimum Required Experience

  • Bachelors degree in IT, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum 10 years of professional experience designing and delivering technology solutions, including hands-on architecture of multiple complex systems taken into production
  • Minimum 5 years leading and mentoring software or data engineering teams to build products or deploy systems

Additional Required Skills and Experience

  • A track record of architecting and delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered systems in production, and the ability to explain how their quality was measured and where they failed
  • Experience leading a multi-workstream technology program for a foundation, donor, or government client, with accountability for budget and results
  • Deep knowledge of system architecture, data pipelines, software development methods, and at least one major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
  • Hands-on familiarity with agentic coding tools and specification-driven development, and experience setting how a team uses them
  • U.S. citizenship is required by federal government contract

Preferred Skills

  • Working proficiency in French or Portuguese
  • Background in survey operations or data collection, such as work on or with the Demographic & Health Surveys (DHS) Program, Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS), Living Standards Measurement Study (LSMS), a national census, or other population-based household surveys
  • Experience delivering technology for global health or international development programs in low- and middle-income countries
  • Experience with field data-collection systems for low-connectivity settings (e.g., e, c, ODK), or with offline or edge deployment
  • Experience working with national statistical offices or ministries of health
  • Experience leading a stage-gated R&D or innovation portfolio, including a decision to stop a workstream
  • Experience setting and being held to quantitative acceptance thresholds for an AI or data system
  • Experience with multi-country deployments where data cannot leave a jurisdiction, and with data privacy and governance for human data, including IRB processes
  • Experience with cybersecurity practices, security controls, and authorization processes
  • Publications or conference presentations in AI, survey methods, or global health
  • Advanced degree in computer science, statistics, demography, public health, or a related field

Professional Skills

  • Credible with both engineers and executives. Can lead a technical design review in the morning and brief a funder's leadership in the afternoon
  • Sound judgment under uncertainty. Can tell a workstream that is late from one that isn't going to work, and acts on it

Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About The Role
The AR Collections Specialist owns collections for an assigned segment of Stord's customer accounts, working proactively ahead of due dates rather than only chasing past-due balances. You'll manage outreach and follow-up cadences, resolve disputes, and track promises-to-pay while building strong customer relationships that keep cash flowing. You'll partner closely with AR & Cash Operations and the Credit & Collections leadership team, and help shape the tools and processes the team relies on as it scales.

This role is remote and will require intermittent travel to our onsite office in Atlanta, GA.

What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day collections for an assigned segment of accounts, working proactively ahead of due dates rather than only chasing past-due balances.
  • Run outreach and follow-up cadences by phone and email, and log every touch so the team has an accurate view of coverage.
  • Track promises-to-pay, follow up on commitments, and escalate accounts that drift into high-risk territory.
