  • Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions

  • Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers

  • Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process

  • Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes

  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

The Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.

About Teamified:

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

About the client:

Our client is an innovative Australian health technology company developing an AI-powered anxiety coaching application based on an evidence-based psychological approach to managing anxiety.

The application is designed for iOS and Android using React Native, with a React-based website supporting user registration and subscriptions. Currently in the testing phase and approaching its soft launch, the platform features an AI-powered coaching assistant that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver structured, personalised coaching conversations.

The AI Coach operates within a clinically guided framework, incorporating structured coaching pathways, a toolkit of resources, conversational guidelines, and built-in safety mechanisms that can intervene when necessary.

As the platform handles sensitive mental health information, security, privacy, and responsible AI development are central to its design and ongoing operation.

About the role:

We are hiring one person to own the product's engineering end-to-end. You will be the technical owner of the AI Coach and the systems around it, reporting directly to a non-technical founder. You plan your own work, set your own technical direction within the product brief, and ship. There is no CTO above you and no agency to lean on - you are the engineering function, working at speed with AI-first tooling and agentic coding workflows.

  • Own the AI Coach: prompting, conversation state and progression, retrieval (Pinecone), model selection and evaluation, and the safety/crisis layer - tested against scripted clinical scenarios
  • Own the backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry), SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, AWS (Sydney)
  • Own mobile and web delivery: React Native (iOS + Android) and React, including App Store / Google Play / Stripe subscriptions
  • Own release engineering: CI/CD, environments, signing credentials, monitoring, backups, rollback - built for fast, safe, frequent releases
  • Bring a product eye: you care how screens look and feel on mobile and web, not just whether the API returns 200
  • Translate technical decisions into plain language for the founder and clinical team

How you work (this is the core of the role):

You are an AI-first engineer. You use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code or equivalent) as your default workflow - planning, generating, reviewing and shipping with AI leverage rather than writing everything by hand. You build evaluation harnesses so the AI Coach can be tested automatically against scenario suites on every change. You are a self-starter who takes a brief, breaks it into a plan, communicates the plan, executes it, and reports outcomes - with direction from the founder but without needing technical supervision.

  • Plan -> Approve -> Deliver: you propose the plan, get sign-off on direction, and own execution
  • Comfortable being the only engineer initially: you learn the system from the code (there is limited as-built documentation) and make it yours
  • Bias to shipping: small, frequent, reversible releases with monitoring and rollback in place
  • Judgement over heroics: this is a mental health product - safety thresholds and crisis handling are governed by legal and clinical sign-off, and you build the systems that enforce them

Requirements

  • Proven experience shipping LLM-based products to production: prompt architecture, conversation state machines, RAG/retrieval, evals, moderation and safety handling - not just API calls
  • Strong backend engineering: Python, FastAPI (or similar), SQL/PostgreSQL, AWS; comfortable owning infrastructure, CI/CD and production operations solo
  • Solid React Native and React: can ship and debug on both iOS and Android, including in-app purchase flows on both stores and Stripe on web
  • Demonstrated AI-first development practice: daily use of agentic coding tools, with the judgement to review and own what they produce
  • Product sensibility: a genuine eye for mobile and web UX; you notice broken layouts, bad copy and clumsy flows, and fix them
  • Self-sufficient operator: track record of owning a product or major system end-to-end with minimal technical oversight; excellent written communication for a non-technical founder
  • Care with sensitive data: experience (or demonstrable seriousness) with privacy, security and access controls around personal/health data

Nice to have:

  • Experience in mental health, health tech or other regulated/safety-critical consumer products
  • Experience taking over a codebase from an agency or departing team
  • Mobile release operations: App Store / Play Store review cycles, promo codes, staged rollouts
  • Analytics and growth tooling: AppsFlyer, GA4, event taxonomy design, experiment frameworks
  • Voice features (TTS/STT), push notification strategy, CRM/email platform integrations

Our stack:

Backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry), SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL. Mobile: React Native. Web: React. Hosting: AWS Sydney. AI: OpenAI (plus OpenAI Moderation), Pinecone vector DB. Mobile services: Firebase. Payments: App Store, Google Play, Stripe. Analytics: AppsFlyer, GA4, Meta Pixel. Code: Bitbucket. Admin: SQLAdmin-based panel.

Reporting and working style:

You report directly to the founder, who is not technical. You will get clear product direction, fast decisions and clinical/legal guardrails from the Founders team - and full ownership of how it gets built. You plan and manage your own process and keep the founder informed in plain language: what you're doing, why, what it costs, and when it lands.

  • A collaborative, no-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
  • A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input

If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Apply now!

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:


Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly Saks Global, is the luxury collective uniting coveted brands with unrivaled customer experiences across Neiman Marcus, Saks Fifth Avenue and Bergdorf Goodman. Job Description:


WHO WE ARE:

Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly Saks Global, is the luxury collective uniting coveted brands with unrivaled customer experiences across Neiman Marcus, Saks Fifth Avenue and Bergdorf Goodman. Driven by a relentless devotion to our customers and powered by our talented colleagues, we offer expertly curated product assortments, unparalleled service and personalized experiences across our integrated retail model. Through strong partnerships with the world's most desired luxury brands and deep customer relationships enhanced by data-rich insights, Exemplar Luxury Group is committed to setting the standard of excellence for luxury retail.


Visit exemplarluxurygroup.com for more information, and follow Exemplar Luxury Group on LinkedIn.


YOU WILL BE:

The Manager, Cross Category eCommerce is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the global site merchandising vision, optimizing the digital conversion funnel, and elevating the end-to-end customer journey across all device types. Operating at the intersection of commercial strategy, digital user experience, and technology, this individual architects global site turnover initiatives, leads end-to-end promotional campaign strategies, and oversees site discovery; continuously auditing search, PLP performance, and product recommendations. As a core people leader, the Manager directly mentors and guides two digital specialists, translating overarching strategy into seamless daily execution. Anchored in data-driven decision-making, this role partners closely with Category Growth, Product Management, Creative, Marketing, and Leadership to champion a site experience that eliminates friction, maximizes conversion rates, and drives sustainable top-line revenue.


WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Develop and Execute Site Merchandising Strategy: Define and implement a comprehensive global site merchandising strategy that aligns with overall business goals, category strategies, and marketing initiatives to maximize online sales, conversion rates, and average order value. Lead global site turnover initiatives.
  • Lead & Manage Specialists: Directly manage, mentor, and develop two digital specialists. Establish operational workflows, delegate tasks effectively, and guide their daily execution to bring site strategies and promotional blueprints to life.
  • Promotional Strategy, Execution & Governance: Architect end-to-end promotional content and navigation strategies for promotional events across all device types. Work cross-functionally with creative and marketing to bring your strategy to life across site placements, product tagging, and site navigation. Own quarterly review process to continuously refine promotional placements, creative content, and the sale site experience.
  • Search, PLP & Discovery Experience Monitoring: Continuously audit live site search, PLP performance, and navigation across device types to identify friction points and critical issues. Partner closely with the product team to route fixes, advocate for enhancements, and influence the site experience.
  • Conversion Funnel Management & Optimization: Maintain holistic ownership of the end-to-end digital conversion funnel. Analyze customer drop-off points from landing through checkout, championing A/B testing and UX enhancements to improve discovery, recommendation relevance, and checkout conversion.
  • Contribute to Website Enhancements: Provide input and collaborate with the ecommerce and technology teams on website enhancements and features that will improve the overall online shopping experience and support merchandising goals.
  • Manage and Optimize Product Recommendations: Implement and optimize product recommendation engines to personalize the shopping experience and drive cross-selling and up-selling opportunities.
  • Analyze Data & Generate Actionable Insights: Utilize website analytics platforms (Adobe Analytics, Tableau, Looker) and performance data to evaluate site health, promotional performance, and discovery effectiveness, presenting findings and strategic recommendations to leadership.
  • Report on Site Merchandising Performance: Regularly communicate site merchandising performance, key findings, and recommendations to leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Stay Informed of Industry Best Practices: Continuously research and stay updated on the latest ecommerce trends, site merchandising techniques, and competitive landscape to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

Required Qualifications:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in e-commerce, site merchandising, or digital business management.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful site merchandising strategies that have driven measurable improvements in online sales and key performance indicators.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex data to identify trends, draw conclusions, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Deep understanding of ecommerce best practices, user experience principles, and online customer behavior.
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and develop a team.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint) and/or Google Suite (Sheets, Slides).
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies and tools.
  • Knowledge of SEO principles as they relate to product presentation and discoverability is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with website analytics tools (Adobe Analytics) and reporting platforms.
  • Familiarity with ecommerce platforms (Salesforce Commerce Cloud) and their merchandising functionalities.
  • Experience with personalization and recommendation engines.

  • Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate

About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Presales Solutions Engineer – VMware is responsible for providing technical expertise around VMware and related technologies. They will take a consultative approach to customer initiatives and have a holistic understanding of modern application platforms and ecosystem technologies that enable business outcomes.  They will qualify and communicate the value of VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) and its technologies throughout the sales and adoption process. The Solutions Engineer will also develop and deliver new offerings to address customer requests and opportunities.

This remote position may be required to report to the office in Austin, Texas, as required for business needs and as determined by SHI management.

Role Description

  • Lead the technical presales engagement and own the technical strategy, execution, and opportunity through the sales cycle.
  • Engage with customers and design VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) private cloud solutions, guiding them to successful outcomes as a subject matter expert (SME). 
  • Collaborate with clients to identify VCF opportunities.
  • Collaboration with multiple layers of contacts within client organizations, including but not limited to CIO, CTO, Infrastructure, and procurement to strengthen our overall customer relationship and better understand the goals and objectives they are trying to achieve.
  • Assess existing IT environments, utilize RVTools and other tools, and provide comprehensive analysis and recommendations for software and hardware.
  • Provide comprehensive technical overviews, planning and guidance for understanding VMware Cloud Foundation’s components (VCF Operations, VSAN, NSX, Vsphere, VCF Automation, Live Recovery, vDefend, VKS and others) and requirements.
  • Create and present presentations and proposals as required by the sales process and customer objectives.
  • Discuss and model the financial investment of VCF, assess customer maturity, and present findings to the customers.
  •  Identify trends and deliver solutions that resolve challenges across multiple VMware products.
  • Identify, determine, and resolve complex technical and operational challenges the customer may experience.
  • Strong communications and interpersonal skills with an ability to read complex customer situations and adapt as needed.
  • Collaborate and work with sales teams on meeting objectives.
  • Provide consistent and actionable communications and adapt to complex customer situations as needed.
  • Staying current on new technology, trends, and market behavior by studying market trends and the industry landscape.
  • Engaging in self-study and independent work in lab facilities to increase job-related knowledge and skills.
  • Developing collateral to assist with organizational sales and technical engagements.
  • Understand the company’s services offerings in all solution practice areas by attending company training and expanding knowledge through self-study.
  • Educate sales teams on VMware and other solution offerings.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Presenting: Can design and deliver engaging presentations, adapting the content and style to suit the audience, context, and medium.
  • Negotiation: Can proactively seek out negotiation opportunities, initiate discussions, and contribute to conflict resolution.
  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences and can facilitate effective communication between others.
  • Detail-Oriented: Can manage complex tasks or projects, identifying errors or inconsistencies, and ensuring all details are addressed, necessary corrections are made, and quality is maintained.
  • Organization: Can effectively coordinate multiple projects, delegate tasks where appropriate, and employ advanced organizational tools and methods.
  • Follow-Up: Can proactively identify tasks that require follow-up, initiate necessary actions, and contribute to efficient workflow management.
  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify potential problems, initiate preventive measures, and propose and contribute to innovative solutions.
  • Relationship Building: Can proactively seek out opportunities to expand networks, initiate collaborations, and contribute to team cohesion.
  • Documentation: Can develop comprehensive documentation standards, implement best practices, and ensure documentation supports operational efficiency.
  • Results Orientation: Can set challenging goals for their team and lead them to achieve these goals, demonstrating a consistent track record of results.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of VCF and its underlying solutions including VCF Operations, VSAN, NSX, Vsphere, VCF Automation, Live Recovery, vDefend  - Intermediate
  • Ability to effectively communicate and sell complex technical products or services by understanding customer needs, articulating the value proposition, and providing technical expertise to support the sales process - Intermediate

Other Requirements

  • Completed Bachelor’s Degree or relevant work experience required
  • 5+ years of experience in a technical role
  • 5+ years experience with VMware Vsphere and related technologies preferred; VMware Cloud Foundation implementation experience and familiarity with VCF topology models
  • 3+ years of experience in a presales role
  • Travel to client locations required up to 20%, for customer meetings, internal meetings or engagements, travel to customer or partner sites, conferences, and SHI offices
  • Extended hours are required to complete some special projects
  • Advanced Certifications such as VCAP-DCV Design and Deploy Certification (minimum) or VCDX -DCV certification (optional)
  • Relevant professional certifications in related OEM categories including but not limited to Networking, Storage, GitOps/DevOps, Automation, Infrastructure/Containers, etc.

jobs.excerpt: If you love creating content, building communities and connecting with people who live and breathe social media, at Metricool you will be able to do it in German and French, as part of a team that shares that passion.
jobs.description:
If you love creating content, building communities and connecting with people who live and breathe social media, at Metricool you will be able to do it in German and French, as part of a team that shares that passion.

You can work 100% remotely in an international, fast-growing company where all the team members love to create, work in teams, analyze, and help social media managers make their work easier. Metricool helps professionals and businesses around the world save time and get better results on social media.

Your mission will be to bring Metricool closer to social media managers, agencies and businesses in German- and French-speaking markets. You will join our Social Media team, which sets the global content plan, and help make it work in German and French: adapting our content so it truly connects with local audiences, creating and recording your own pieces, and taking care of our community every day.

In this position, you will be able to have a wonderful contribution and impact in different areas:

As a Content Creator & Social Media Manager,

  • Community management: Be the daily voice of Metricool in German and French on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube: reply to comments and messages, moderate conversations, and flag product questions and feedback to the right teams.

  • Content localization:Adapt our English and Spanish posts into German and French and schedule them in Metricool, localizing hooks, examples, references and CTAs so they feel native instead of translated word by word.

  • Editorial calendar:Keep the German and French editorial calendars up to date, aligned with the Social Media Team Leader and the global content plan.

  • On-camera content:Record videos in German (and in French, if your level allows it): short videos for social every week and long-form videos for YouTube every month. You will adapt the scripts and review the edits for language accuracy.

  • Market insights:Spot local trends, formats and competitors in DACH and French-speaking markets and bring fresh ideas to the social plan.

  • Growth support:Support the Growth team’s German influencer campaigns and Ads with content and language review.

As a Team Member,

  • Work closely with the Social Media, YouTube and Growth teams and our video editor to make sure every German and French piece is aligned with Metricool’s goals.

  • Become the go-to reference for the DACH market inside the Content and Growth teams.

  • Share ideas, learnings and best practices in team brainstorming sessions.

Long story short: How will your first days in Metricool look like?

  • First month: You will get to know our product, our brand voice, our tools and the team. You will start taking over German and French community management, as well as the adaptation and scheduling of posts.

  • First quarter: You will own the German and French calendars end to end, with your weekly and monthly German videos up and running. You will start bringing your own local ideas to the social plan.

  • To the moon: Our German channels will work as a truly localized channel, not a translation, and you will be the DACH reference for the Content and Growth teams.

Job requirements

You’ll be successful on your mission if you have:

  • Based in Spain.

  • Experience: At least 2 years of experience in content creation or social media management.

  • Experience in community management, or a clear interest in it.

  • Experience creating B2B or SaaS content for the German market is highly valued.

Education:Degree in Marketing, Communication, Journalism or a related field is a plus.

Languages:

  • Native German, with excellent writing skills.

  • Advanced English (C1), our team’s working language.

  • French is a strong plus: a native or high C1 level would allow you to record in French too, while a B2–C1 level is enough for community management and post adaptation.

Hard skills:

  • Strong copywriting in German for social media: hooks, captions, CTAs and comment replies, with the ability to adapt to an established brand voice.

  • Natural on-camera presence in German. Experience recording for social media or YouTube is a plus.Good knowledge of LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube and their formats and trends.

  • A portfolio of posts, content examples or social accounts you have managed is a nice to have.

Soft skills:

  • Proactivity and initiative: you don’t wait to be told what to do and you bring your own ideas.

  • Autonomy and sound judgment, as you will be working in languages that nobody else on the team speaks.

  • Organization and time management to handle two languages across three networks.

  • Cultural sensitivity to adapt tone, references and messages to each market.

  • Collaborative attitude to work remotely in an international team.

Why will you fall in love with Metricool?

  • Remote Work Environment: Team members have the flexibility to work from any location of their choice in Spain. All processes are designed to accommodate remote work, fostering inclusivity and communication through platforms like Slack or Google Meet. The company provides a Windows or Mac laptop.

  • 100% Flexible Schedule: We advocate for a flexible work schedule, allowing you to organize your time as preferred, as long as you can collaborate properly with your team.

  • Annual Meetups:Once a year, we organize gatherings to bring the team together, fostering camaraderie and mutual understanding.

  • Health Insurance.

  • Competitive Salary: We are actively working to align our budgets with market standards, offering highly competitive salary packages. For this position we estimate between 30.000€ and 40.000€ (annually), depending on the candidate’s experience.

  • Professional Development Plan: Recognizing the desire for personal growth, we provide guidance and support to our team members on their professional journey.

  • Language Lessons: As an international company with team members fluent in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, or Italian, we believe in breaking barriers through language learning.

What are the steps of the hiring process?

  • First interview (30 minutes) with Alba from our People department, to know each other, know more about the company and our culture, the position and the team, and see if your background and aspirations fit the profile.

  • Second interview (45–60 minutes) with Ana, our Content Team Manager, and Almendra, one of our Social Media Managers, to talk about your experience, your ideas for the German market and your approach to community management. Feel free to share any portfolio, posts or accounts you have worked on!

  • Language interview with Lea, a German native speaker from our team, to confirm your German level (and a short French check, if applicable).

If you are excited about the things that you just read, don’t hesitate to apply for the job position!

jobs.description:
You will be reporting on technical subject matter such as malware developments, offensive security tools, vulnerability exploits, cloud security, and mobile security. Cyber Threat Analysts are expected to familiarize themselves with these topics continuously, identifying threat leads from a variety of sources. Cyber Threat Analysts are also expected to analyze malware and create effective detections, which their senior peers will review and validate. Cyber Threat Analysts must be able to communicate this subject matter effectively to various audiences, both verbally and in writing.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Threat Lead Identification: Research new adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using open sources (public information such as security vendor reporting, social media, code repositories); closed sources (dark web and underground forums); and proprietary sources.
  • Subject Matter: Threat leads should focus on team priority intelligence requirements (PIRs). Examples of such subject matter include malware developments, offensive security tools, vulnerability exploits, cloud security, and mobile security.
  • Key Detail Identification: During research, identify and take note of infection chains, host and network IoCs, malware samples, threat actors, and MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques
  • Author Insikt Notes: Write TTP Instances detailing identified threat leads. TTP Instances include a combination of information from open-source reporting and your own analysis (i.e. code review, static malware analysis). TTP Instances are written and formatted to help our customers understand infection chains while also helping them prepare and validate their defenses.
  • Cadence: Write at least 2 TTP Instance notes daily.
  • Quality: Authored TTP Instances should include minimal grammatical or syntax errors. Plagiarism is not acceptable.
  • Malware Analysis: Using sandbox environments and static analysis tools, analyze malware samples associated with threat leads.
  • Use Cases: Malware analysis is used to provide additional insight into an event, validate open-source reporting, uncover additional IoCs, and assist peers and customers in detection engineering.
  • Detection Engineering: Create malware or vulnerability detections (e.g. YARA, Sigma, Snort, Nuclei) that can be used for threat hunting, detection, and classification.
  • Cadence: Create at least 1 malware or vulnerability detection per month
  • Delivery: In most cases, these detections will be delivered alongside a TTP Instance.
  • Information Security: Adhere to and implement quality and information security policies and carry out its processes and procedures accordingly.

Required Skills:

  • Strong written communication in English
  • Demonstrable experience writing reports on technical subject matter (e.g. malware,
    vulnerability exploits, offensive security tools) in a clear, concise, and logical format
  • Disciplined time management
  • Self-starting, self-motivated, and thrive in a collaborative environment
  • Ability to receive and apply constructive feedback from peers and leadership

Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. equivalent in computer science, information systems, or cyber intelligence
  • At least one (1) year professional experience, Malware Analysis & Technical Writing
  • Technical proficiency in Cyber Threat Intelligence and Threat Intelligence Platforms
  • Experience working with open-source intelligence (OSINT) and/or large data sets
  • Experience working with sandboxes, virtual machines, or other malware analysis
    tools
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK Framework, including the ability map reported
    activity to ATT&CK tactics and techniques
  • Familiarity with interpreting and mapping cyberattacks to the Diamond Model of
    Intrusion Analysis
  • Adeptness in cybersecurity and data protection

Good-To-Have Skills:

  • Proficiency in scripting or programming languages (PHP, C, C#, C++, Python, PowerShell, Go, JavaScript, Rust)
  • Experience creating malware detections (e.g. YARA, Sigma, Snort)
  • Experience creating vulnerability detections (e.g. Nuclei)

We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. About the Role:

Build the Future of Learning:

Are you passionate about building reliable, scalable software and using automation to transform how engineering teams develop and deliver high-quality products? Do you enjoy solving complex technical problems, building frameworks and developer tooling, and creating systems that catch problems before they ever reach customers?

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer specializing in quality, automation, and engineering enablement. You’ll work alongside software engineers, architects, product managers, and technical leaders to build reliable software, develop scalable automation capabilities, strengthen engineering practices, and make quality an integral part of software architecture and development.


This is not a traditional QA role. You’ll be an engineer embedded within the development organisation, writing production-quality code and automation, designing frameworks and tooling, influencing architecture and testability, and helping teams build systems that are easier to validate, operate, scale, and evolve.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and build software, frameworks, tools, and automation that improve product quality and engineering efficiency.
  • Develop scalable automated testing capabilities across APIs, services, integrations, user interfaces, distributed systems, and end-to-end workflows.
  • Build and evolve automation frameworks and shared engineering capabilities that can be reused across teams and applications.
  • Partner with software engineers during architecture, design, and development to improve system testability, reliability, resiliency, and maintainability.
  • Define technical approaches for test infrastructure, automated environments, test data, mocks, service virtualization, and dependency management.
  • Integrate automation deeply into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast, reliable, and actionable feedback throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Investigate complex defects, automation failures, and production issues; perform root-cause analysis; and develop solutions that prevent recurrence.

  • Lead technical discussions and influence engineering standards related to automation, software quality, reliability, testing strategy, and continuous delivery.
  • Explore and apply AI-assisted engineering approaches to areas such as test generation, intelligent automation, failure analysis, coverage analysis, defect detection, and engineering productivity.
  • Evaluate emerging AI-enabled development and automation tools, frameworks, and patterns and determine where they can meaningfully improve speed, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Mentor engineers and help raise automation, software quality, and engineering capabilities across the organization.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to a highly collaborative engineering culture.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong software engineering experience with significant hands-on experience designing and building automated testing solutions.
  • Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Python, or similar.
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automation frameworks using technologies such as Playwright, Cypress,
  • Selenium, or comparable tools.
  • Strong experience testing APIs, backend services, integrations, data flows, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern software architecture and the ability to understand complex interactions across applications, services, infrastructure, and data layers.
  • Strong understanding of unit, component, contract, integration, API, and end-to-end testing strategies.
  • Ability to make sound engineering decisions about what should be tested, where it should be tested, and which level of automation provides the most value.
  • Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery workflows.
  • Experience debugging complex systems and performing root-cause analysis across application, service, data, infrastructure, and automation layers.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, maintainability, testability, observability, and engineering best practices.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, pull-request workflows, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience contributing to engineering architecture, technical design, or platform-level decisions.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools, AI frameworks, agents, or AI-enabled automation, or a strong interest in experimenting with emerging AI-driven engineering approaches.
  • Curiosity about how AI can improve software development, automation, test generation, failure analysis, defect detection, and engineering productivity.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB, MySQL, observability platforms, and DevOps practices is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, architects, product teams, and technical leadership.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, as you’ll collaborate with an international engineering organization.

Why Join Us?

  • Build technology that has a meaningful impact on learners around the world.
  • Solve challenging engineering problems involving automation, distributed systems, reliability, scalability, and software quality.
  • Help define modern quality engineering practices where quality is an engineering responsibility—not a separate phase of development.
  • Build frameworks, tools, and infrastructure that make entire engineering teams faster and more effective.
  • Explore how AI and emerging automation technologies can transform the way software is developed, tested, analyzed, and delivered.
  • Work with modern cloud platforms, CI/CD systems, automation technologies, distributed architectures, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  • Influence technical direction, architecture, engineering standards, and development practices.
  • Collaborate with talented engineers, architects, product leaders, and technology teams across the globe.
  • Be part of a culture that values engineering excellence, ownership, experimentation, continuous learning, and meaningful customer impact.

If you’re a software engineer who enjoys building the systems behind great software—the automation, tooling, infrastructure, and engineering

practices that make products easier to test, safer to change, and more reliable in production—and you’re excited about how AI can push those capabilities even further, we’d love to hear from you.

For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.

jobs.description:
Sustainability in the NHS

Course Developer and Skills Coach

Permanent, full-time | Remote within the UK
Salary: up to £37,500 per annum, dependent on experience

Start date: Available for an immediate start

Closing date: Monday 19th October

(We may close this advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. We encourage early applications.)

Bring your NHS experience into learning

Have you worked in the NHS and helped turn sustainability commitments into practical action? This is an opportunity to use that experience to shape relevant learning for NHS colleagues and support them as a Skills Coach.

Direct experience of working within the NHS is essential for this appointment. We will prioritise candidates who bring practical NHS sustainability, procurement or related operational experience, as this is the expertise we are looking to add to our team.

Join KnowledgeBrief

KnowledgeBrief is an apprenticeship and training provider helping people and organisations build the skills they need across business management. Our expertise spans leadership and management, digital, and business and professional services. Through apprenticeships, professional qualifications, workshops and coaching, we connect learning to real work, helping people make better decisions, lead change and improve organisational performance.

Our vision is a future where every organisation can turn learning into measurable performance through confident people, modern leadership and practical capability. We bring together specialist expertise, our own learning technology and personalised support to help people apply what they learn and make a meaningful difference in their roles.

We are a values-driven organisation: inspirational, innovative and authentic, with relationships at the heart of how we work. Joining KnowledgeBrief means being part of a team that values the joy of learning and cares about the impact we create for our learners, clients and each other.

About the Role

You will help adapt our established Level 4 Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability Practitioner apprenticeship for NHS and healthcare learners, then coach apprentices through the programme over the long term. Development is planned from early 2027, with a proposed spring launch.

The course framework and core curriculum are already in place. Working with the Curriculum Development and Sustainability teams, you will review the content through an NHS lens, adapting examples, workplace activities and evidence opportunities while preserving the apprenticeship standard and its knowledge, skills and behaviours.

Your understanding of NHS structures, local priorities and procurement arrangements will help learners apply the programme in their own trust, integrated care board or department. The role sits within Operations and reports to the Curriculum Team Leader.

You may currently work in NHS sustainability, procurement, estates, operations or management and be ready to move into learning and coaching. We will support you to develop your apprenticeship delivery and coaching skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and adapt learning cycles, workshops, case studies and workplace activities for different NHS settings, retaining existing content where it remains relevant.
  • Apply NHS sustainability, governance, budgets, commissioning and procurement knowledge to connect learning with employers’ Green Plans, contracts and improvement priorities.
  • Check NHS policy references and resources for accuracy, work to editorial standards and deadlines, and share your subject expertise with colleagues and employer partners.
  • Coach adult apprentices through individual learning plans, monthly one-to-one sessions and relevant workshops, adapting support to their roles and working patterns.
  • Monitor progress, provide developmental feedback and hold reviews with learners and line managers every 6–8 weeks; identify barriers early and agree practical support.
  • Help learners prepare for gateway and end-point assessment, maintain accurate progress and off-the-job learning records, and contribute to programme improvement.
  • Follow safeguarding, Prevent, equality, inclusion, funding and quality requirements, raising concerns promptly.

Interpersonal Fit

You will bring curiosity, clear communication and an approachable manner, building credibility with NHS colleagues at every level. We value people who take ownership, collaborate with stong working relationships, welcome feedback and share our commitment to the joy of learning, sustainable patient care, quality, safeguarding and inclusion.

Experience, Skills & Qualifications

Essential

  • Substantial first-hand experience working within an NHS trust, integrated care board or national NHS body in sustainability, procurement, estates and facilities, operations or management, with hands-on involvement in net zero or social value activity.
  • Experience preparing papers or business cases for senior leaders, boards or committees and managing budgets, resources or contracts within NHS governance requirements.
  • Understanding of NHS structures and governance, Green Plans, the 2040 and 2045 net zero targets, climate duties under the Health and Care Act 2022 and CQC Well-led expectations on environmental sustainability.
  • Knowledge of the Procurement Act 2023, Provider Selection Regime, NHS Net Zero Supplier Roadmap, supplier Carbon Reduction Plans and social value; an understanding of how procurement arrangements differ across NHS organisations and functions.
  • Awareness of sustainability across healthcare estates, energy, clinical waste, medicines, anaesthetic gases, travel, food, digital services and lower-carbon care pathways.
  • Understanding of corporate responsibility and sustainability, including ESG, sustainability frameworks, GHG Protocol scopes, reporting standards, stakeholder theory and risk management.
  • Ability to review and adapt learning materials, check credible evidence and meet deadlines; experience coaching, training or developing adults, facilitating workshops and giving feedback.
  • A relevant degree in health management, environmental management, sustainability, business or procurement, or equivalent professional experience; a teaching or training qualification such as the Level 3 Award in Education and Training, or willingness to achieve one.
  • Clear communication, confidence with online delivery, strong organisation and accurate record keeping; GCSE
  • English and Mathematics at grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent.

Desirable

  • Experience in a Green Plan role, supporting a board-level net zero lead or working with healthcare suppliers on net zero commitments.
  • Familiarity with the Five Case Model, Core20PLUS5, NHS anchor institutions, the NHS 10 Year Health Plan, NHS charities, the NHS Social Value Playbook, Evergreen or SusQI.
  • Experience developing learning resources or delivering apprenticeships; relevant professional membership, assessor, CIPS, NHS leadership or project management qualifications; experience with learning platforms or e-portfolios.

Why Work With Us?

At KnowledgeBrief, we are committed to creating an environment where people feel supported, challenged, and able to grow.

You’ll benefit from:

  • 5.6 weeks’ annual leave
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme
  • Dedicated monthly CPD days on successful completion of probation
  • Two weeks’ paid time off over Christmas and New Year on successful completion of probation
  • Company sick pay on successful completion of probation
  • Opportunities to contribute to cross-team projects and organisational growth
  • A remote-first environment with opportunities to connect in person

Our Commitment to Safer Recruitment and Inclusion

KnowledgeBrief is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of learners, and all colleagues are expected to share this commitment.

Offers of employment are subject to pre-employment checks, including right to work, references, and DBS checks where appropriate.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. Reasonable adjustments are available throughout the recruitment process.

Application Process

Submit your CV, clearly highlighting your NHS employment experience and involvement in sustainability, procurement, net zero or social value activity.

  • Initial screening with the People & Culture Team
  • Interview stage(s) with the hiring team
  • Final decision and feedback

We aim to keep the process timely, transparent, and respectful of your experience.

Ready to Apply?

If you would like to use your NHS experience to help others learn and make a practical difference, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and we will be in touch.

The Hiring Team

  • Experience defining and communicating prioritized remediation plans and partnering with engineering teams to drive security improvements.
  • Experience mentoring security consultants or leading technical customer engagements.

This is a founding role — a rare chance to build something from the ground up within an established, high-scale Professional Services organization. You'll set the tone for how we deliver security, mentor future team members, and directly shape the methodologies and culture of the PSSA practice.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements

  • 8+ years professional software development experience, with 3+ years in an architecture-focused role
  • Deep experience designing low-latency service architectures in AWS, including judgment about when distributed components (queues, caches, search projections) earn their place
  • Experience designing to explicit latency budgets (p95/p99), including synchronous durable commits in hot paths
  • Experience designing audit/evidence systems: append-only event logs, versioned or bitemporal fact models, and deterministic historical replay
  • Experience designing fail-open/fail-closed/degraded-state semantics and outage postures
  • Proven experience architecting secure multi-tenant environments, including tradeoff analysis (RLS vs. schema-per-tenant vs. database-per-tenant)
  • Deep experience with PostgreSQL/AuroraDB and Row-Level Security (RLS) at a data-modeling and architecture level
  • Expertise in designing and building scalable RESTful APIs
  • Experience architecting SDK integrations to other services
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript across the stack
  • Experience building capacity models and cloud cost/performance projections (AWS Well-Architected Framework)
  • Experience establishing technical standards, conducting architecture and code reviews, and mentoring engineering teams
  • Experience producing architecture documentation, diagrams, and technical decision records (ADRs)
  • Experience presenting and defending architecture decisions in client engineering and security reviews
  • Experience working with AI coding assistants as part of daily development
  • Substantial background architecting large, complex systems end-to-end
  • Ability to overlap US business hours
  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables
  • Client-focused dedication to team commitments
  • Best practices knowledge and adherence
  • Strong problem-solving ability and technical leadership skills
  • Positive mindset and can-do attitude
  • Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in compliance-sensitive or regulated domains (e.g., TCPA/DNC, fintech decisioning, audit-heavy systems)
  • Experience with event-driven design, message queues, and caching strategies at scale
  • Advanced degree

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our partner company, a healthcare technology platform used by clinics to manage scheduling, clinical records, invoicing, and more.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our partner company, a healthcare technology platform used by clinics to manage scheduling, clinical records, invoicing, and more. In this role, you will ship features end to end, own production health, and build AI-powered capabilities that help clinic staff work smarter. The ideal candidate is passionate about writing clean, secure, and performant code, enjoys working directly with stakeholders, and is eager to raise the engineering bar for the whole team.

Excited? Let’s see what it takes 💛

What you will do:

  • Ship features end to end in Django/DRF, PostgreSQL, and React/TypeScript, covering scheduling, clinical records, invoicing, and reports;
  • Maintain the Playwright end-to-end test suite for both API and UI, keeping it green with the help of AI agents;
  • Build AI features, including an MCP server that gives AI agents per-user access to the platform and a staff assistant on AWS Bedrock with EU data residency;
  • Plan and ship releases, including scoping, QA sign-off, migration and deploy order, feature flags, and rollback;
  • Own production health across ECS services, RDS, Celery workers, and the real-time server, leading the fix and the post-mortem when something breaks;
  • Build and maintain the integrations clinics depend on: UAE health exchanges, Stripe, SMS, WhatsApp, email, imaging and 3D scans, and country-specific tax and invoicing rules;
  • Keep each clinic's data isolated and safe through multi-tenant access control, roles and permissions, and audit trails;
  • Keep the product fast by fixing N+1 queries, tuning slow endpoints and reports, and writing migrations that are safe on live data;
  • Work directly with stakeholders and clinics to clarify requests, demo completed work, and turn support tickets into root-cause fixes;
  • Mentor a middle developer and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, Jenkins pipelines, and Terraform.

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 5+ years of proven experience with Python/Django and PostgreSQL;
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, particularly ECS and RDS;
  • Confidence working with React;
  • Practical experience building products with AI/LLMs;
  • Familiarity with Jenkins, Bitbucket, and Jira;
  • Fluent English (B2 or higher), both written and spoken;
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to lead incident resolution, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and mentor others.

Will be a plus:

  • Experience with healthcare or clinical workflows;
  • Experience with integrations with government or healthcare systems.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Fixed schedule: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UAE time (GMT+4);
  • Opportunity to cooperate fully remotely;
  • Inclusive and international environment;
  • Compensation in USD;
  • Supportive management focused on your growth and long-term collaboration.

So if you are a proactive PythonFull-Stack Developer who loves owning products end to end, building meaningful AI features, and making a real impact on healthcare — grab the chance to collaborate with us and send your CV in English 💛

We adhere to the principles of equal treatment of candidates and prohibit discrimination on any grounds protected by law.

Your personal data will be processed as described in the SupportYourApp Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Mobile & Web
jobs.excerpt: At MoneyGram, we're combining the strength of a trusted global brand with the agility of a tech-forward, growth driven culture.
jobs.description:
At MoneyGram, we're combining the strength of a trusted global brand with the agility of a tech-forward, growth driven culture. With 85+ years of experience and a presence in more than 200 countries and territories, we've built a foundation of stability and trust to help millions of people around the world send funds quickly, securely, and affordably. We're looking for bold thinkers, builders, technologists, and sellers who want real ownership of their work, thrive in collaborative environments, and are energized by solving complex challenges. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact - fast. If you're eager to shape the future of cross-border payments and financial services, join us as we transform how the world moves money.

Senior Full Stack Engineer, Mobile & Web Location: Remote, Germany or Portugal About the role MoneyGram is being refounded. Nearly half a million cash locations across 200+ countries, built over decades. Five times the footprint of McDonald's, Burger King and Starbucks combined. Over $150 billion moving through it a year. Nobody building crypto payments can buy that. Now we're wiring it into the rails money is moving onto. This past year: multi-chain, billions on chain, our own stablecoin, cash off-ramp for platforms like Kraken. Next is a stablecoin-powered balance account for millions of people worldwide. Most of the industry builds digital money for people who already have good banking. We're building it for everyone else. You'd join the small team building it. Startup pace, decades of infrastructure underneath you. What you'll do

  • Build features end to end. From the React Native screen a recipient taps to the Spring Boot service behind it. You'll own vertical slices, not layers.
  • Lead on mobile and web. The client experience is where this product lives or dies. We want someone whose frontend work is a genuine strength, not the half of the stack they tolerate.
  • Launch new markets, and make each one cheaper than the last. Every country brings its own regulatory, payout and localization requirements, and today each launch takes heavy manual work. You'll ship these launches, then build the tooling so the tenth doesn't cost as much as the first.
  • Work on the money path. Balances, ledgers, transfers, reconciliation. Getting this right when things fail halfway is the hard part of the job, and we treat it that way.

  • Invest in the platform. Automated testing, alerting, wallet recovery, KYC flows. We've deferred more of this than we'd like. You'll help us stop.

Operate what you build. Deployment, monitoring, on-call, root cause analysis, with the autonomy and the responsibility that come with it. What we're looking for

Our stack

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts to different audiences.
